66std::string TrimAscii(const std::string& input) {
67 size_t start = 0;
68 while (start < input.size() &&
69 std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(input[start]))) {
70 ++start;
71 }
72 size_t end = input.size();
73 while (end > start &&
74 std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(input[end - 1]))) {
75 --end;
76 }
77 return input.substr(start, end - start);
78}

80std::string StripInlineComment(const std::string& value) {
81 for (size_t i = 0; i < value.size(); ++i) {
82 if (value[i] != '#') {
83 continue;
84 }
85 if (i == 0 || std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(value[i - 1]))) {
86 return TrimAscii(value.substr(0, i));
87 }
88 }
89 return TrimAscii(value);
90}

92bool ParseDotEnvLine(const std::string& line, std::string* key,
93 std::string* value) {
94 if (!key || !value) {
95 return false;
96 }
97 std::string trimmed = TrimAscii(line);
98 if (trimmed.empty() || trimmed[0] == '#') {
99 return false;
100 }
101 constexpr const char* kExportPrefix = "export ";
102 if (trimmed.rfind(kExportPrefix, 0) == 0u) {
103 trimmed = TrimAscii(trimmed.substr(std::strlen(kExportPrefix)));
104 }
105 size_t eq = trimmed.find('=');
106 if (eq == std::string::npos) {
107 return false;
108 }
109 *key = TrimAscii(trimmed.substr(0, eq));
110 if (key->empty()) {
111 return false;
112 }
113 std::string raw_value = TrimAscii(trimmed.substr(eq + 1));
114 if (raw_value.size() >= 2u) {
115 char quote = raw_value.front();
116 if ((quote == '"' || quote == '\'') && raw_value.back() == quote) {
117 *value = raw_value.substr(1, raw_value.size() - 2);
118 return true;
119 }
120 }
121 *value = StripInlineComment(raw_value);
122 return true;
123}

125void LoadDotEnvIfDebug() {
126#ifdef NDEBUG
127 return;
128#else
129 std::error_code ec;
130 std::filesystem::path cwd = std::filesystem::current_path(ec);
131 if (ec || cwd.empty()) {
132 return;
133 }
134 std::filesystem::path env_path = cwd / ".env";
135 std::ifstream in(env_path);
136 if (!in) {
137 return;
138 }
139 std::string line;
140 while (std::getline(in, line)) {
141 if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') {
142 line.pop_back();
143 }
144 std::string key;
145 std::string value;
146 if (!ParseDotEnvLine(line, &key, &value)) {
147 continue;
148 }
149 if (std::getenv(key.c_str()) != nullptr) {
150 continue;
151 }
152 setenv(key.c_str(), value.c_str(), 0);
153 }
154#endif
155}

208uint32_t EnvUint(const char* key, uint32_t default_value) {
209 const char* value = std::getenv(key);
210 if (!value || *value == '\0') {
211 return default_value;
212 }
213 char* end = nullptr;
214 unsigned long parsed = std::strtoul(value, &end, 10);
215 if (!end || end == value) {
216 return default_value;
217 }
218 if (parsed > std::numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max()) {
219 return std::numeric_limits<uint32_t>::max();
220 }
221 return static_cast<uint32_t>(parsed);
222}

321bool TokenizeSdf(const std::string& content, std::vector<SdfToken>* tokens,
322 std::string* error, int* error_line, int* error_column) {
323 tokens->clear();
324 int line = 1;
325 int column = 1;
326 size_t i = 0;
327 auto set_error = [&](const std::string& message) {
328 if (error) {
329 *error = message;
330 }
331 if (error_line) {
332 *error_line = line;
333 }
334 if (error_column) {
335 *error_column = column;
336 }
337 };
338 auto push_token = [&](const std::string& text, int tok_line,
339 int tok_column) {
340 tokens->push_back(SdfToken{text, tok_line, tok_column});
341 };
342 while (i < content.size()) {
343 unsigned char ch = static_cast<unsigned char>(content[i]);
344 if (std::isspace(ch)) {
345 if (content[i] == '\n') {
346 ++line;
347 column = 1;
348 } else {
349 ++column;
350 }
351 ++i;
352 continue;
353 }
354 if (content[i] == '/' && i + 1 < content.size()) {
355 if (content[i + 1] == '/') {
356 i += 2;
357 column += 2;
358 while (i < content.size() && content[i] != '\n') {
359 ++i;
360 ++column;
361 }
362 continue;
363 }
364 if (content[i + 1] == '*') {
365 i += 2;
366 column += 2;
367 bool closed = false;
368 while (i + 1 < content.size()) {
369 if (content[i] == '\n') {
370 ++line;
371 column = 1;
372 ++i;
373 continue;
374 }
375 if (content[i] == '*' && content[i + 1] == '/') {
376 i += 2;
377 column += 2;
378 closed = true;
379 break;
380 }
381 ++i;
382 ++column;
383 }
384 if (!closed) {
385 set_error("unterminated block comment");
386 return false;
387 }
388 continue;
389 }
390 }
391 if (content[i] == '(' || content[i] == ')') {
392 int tok_line = line;
393 int tok_column = column;
394 push_token(std::string(1, content[i]), tok_line, tok_column);
395 ++i;
396 ++column;
397 continue;
398 }
399 if (content[i] == '"') {
400 int tok_line = line;
401 int tok_column = column;
402 ++i;
403 ++column;
404 std::string value;
405 bool closed = false;
406 while (i < content.size()) {
407 char c = content[i];
408 if (c == '"') {
409 closed = true;
410 ++i;
411 ++column;
412 break;
413 }
414 if (c == '\\' && i + 1 < content.size()) {
415 value.push_back(content[i + 1]);
416 i += 2;
417 column += 2;
418 continue;
419 }
420 if (c == '\n') {
421 ++line;
422 column = 1;
423 value.push_back(c);
424 ++i;
425 continue;
426 }
427 value.push_back(c);
428 ++i;
429 ++column;
430 }
431 if (!closed) {
432 set_error("unterminated string literal");
433 return false;
434 }
435 push_token(value, tok_line, tok_column);
436 continue;
437 }
438 int tok_line = line;
439 int tok_column = column;
440 size_t start = i;
441 while (i < content.size()) {
442 char c = content[i];
443 if (std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)) || c == '(' ||
444 c == ')') {
445 break;
446 }
447 ++i;
448 ++column;
449 }
450 if (i == start) {
451 set_error("unexpected character");
452 return false;
453 }
454 push_token(content.substr(start, i - start), tok_line, tok_column);
455 }
456 return true;
457}

459bool ParseSdfNode(const std::vector<SdfToken>& tokens, size_t* index,
460 SdfNode* out, std::string* error, int* error_line,
461 int* error_column) {
462 if (*index >= tokens.size()) {
463 if (error) {
464 *error = "unexpected end of file";
465 }
466 return false;
467 }
468 const SdfToken& token = tokens[*index];
469 if (token.text == "(") {
470 out->is_atom = false;
471 out->line = token.line;
472 out->column = token.column;
473 out->children.clear();
474 ++(*index);
475 while (*index < tokens.size() && tokens[*index].text != ")") {
476 SdfNode child;
477 if (!ParseSdfNode(tokens, index, &child, error, error_line,
478 error_column)) {
479 return false;
480 }
481 out->children.push_back(std::move(child));
482 }
483 if (*index >= tokens.size()) {
484 if (error) {
485 *error = "missing ')' in SDF list";
486 }
487 if (error_line) {
488 *error_line = token.line;
489 }
490 if (error_column) {
491 *error_column = token.column;
492 }
493 return false;
494 }
495 ++(*index);
496 return true;
497 }
498 if (token.text == ")") {
499 if (error) {
500 *error = "unexpected ')'";
501 }
502 if (error_line) {
503 *error_line = token.line;
504 }
505 if (error_column) {
506 *error_column = token.column;
507 }
508 return false;
509 }
510 out->is_atom = true;
511 out->text = token.text;
512 out->line = token.line;
513 out->column = token.column;
514 ++(*index);
515 return true;
516}

518bool ParseSdfTokens(const std::vector<SdfToken>& tokens,
519 std::vector<SdfNode>* nodes, std::string* error,
520 int* error_line, int* error_column) {
521 nodes->clear();
522 size_t index = 0;
523 while (index < tokens.size()) {
524 SdfNode node;
525 if (!ParseSdfNode(tokens, &index, &node, error, error_line,
526 error_column)) {
527 return false;
528 }
529 nodes->push_back(std::move(node));
530 }
531 return true;
532}

534void AppendSdfNodeText(const SdfNode& node, std::string* out,
535 bool include_parens) {
536 if (node.is_atom) {
537 out->append(node.text);
538 return;
539 }
540 if (include_parens) {
541 out->push_back('(');
542 }
543 for (const auto& child : node.children) {
544 AppendSdfNodeText(child, out, true);
545 }
546 if (include_parens) {
547 out->push_back(')');
548 }

564bool IsTimingCheckName(const std::string& name) {
565 static const std::unordered_set<std::string> names = {
566 "setup", "hold", "setuphold", "recovery", "removal",
567 "recrem", "skew", "period", "width", "pulsewidth", "nochange"};

571bool ParseSdfNumber(const std::string& text, SdfTimingCheck::Value* out) {
572 if (!out) {
573 return false;
574 }
575 *out = {};
576 if (text.empty() || text == "*") {
577 return false;
578 }
579 bool has_float = false;
580 for (char ch : text) {
581 if (ch == '.' || ch == 'e' || ch == 'E') {
582 has_float = true;
583 break;
584 }
585 }
586 char* end = nullptr;
587 if (has_float) {
588 double value = std::strtod(text.c_str(), &end);
589 if (end == text.c_str() || (end && *end != '\0')) {
590 return false;
591 }
592 out->valid = true;
593 out->is_real = true;
594 out->real_value = value;
595 return true;
596 }
597 long long value = std::strtoll(text.c_str(), &end, 10);
598 if (end == text.c_str() || (end && *end != '\0')) {
599 double real_value = std::strtod(text.c_str(), &end);
600 if (end == text.c_str() || (end && *end != '\0')) {
601 return false;
602 }
603 out->valid = true;
604 out->is_real = true;
605 out->real_value = real_value;
606 return true;
607 }
608 out->valid = true;
609 out->is_real = false;
610 out->int_value = static_cast<int64_t>(value);
611 return true;
612}

614SdfTimingCheck::Limit ParseSdfLimitToken(const std::string& text) {
615 SdfTimingCheck::Limit limit;
616 if (text.empty()) {
617 return limit;
618 }
619 std::vector<std::string> parts;
620 size_t start = 0;
621 for (size_t i = 0; i <= text.size(); ++i) {
622 if (i == text.size() || text[i] == ':') {
623 parts.push_back(text.substr(start, i - start));
624 start = i + 1;
625 }
626 }
627 auto parse_value = [&](const std::string& token,
628 SdfTimingCheck::Value* out) {
629 if (!token.empty()) {
630 ParseSdfNumber(token, out);
631 }
632 };
633 if (parts.size() == 1) {
634 parse_value(parts[0], &limit.min);
635 limit.typ = limit.min;
636 limit.max = limit.min;
637 } else if (parts.size() == 2) {
638 parse_value(parts[0], &limit.min);
639 parse_value(parts[1], &limit.max);
640 } else {
641 parse_value(parts[0], &limit.min);
642 parse_value(parts[1], &limit.typ);
643 parse_value(parts[2], &limit.max);
644 }
645 return limit;
646}

648void AppendSdfValueTokens(const SdfNode& node,
649 std::vector<std::string>* out) {
650 if (!out) {
651 return;
652 }
653 if (node.is_atom) {
654 out->push_back(ToLowerAscii(node.text));
655 return;
656 }
657 if (!node.children.empty() && node.children[0].is_atom) {
658 std::string head = ToLowerAscii(node.children[0].text);
659 if (head == "cond" || head == "posedge" || head == "negedge") {
660 return;
661 }
662 }
663 for (const auto& child : node.children) {
664 if (child.is_atom) {
665 out->push_back(ToLowerAscii(child.text));
666 } else {
667 std::string normalized = NormalizeSdfExpr(child);
668 if (!normalized.empty()) {
669 out->push_back(normalized);
670 }
671 }
672 }
673}

675size_t SdfEventCountForCheck(const std::string& name) {
676 if (name == "period" || name == "width" || name == "pulsewidth") {
677 return 1u;
678 }
679 return 2u;
680}
681
682size_t SdfRefEventIndexForCheck(const std::string& name,
683 size_t event_count) {
684 if (event_count == 0u) {
685 return 0u;
686 }
687 if ((name == "setup" || name == "recovery" || name == "removal" ||
688 name == "recrem") &&
689 event_count > 1u) {
690 return 1u;
691 }
692 return 0u;
693}

695void ExtractEventFromSdfNode(const SdfNode& node, std::string* edge,
696 std::string* signal) {
697 edge->clear();
698 signal->clear();
699 if (node.is_atom) {
700 *signal = ToLowerAscii(node.text);
701 return;
702 }
703 if (node.children.empty()) {
704 return;
705 }
706 if (node.children[0].is_atom) {
707 std::string first = ToLowerAscii(node.children[0].text);
708 if (first == "posedge" || first == "negedge") {
709 *edge = first;
710 if (node.children.size() > 1) {
711 *signal = NormalizeSdfNodeList(
712 std::vector<SdfNode>(node.children.begin() + 1,
713 node.children.end()));
714 }
715 return;
716 }
717 }
718 *signal = NormalizeSdfNodeList(node.children);
719}

721bool ParseSdfTimingCheck(const SdfNode& node, SdfTimingCheck* out) {
722 if (node.is_atom || node.children.empty()) {
723 return false;
724 }
725 if (!node.children[0].is_atom) {
726 return false;
727 }
728 std::string name = ToLowerAscii(node.children[0].text);
729 if (!IsTimingCheckName(name)) {
730 return false;
731 }
732 size_t event_needed = SdfEventCountForCheck(name);
733 std::vector<const SdfNode*> event_nodes;
734 size_t value_start = 1;
735 while (value_start < node.children.size() &&
736 event_nodes.size() < event_needed) {
737 event_nodes.push_back(&node.children[value_start]);
738 ++value_start;
739 }
740 if (event_nodes.empty()) {
741 return false;
742 }
743 size_t ref_index = SdfRefEventIndexForCheck(name, event_nodes.size());
744 const SdfNode* event_node = event_nodes[ref_index];
745 out->name = name;
746 out->edge.clear();
747 out->signal.clear();
748 out->condition.clear();
749 out->has_cond = false;
750 out->limits.clear();
751 out->line = node.line;
752 out->column = node.column;
753 if (!event_node->children.empty() && event_node->children[0].is_atom) {
754 std::string head = ToLowerAscii(event_node->children[0].text);
755 if (head == "cond") {
756 out->has_cond = true;
757 if (event_node->children.size() >= 3) {
758 out->condition = NormalizeSdfExpr(event_node->children[1]);
759 ExtractEventFromSdfNode(event_node->children.back(), &out->edge,
760 &out->signal);
761 return !out->signal.empty();
762 }
763 return false;
764 }
765 }
766 ExtractEventFromSdfNode(*event_node, &out->edge, &out->signal);
767 std::vector<std::string> value_tokens;
768 for (size_t i = value_start; i < node.children.size(); ++i) {
769 AppendSdfValueTokens(node.children[i], &value_tokens);
770 }
771 for (const auto& token : value_tokens) {
772 SdfTimingCheck::Limit limit = ParseSdfLimitToken(token);
773 if (limit.HasAny()) {
774 out->limits.push_back(std::move(limit));
775 }
776 }
777 return !out->signal.empty();
778}
779
780void CollectSdfTimingChecks(const SdfNode& node,
781 std::vector<SdfTimingCheck>* out) {
782 SdfTimingCheck timing;
783 if (ParseSdfTimingCheck(node, &timing)) {
784 out->push_back(std::move(timing));
785 }
786 if (!node.is_atom) {
787 for (const auto& child : node.children) {
788 CollectSdfTimingChecks(child, out);
789 }
790 }
791}
792
793bool LoadSdfTimingChecks(const std::string& path,
794 std::vector<SdfTimingCheck>* checks,
795 gpga::Diagnostics* diagnostics) {
796 checks->clear();
797 std::ifstream in(path, std::ios::binary);
798 if (!in) {
799 diagnostics->Add(gpga::Severity::kError,
800 "failed to open SDF file",
801 gpga::SourceLocation{path});
802 return false;
803 }
804 std::string content((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in)),
805 std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
806 std::vector<SdfToken> tokens;
807 std::string error;
808 int error_line = 0;
809 int error_column = 0;
810 if (!TokenizeSdf(content, &tokens, &error, &error_line, &error_column)) {
811 diagnostics->Add(gpga::Severity::kError,
812 "failed to tokenize SDF: " + error,
813 gpga::SourceLocation{path, error_line, error_column});
814 return false;
815 }
816 std::vector<SdfNode> nodes;
817 if (!ParseSdfTokens(tokens, &nodes, &error, &error_line, &error_column)) {
818 diagnostics->Add(gpga::Severity::kError,
819 "failed to parse SDF: " + error,
820 gpga::SourceLocation{path, error_line, error_column});
821 return false;
822 }
823 for (const auto& node : nodes) {
824 CollectSdfTimingChecks(node, checks);
825 }
826 return true;
827}

829uint64_t DoubleToBits(double value) {
830 uint64_t bits = 0;
831 static_assert(sizeof(bits) == sizeof(value), "double size mismatch");
832 std::memcpy(&bits, &value, sizeof(bits));
833 return bits;
834}
835
836std::unique_ptr<gpga::Expr> MakeSdfRealExpr(double value) {
837 uint64_t bits = DoubleToBits(value);
838 auto expr = std::make_unique<gpga::Expr>();
839 expr->kind = gpga::ExprKind::kNumber;
840 expr->number = bits;
841 expr->value_bits = bits;
842 expr->has_width = true;
843 expr->number_width = 64;
844 expr->is_real_literal = true;
845 return expr;
846}
847
848std::unique_ptr<gpga::Expr> MakeSdfIntegerExpr(int64_t value) {
849 auto expr = std::make_unique<gpga::Expr>();
850 expr->kind = gpga::ExprKind::kNumber;
851 expr->is_signed = value < 0;
852 expr->has_width = true;
853 expr->number_width = 64;
854 uint64_t bits = static_cast<uint64_t>(value);
855 expr->number = bits;
856 expr->value_bits = bits;
857 return expr;
858}
859
860std::unique_ptr<gpga::Expr> MakeSdfValueExpr(
861 const SdfTimingCheck::Value& value) {
862 if (!value.valid) {
863 return nullptr;
864 }
865 if (value.is_real) {
866 return MakeSdfRealExpr(value.real_value);
867 }
868 return MakeSdfIntegerExpr(value.int_value);
869}

871void ClearTimingLimit(gpga::TimingCheckLimit* limit) {
872 if (!limit) {
873 return;
874 }
875 limit->min.reset();
876 limit->typ.reset();
877 limit->max.reset();

880void ApplySdfLimit(const SdfTimingCheck::Limit& src,
881 gpga::TimingCheckLimit* dest) {
882 if (!dest || !src.HasAny()) {
883 return;
884 }
885 ClearTimingLimit(dest);
886 dest->min = MakeSdfValueExpr(src.min);
887 dest->typ = MakeSdfValueExpr(src.typ);
888 dest->max = MakeSdfValueExpr(src.max);
889}

891size_t TimingCheckLimitCount(const gpga::TimingCheck& check) {
892 switch (check.kind) {
893 case gpga::TimingCheckKind::kSetupHold:
894 case gpga::TimingCheckKind::kRecRem:
895 case gpga::TimingCheckKind::kFullSkew:
896 case gpga::TimingCheckKind::kPulseWidth:
897 case gpga::TimingCheckKind::kNoChange:
898 return 2u;
899 default:
900 return 1u;
901 }
902}
903
904std::string TimingCheckKey(const std::string& name, const std::string& edge,
905 const std::string& signal,
906 const std::string& condition) {
907 return name + "|" + edge + "|" + signal + "|" + condition;
908}
909
910void ApplySdfTimingChecks(const std::string& path,
911 const std::vector<SdfTimingCheck>& sdf_checks,
912 gpga::Program* program,
913 gpga::Diagnostics* diagnostics) {
914 std::unordered_map<std::string, std::vector<gpga::TimingCheck*>>
915 checks_by_key;
916 std::vector<std::pair<std::string, gpga::TimingCheck*>> check_keys;
917 for (auto& module : program->modules) {
918 for (auto& check : module.timing_checks) {
919 std::string key = TimingCheckKey(check.name, check.edge, check.signal,
920 check.condition);
921 checks_by_key[key].push_back(&check);
922 check_keys.emplace_back(module.name, &check);
923 }
924 }
925 const char* verbose_env = std::getenv("METALFPGA_SDF_VERBOSE");
926 bool verbose = verbose_env && *verbose_env != '\0';
927 std::unordered_set<std::string> matched_keys;
928 for (const auto& sdf : sdf_checks) {
929 std::string key = TimingCheckKey(sdf.name, sdf.edge, sdf.signal,
930 sdf.condition);
931 auto it = checks_by_key.find(key);
932 if (it != checks_by_key.end()) {
933 matched_keys.insert(key);
934 if (!sdf.limits.empty()) {
935 for (gpga::TimingCheck* check : it->second) {
936 size_t limit_count = TimingCheckLimitCount(*check);
937 if (limit_count > 0u) {
938 ApplySdfLimit(sdf.limits[0], &check->limit);
939 }
940 if (limit_count > 1u && sdf.limits.size() > 1u) {
941 ApplySdfLimit(sdf.limits[1], &check->limit2);
942 }
943 }
944 }
945 if (verbose) {
946 std::cerr << "SDF match: " << sdf.name;
947 if (!sdf.edge.empty()) {
948 std::cerr << " " << sdf.edge;
949 }
950 if (!sdf.signal.empty()) {
951 std::cerr << " " << sdf.signal;
952 }
953 if (!sdf.condition.empty()) {
954 std::cerr << " &&& " << sdf.condition;
955 }
956 std::cerr << "\n";
957 }
958 continue;
959 }
960 if (sdf.has_cond) {
961 diagnostics->Add(gpga::Severity::kWarning,
962 "SDF COND did not match any timing check",
963 gpga::SourceLocation{path, sdf.line, sdf.column});
964 } else if (verbose) {
965 std::cerr << "SDF no match: " << sdf.name;
966 if (!sdf.edge.empty()) {
967 std::cerr << " " << sdf.edge;
968 }
969 if (!sdf.signal.empty()) {
970 std::cerr << " " << sdf.signal;
971 }
972 std::cerr << "\n";
973 }
974 }
975 if (verbose) {
976 for (const auto& entry : check_keys) {
977 const gpga::TimingCheck* check = entry.second;
978 const std::string key = TimingCheckKey(check->name, check->edge,
979 check->signal, check->condition);
980 if (matched_keys.count(key) != 0u) {
981 continue;
982 }
983 std::cerr << "SDF unannotated: " << entry.first << "." << check->name;
984 if (!check->edge.empty()) {
985 std::cerr << " " << check->edge;
986 }
987 if (!check->signal.empty()) {
988 std::cerr << " " << check->signal;
989 }
990 if (!check->condition.empty()) {
991 std::cerr << " &&& " << check->condition;
992 }
993 std::cerr << "\n";
994 }
995 }
996}

1010bool IdentAsString(const std::string& name) {
1011 return name == "$dumpvars" || name == "$dumpports" ||
1012 name == "$readmemh" || name == "$readmemb" ||
1013 name == "$writememh" || name == "$writememb" ||
1014 name == "$printtimescale" || name == "$async$and$array" ||
1015 name == "$async$and$plane" || name == "$sync$or$plane" ||
1016 name == "$async$nor$plane" || name == "$sync$nand$plane";

1019std::vector<char> ExtractFormatSpecs(const std::string& format) {
1020 std::vector<char> specs;
1021 for (size_t i = 0; i < format.size(); ++i) {
1022 if (format[i] != '%') {
1023 continue;
1024 }
1025 if (i + 1 < format.size() && format[i + 1] == '%') {
1026 ++i;
1027 continue;
1028 }
1029 size_t j = i + 1;
1030 if (j < format.size() && format[j] == '0') {
1031 ++j;
1032 }
1033 while (j < format.size() &&
1034 std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(format[j]))) {
1035 ++j;
1036 }
1037 if (j < format.size() && format[j] == '.') {
1038 ++j;
1039 while (j < format.size() &&
1040 std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(format[j]))) {
1041 ++j;
1042 }
1043 }
1044 if (j >= format.size()) {
1045 break;
1046 }
1047 char spec = format[j];
1048 if (spec >= 'A' && spec <= 'Z') {
1049 spec = static_cast<char>(spec - 'A' + 'a');
1050 }
1051 specs.push_back(spec);
1052 i = j;
1053 }
1054 return specs;
1055}

1057bool IsFileSystemFunctionName(const std::string& name) {
1058 return name == "$fopen" || name == "$fclose" || name == "$fgetc" ||
1059 name == "$fgets" || name == "$feof" || name == "$fscanf" ||
1060 name == "$sscanf" || name == "$ftell" || name == "$fseek" ||
1061 name == "$ferror" || name == "$ungetc" || name == "$fread" ||
1062 name == "$rewind" || name == "$test$plusargs" ||
1063 name == "$value$plusargs";
1064}
1065
1066void AddString(SysTaskInfo* info, const std::string& value) {
1067 if (!info) {
1068 return;
1069 }
1070 auto it = info->string_ids.find(value);
1071 if (it != info->string_ids.end()) {
1072 return;
1073 }
1074 info->string_ids[value] = info->string_table.size();
1075 info->string_table.push_back(value);
1076}
1077
1078void CollectStringLiterals(const gpga::Expr& expr, SysTaskInfo* info) {
1079 if (!info) {
1080 return;
1081 }
1082 switch (expr.kind) {
1083 case gpga::ExprKind::kString:
1084 AddString(info, expr.string_value);
1085 return;
1086 case gpga::ExprKind::kUnary:
1087 if (expr.operand) {
1088 CollectStringLiterals(*expr.operand, info);
1089 }
1090 return;
1091 case gpga::ExprKind::kBinary:
1092 if (expr.lhs) {
1093 CollectStringLiterals(*expr.lhs, info);
1094 }
1095 if (expr.rhs) {
1096 CollectStringLiterals(*expr.rhs, info);
1097 }
1098 return;
1099 case gpga::ExprKind::kTernary:
1100 if (expr.condition) {
1101 CollectStringLiterals(*expr.condition, info);
1102 }
1103 if (expr.then_expr) {
1104 CollectStringLiterals(*expr.then_expr, info);
1105 }
1106 if (expr.else_expr) {
1107 CollectStringLiterals(*expr.else_expr, info);
1108 }
1109 return;
1110 case gpga::ExprKind::kSelect:
1111 if (expr.base) {
1112 CollectStringLiterals(*expr.base, info);
1113 }
1114 if (expr.msb_expr) {
1115 CollectStringLiterals(*expr.msb_expr, info);
1116 }
1117 if (expr.lsb_expr) {
1118 CollectStringLiterals(*expr.lsb_expr, info);
1119 }
1120 return;
1121 case gpga::ExprKind::kIndex:
1122 if (expr.base) {
1123 CollectStringLiterals(*expr.base, info);
1124 }
1125 if (expr.index) {
1126 CollectStringLiterals(*expr.index, info);
1127 }
1128 return;
1129 case gpga::ExprKind::kCall:
1130 for (const auto& arg : expr.call_args) {
1131 if (arg) {
1132 CollectStringLiterals(*arg, info);
1133 }
1134 }
1135 return;
1136 case gpga::ExprKind::kConcat:
1137 for (const auto& element : expr.elements) {
1138 if (element) {
1139 CollectStringLiterals(*element, info);
1140 }
1141 }
1142 if (expr.repeat_expr) {
1143 CollectStringLiterals(*expr.repeat_expr, info);
1144 }
1145 return;
1146 case gpga::ExprKind::kIdentifier:
1147 case gpga::ExprKind::kNumber:
1148 return;
1149 }
1150}
1151
1152void CollectSystemFunctionExpr(const gpga::Expr& expr, SysTaskInfo* info) {
1153 if (!info) {
1154 return;
1155 }
1156 if (expr.kind == gpga::ExprKind::kCall) {
1157 if (IsFileSystemFunctionName(expr.ident)) {
1158 info->has_tasks = true;
1159 info->max_args = std::max(info->max_args, expr.call_args.size());
1160 for (size_t i = 0; i < expr.call_args.size(); ++i) {
1161 const auto* arg = expr.call_args[i].get();
1162 if (!arg) {
1163 continue;
1164 }
1165 if (arg->kind == gpga::ExprKind::kString) {
1166 AddString(info, arg->string_value);
1167 continue;
1168 }
1169 if (arg->kind == gpga::ExprKind::kIdentifier) {
1170 bool treat_ident = false;
1171 if (expr.ident == "$fgets") {
1172 treat_ident = (i == 0);
1173 } else if (expr.ident == "$fread") {
1174 treat_ident = (i == 0);
1175 } else if (expr.ident == "$fscanf" || expr.ident == "$sscanf") {
1176 treat_ident = (i >= 2);
1177 if (expr.ident == "$sscanf" && i == 0) {
1178 treat_ident = true;
1179 }
1180 } else if (expr.ident == "$fopen") {
1181 treat_ident = true;
1182 } else if (expr.ident == "$test$plusargs" ||
1183 expr.ident == "$value$plusargs") {
1184 treat_ident = true;
1185 }
1186 if (treat_ident) {
1187 AddString(info, arg->ident);
1188 }
1189 }
1190 }
1191 }
1192 for (const auto& arg : expr.call_args) {
1193 if (arg) {
1194 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*arg, info);
1195 }
1196 }
1197 return;
1198 }
1199 if (expr.kind == gpga::ExprKind::kUnary && expr.operand) {
1200 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*expr.operand, info);
1201 return;
1202 }
1203 if (expr.kind == gpga::ExprKind::kBinary) {
1204 if (expr.lhs) {
1205 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*expr.lhs, info);
1206 }
1207 if (expr.rhs) {
1208 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*expr.rhs, info);
1209 }
1210 return;
1211 }
1212 if (expr.kind == gpga::ExprKind::kTernary) {
1213 if (expr.condition) {
1214 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*expr.condition, info);
1215 }
1216 if (expr.then_expr) {
1217 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*expr.then_expr, info);
1218 }
1219 if (expr.else_expr) {
1220 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*expr.else_expr, info);
1221 }
1222 return;
1223 }
1224 if (expr.kind == gpga::ExprKind::kSelect) {
1225 if (expr.base) {
1226 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*expr.base, info);
1227 }
1228 if (expr.msb_expr) {
1229 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*expr.msb_expr, info);
1230 }
1231 if (expr.lsb_expr) {
1232 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*expr.lsb_expr, info);
1233 }
1234 return;
1235 }
1236 if (expr.kind == gpga::ExprKind::kIndex) {
1237 if (expr.base) {
1238 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*expr.base, info);
1239 }
1240 if (expr.index) {
1241 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*expr.index, info);
1242 }
1243 return;
1244 }
1245 if (expr.kind == gpga::ExprKind::kConcat) {
1246 for (const auto& element : expr.elements) {
1247 if (element) {
1248 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*element, info);
1249 }
1250 }
1251 if (expr.repeat_expr) {
1252 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*expr.repeat_expr, info);
1253 }
1254 return;
1255 }
1256}

1258void CollectReadSignalsExpr(const gpga::Expr& expr,
1259 std::unordered_set<std::string>* out) {
1260 if (!out) {
1261 return;
1262 }
1263 switch (expr.kind) {
1264 case gpga::ExprKind::kIdentifier:
1265 out->insert(expr.ident);
1266 return;
1267 case gpga::ExprKind::kUnary:
1268 if (expr.operand) {
1269 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*expr.operand, out);
1270 }
1271 return;
1272 case gpga::ExprKind::kBinary:
1273 if (expr.lhs) {
1274 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*expr.lhs, out);
1275 }
1276 if (expr.rhs) {
1277 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*expr.rhs, out);
1278 }
1279 return;
1280 case gpga::ExprKind::kTernary:
1281 if (expr.condition) {
1282 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*expr.condition, out);
1283 }
1284 if (expr.then_expr) {
1285 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*expr.then_expr, out);
1286 }
1287 if (expr.else_expr) {
1288 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*expr.else_expr, out);
1289 }
1290 return;
1291 case gpga::ExprKind::kSelect:
1292 if (expr.base) {
1293 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*expr.base, out);
1294 }
1295 if (expr.msb_expr) {
1296 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*expr.msb_expr, out);
1297 }
1298 if (expr.lsb_expr) {
1299 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*expr.lsb_expr, out);
1300 }
1301 return;
1302 case gpga::ExprKind::kIndex:
1303 if (expr.base) {
1304 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*expr.base, out);
1305 }
1306 if (expr.index) {
1307 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*expr.index, out);
1308 }
1309 return;
1310 case gpga::ExprKind::kCall:
1311 for (const auto& arg : expr.call_args) {
1312 if (arg) {
1313 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*arg, out);
1314 }
1315 }
1316 return;
1317 case gpga::ExprKind::kConcat:
1318 for (const auto& element : expr.elements) {
1319 if (element) {
1320 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*element, out);
1321 }
1322 }
1323 if (expr.repeat_expr) {
1324 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*expr.repeat_expr, out);
1325 }
1326 return;
1327 default:
1328 return;
1329 }
1330}
1331
1332void CollectReadSignals(const gpga::Statement& stmt,
1333 std::unordered_set<std::string>* out) {
1334 if (!out) {
1335 return;
1336 }
1337 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kAssign ||
1338 stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kForce ||
1339 stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kRelease) {
1340 if (stmt.assign.rhs) {
1341 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*stmt.assign.rhs, out);
1342 }
1343 if (stmt.assign.lhs_index) {
1344 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*stmt.assign.lhs_index, out);
1345 }
1346 for (const auto& index : stmt.assign.lhs_indices) {
1347 if (index) {
1348 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*index, out);
1349 }
1350 }
1351 if (stmt.assign.lhs_msb_expr) {
1352 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*stmt.assign.lhs_msb_expr, out);
1353 }
1354 if (stmt.assign.lhs_lsb_expr) {
1355 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*stmt.assign.lhs_lsb_expr, out);
1356 }
1357 if (stmt.assign.delay) {
1358 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*stmt.assign.delay, out);
1359 }
1360 return;
1361 }
1362 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kIf) {
1363 if (stmt.condition) {
1364 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*stmt.condition, out);
1365 }
1366 for (const auto& inner : stmt.then_branch) {
1367 CollectReadSignals(inner, out);
1368 }
1369 for (const auto& inner : stmt.else_branch) {
1370 CollectReadSignals(inner, out);
1371 }
1372 return;
1373 }
1374 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kBlock) {
1375 for (const auto& inner : stmt.block) {
1376 CollectReadSignals(inner, out);
1377 }
1378 return;
1379 }
1380 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kCase) {
1381 if (stmt.case_expr) {
1382 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*stmt.case_expr, out);
1383 }
1384 for (const auto& item : stmt.case_items) {
1385 for (const auto& label : item.labels) {
1386 if (label) {
1387 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*label, out);
1388 }
1389 }
1390 for (const auto& inner : item.body) {
1391 CollectReadSignals(inner, out);
1392 }
1393 }
1394 for (const auto& inner : stmt.default_branch) {
1395 CollectReadSignals(inner, out);
1396 }
1397 return;
1398 }
1399 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kFor) {
1400 if (stmt.for_init_rhs) {
1401 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*stmt.for_init_rhs, out);
1402 }
1403 if (stmt.for_condition) {
1404 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*stmt.for_condition, out);
1405 }
1406 if (stmt.for_step_rhs) {
1407 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*stmt.for_step_rhs, out);
1408 }
1409 for (const auto& inner : stmt.for_body) {
1410 CollectReadSignals(inner, out);
1411 }
1412 return;
1413 }
1414 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kWhile) {
1415 if (stmt.while_condition) {
1416 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*stmt.while_condition, out);
1417 }
1418 for (const auto& inner : stmt.while_body) {
1419 CollectReadSignals(inner, out);
1420 }
1421 return;
1422 }
1423 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kRepeat) {
1424 if (stmt.repeat_count) {
1425 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*stmt.repeat_count, out);
1426 }
1427 for (const auto& inner : stmt.repeat_body) {
1428 CollectReadSignals(inner, out);
1429 }
1430 return;
1431 }
1432 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kDelay) {
1433 if (stmt.delay) {
1434 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*stmt.delay, out);
1435 }
1436 for (const auto& inner : stmt.delay_body) {
1437 CollectReadSignals(inner, out);
1438 }
1439 return;
1440 }
1441 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kEventControl) {
1442 if (stmt.event_expr) {
1443 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*stmt.event_expr, out);
1444 }
1445 for (const auto& item : stmt.event_items) {
1446 if (item.expr) {
1447 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*item.expr, out);
1448 }
1449 }
1450 for (const auto& inner : stmt.event_body) {
1451 CollectReadSignals(inner, out);
1452 }
1453 return;
1454 }
1455 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kWait) {
1456 if (stmt.wait_condition) {
1457 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*stmt.wait_condition, out);
1458 }
1459 for (const auto& inner : stmt.wait_body) {
1460 CollectReadSignals(inner, out);
1461 }
1462 return;
1463 }
1464 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kForever) {
1465 for (const auto& inner : stmt.forever_body) {
1466 CollectReadSignals(inner, out);
1467 }
1468 return;
1469 }
1470 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kFork) {
1471 for (const auto& inner : stmt.fork_branches) {
1472 CollectReadSignals(inner, out);
1473 }
1474 }
1475 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kTaskCall) {
1476 for (const auto& arg : stmt.task_args) {
1477 if (arg) {
1478 CollectReadSignalsExpr(*arg, out);
1479 }
1480 }
1481 return;
1482 }
1483}
1484
1485void CollectSystemFunctionInfo(const gpga::Statement& stmt, SysTaskInfo* info) {
1486 if (!info) {
1487 return;
1488 }
1489 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kAssign) {
1490 if (stmt.assign.rhs) {
1491 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*stmt.assign.rhs, info);
1492 }
1493 if (stmt.assign.lhs_index) {
1494 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*stmt.assign.lhs_index, info);
1495 }
1496 for (const auto& index : stmt.assign.lhs_indices) {
1497 if (index) {
1498 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*index, info);
1499 }
1500 }
1501 if (stmt.assign.lhs_msb_expr) {
1502 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*stmt.assign.lhs_msb_expr, info);
1503 }
1504 if (stmt.assign.lhs_lsb_expr) {
1505 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*stmt.assign.lhs_lsb_expr, info);
1506 }
1507 if (stmt.assign.delay) {
1508 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*stmt.assign.delay, info);
1509 }
1510 return;
1511 }
1512 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kIf) {
1513 if (stmt.condition) {
1514 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*stmt.condition, info);
1515 }
1516 for (const auto& inner : stmt.then_branch) {
1517 CollectSystemFunctionInfo(inner, info);
1518 }
1519 for (const auto& inner : stmt.else_branch) {
1520 CollectSystemFunctionInfo(inner, info);
1521 }
1522 return;
1523 }
1524 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kBlock) {
1525 for (const auto& inner : stmt.block) {
1526 CollectSystemFunctionInfo(inner, info);
1527 }
1528 return;
1529 }
1530 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kCase) {
1531 if (stmt.case_expr) {
1532 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*stmt.case_expr, info);
1533 }
1534 for (const auto& item : stmt.case_items) {
1535 for (const auto& label : item.labels) {
1536 if (label) {
1537 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*label, info);
1538 }
1539 }
1540 for (const auto& inner : item.body) {
1541 CollectSystemFunctionInfo(inner, info);
1542 }
1543 }
1544 for (const auto& inner : stmt.default_branch) {
1545 CollectSystemFunctionInfo(inner, info);
1546 }
1547 return;
1548 }
1549 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kFor) {
1550 if (stmt.for_init_rhs) {
1551 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*stmt.for_init_rhs, info);
1552 }
1553 if (stmt.for_condition) {
1554 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*stmt.for_condition, info);
1555 }
1556 if (stmt.for_step_rhs) {
1557 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*stmt.for_step_rhs, info);
1558 }
1559 for (const auto& inner : stmt.for_body) {
1560 CollectSystemFunctionInfo(inner, info);
1561 }
1562 return;
1563 }
1564 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kWhile) {
1565 if (stmt.while_condition) {
1566 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*stmt.while_condition, info);
1567 }
1568 for (const auto& inner : stmt.while_body) {
1569 CollectSystemFunctionInfo(inner, info);
1570 }
1571 return;
1572 }
1573 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kRepeat) {
1574 if (stmt.repeat_count) {
1575 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*stmt.repeat_count, info);
1576 }
1577 for (const auto& inner : stmt.repeat_body) {
1578 CollectSystemFunctionInfo(inner, info);
1579 }
1580 return;
1581 }
1582 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kDelay) {
1583 if (stmt.delay) {
1584 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*stmt.delay, info);
1585 }
1586 for (const auto& inner : stmt.delay_body) {
1587 CollectSystemFunctionInfo(inner, info);
1588 }
1589 return;
1590 }
1591 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kEventControl) {
1592 if (stmt.event_expr) {
1593 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*stmt.event_expr, info);
1594 }
1595 for (const auto& item : stmt.event_items) {
1596 if (item.expr) {
1597 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*item.expr, info);
1598 }
1599 }
1600 for (const auto& inner : stmt.event_body) {
1601 CollectSystemFunctionInfo(inner, info);
1602 }
1603 return;
1604 }
1605 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kWait) {
1606 if (stmt.wait_condition) {
1607 CollectSystemFunctionExpr(*stmt.wait_condition, info);
1608 }
1609 for (const auto& inner : stmt.wait_body) {
1610 CollectSystemFunctionInfo(inner, info);
1611 }
1612 return;
1613 }
1614 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kForever) {
1615 for (const auto& inner : stmt.forever_body) {
1616 CollectSystemFunctionInfo(inner, info);
1617 }
1618 return;
1619 }
1620 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kFork) {
1621 for (const auto& inner : stmt.fork_branches) {
1622 CollectSystemFunctionInfo(inner, info);
1623 }
1624 }
1625}
1626
1627void CollectTasks(const gpga::Statement& stmt, SysTaskInfo* info) {
1628 if (!info) {
1629 return;
1630 }
1631 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kTaskCall &&
1632 IsSystemTask(stmt.task_name)) {
1633 info->has_tasks = true;
1634 if (stmt.task_name == "$dumpvars" || stmt.task_name == "$dumpports") {
1635 info->has_dumpvars = true;
1636 }
1637 info->max_args = std::max(info->max_args, stmt.task_args.size());
1638 size_t format_arg_start = 0;
1639 if (stmt.task_name == "$fdisplay" || stmt.task_name == "$fwrite") {
1640 format_arg_start = 1;
1641 } else if (stmt.task_name == "$sformat") {
1642 format_arg_start = 1;
1643 }
1644 std::vector<char> format_specs;
1645 bool has_format_specs =
1646 stmt.task_args.size() > format_arg_start &&
1647 stmt.task_args[format_arg_start] &&
1648 stmt.task_args[format_arg_start]->kind == gpga::ExprKind::kString;
1649 if (has_format_specs) {
1650 format_specs =
1651 ExtractFormatSpecs(stmt.task_args[format_arg_start]->string_value);
1652 }
1653 size_t format_arg_index = 0;
1654 if (stmt.task_name == "$sformat" && !stmt.task_args.empty() &&
1655 stmt.task_args[0] &&
1656 stmt.task_args[0]->kind == gpga::ExprKind::kIdentifier) {
1657 AddString(info, stmt.task_args[0]->ident);
1658 }
1659 bool treat_ident = IdentAsString(stmt.task_name);
1660 for (size_t i = 0; i < stmt.task_args.size(); ++i) {
1661 const auto& arg = stmt.task_args[i];
1662 if (!arg) {
1663 continue;
1664 }
1665 bool is_format_literal = has_format_specs && i == format_arg_start &&
1666 arg->kind == gpga::ExprKind::kString;
1667 if (arg->kind == gpga::ExprKind::kString) {
1668 AddString(info, arg->string_value);
1669 } else if (treat_ident && arg->kind == gpga::ExprKind::kIdentifier) {
1670 AddString(info, arg->ident);
1671 } else if (has_format_specs && !is_format_literal &&
1672 format_arg_index < format_specs.size() &&
1673 format_specs[format_arg_index] == 's' &&
1674 arg->kind == gpga::ExprKind::kIdentifier) {
1675 AddString(info, arg->ident);
1676 } else if (has_format_specs && !is_format_literal &&
1677 format_arg_index < format_specs.size() &&
1678 format_specs[format_arg_index] == 's') {
1679 CollectStringLiterals(*arg, info);
1680 }
1681 if (has_format_specs && !is_format_literal) {
1682 ++format_arg_index;
1683 }
1684 }
1685 }
1686 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kIf) {
1687 for (const auto& inner : stmt.then_branch) {
1688 CollectTasks(inner, info);
1689 }
1690 for (const auto& inner : stmt.else_branch) {
1691 CollectTasks(inner, info);
1692 }
1693 return;
1694 }
1695 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kBlock) {
1696 for (const auto& inner : stmt.block) {
1697 CollectTasks(inner, info);
1698 }
1699 return;
1700 }
1701 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kCase) {
1702 for (const auto& item : stmt.case_items) {
1703 for (const auto& inner : item.body) {
1704 CollectTasks(inner, info);
1705 }
1706 }
1707 for (const auto& inner : stmt.default_branch) {
1708 CollectTasks(inner, info);
1709 }
1710 return;
1711 }
1712 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kFor) {
1713 for (const auto& inner : stmt.for_body) {
1714 CollectTasks(inner, info);
1715 }
1716 return;
1717 }
1718 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kWhile) {
1719 for (const auto& inner : stmt.while_body) {
1720 CollectTasks(inner, info);
1721 }
1722 return;
1723 }
1724 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kRepeat) {
1725 for (const auto& inner : stmt.repeat_body) {
1726 CollectTasks(inner, info);
1727 }
1728 return;
1729 }
1730 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kDelay) {
1731 for (const auto& inner : stmt.delay_body) {
1732 CollectTasks(inner, info);
1733 }
1734 return;
1735 }
1736 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kEventControl) {
1737 for (const auto& inner : stmt.event_body) {
1738 CollectTasks(inner, info);
1739 }
1740 return;
1741 }
1742 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kWait) {
1743 for (const auto& inner : stmt.wait_body) {
1744 CollectTasks(inner, info);
1745 }
1746 return;
1747 }
1748 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kForever) {
1749 for (const auto& inner : stmt.forever_body) {
1750 CollectTasks(inner, info);
1751 }
1752 return;
1753 }
1754 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kFork) {
1755 for (const auto& inner : stmt.fork_branches) {
1756 CollectTasks(inner, info);
1757 }
1758 }
1759}
1760
1761gpga::ServiceStringTable BuildStringTable(const gpga::Module& module) {
1762 SysTaskInfo info;
1763 for (const auto& block : module.always_blocks) {
1764 for (const auto& stmt : block.statements) {
1765 CollectTasks(stmt, &info);
1766 CollectSystemFunctionInfo(stmt, &info);
1767 }
1768 }
1769 for (const auto& task : module.tasks) {
1770 for (const auto& stmt : task.body) {
1771 CollectTasks(stmt, &info);
1772 CollectSystemFunctionInfo(stmt, &info);
1773 }
1774 }
1775 gpga::ServiceStringTable table;
1776 table.entries = std::move(info.string_table);
1777 return table;
1778}
1779
1780bool ModuleUsesDumpvars(const gpga::Module& module) {
1781 SysTaskInfo info;
1782 for (const auto& block : module.always_blocks) {
1783 for (const auto& stmt : block.statements) {
1784 CollectTasks(stmt, &info);
1785 }
1786 }
1787 for (const auto& task : module.tasks) {
1788 for (const auto& stmt : task.body) {
1789 CollectTasks(stmt, &info);
1790 }
1791 }
1792 return info.has_dumpvars;
1793}
1794
1795gpga::ModuleInfo BuildModuleInfo(
1796 const gpga::Module& module,
1797 bool four_state,
1798 const std::vector<std::string>* extra_signals) {
1799 gpga::ModuleInfo info;
1800 info.name = module.name;
1801 info.four_state = four_state;
1802 std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::SignalInfo> signals;
1803 for (const auto& port : module.ports) {
1804 gpga::SignalInfo sig;
1805 sig.name = port.name;
1806 sig.width = port.width;
1807 sig.is_real = port.is_real;
1808 signals[port.name] = sig;
1809 }
1810 for (const auto& net : module.nets) {
1811 auto it = signals.find(net.name);
1812 if (it == signals.end()) {
1813 gpga::SignalInfo sig;
1814 sig.name = net.name;
1815 sig.width = net.width;
1816 sig.array_size = net.array_size;
1817 sig.is_real = net.is_real;
1818 sig.is_trireg = net.type == gpga::NetType::kTrireg;
1819 signals[net.name] = sig;
1820 } else {
1821 it->second.width = std::max(it->second.width,
1822 static_cast<uint32_t>(net.width));
1823 if (net.array_size > 0) {
1824 it->second.array_size = net.array_size;
1825 }
1826 if (net.is_real) {
1827 it->second.is_real = true;
1828 }
1829 if (net.type == gpga::NetType::kTrireg) {
1830 it->second.is_trireg = true;
1831 }
1832 }
1833 }
1834 if (extra_signals) {
1835 for (const auto& name : *extra_signals) {
1836 if (name.empty() || signals.count(name) > 0) {
1837 continue;
1838 }
1839 gpga::SignalInfo sig;
1840 sig.name = name;
1841 sig.width = 32u;
1842 signals[name] = sig;
1843 }
1844 }
1845 info.signals.reserve(signals.size());
1846 for (auto& entry : signals) {
1847 info.signals.push_back(std::move(entry.second));
1848 }
1849 return info;
1850}

1906
1907bool InitSchedulerVmBuffers(
1908 std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>* buffers,
1909 const gpga::SchedulerConstants& sched, uint32_t instance_count,
1910 const gpga::SchedulerVmLayout* layout, std::string* error) {
1911 if (!sched.vm_enabled) {
1912 return true;
1913 }
1914 if (!buffers) {
1915 if (error) {
1916 *error = "missing scheduler buffers for VM initialization";
1917 }
1918 return false;
1919 }
1920 constexpr uint32_t kMinWordsPerProc = gpga::kSchedulerVmWordsPerProc;
1921 const uint32_t proc_count = sched.proc_count;
1922 const uint32_t vm_words =
1923 layout ? static_cast<uint32_t>(layout->bytecode.size())
1924 : sched.vm_bytecode_words;
1925 const uint32_t layout_proc_count = layout ? layout->proc_count : proc_count;
1926 const uint32_t layout_words_per_proc =
1927 layout ? layout->words_per_proc : 0u;
1928 if (proc_count > 0u && vm_words == 0u) {
1929 if (error) {
1930 *error = "scheduler VM enabled without bytecode sizing";
1931 }
1932 return false;
1933 }
1934 if (sched.vm_cond_count == 0u) {
1935 if (error) {
1936 *error = "scheduler VM enabled without cond sizing";
1937 }
1938 return false;
1939 }
1940 if (layout && layout_proc_count != proc_count) {
1941 if (error) {
1942 *error = "scheduler VM layout proc count mismatch";
1943 }
1944 return false;
1945 }
1946 uint32_t words_per_proc = 0u;
1947 if (proc_count > 0u) {
1948 if (vm_words < proc_count * kMinWordsPerProc) {
1949 if (error) {
1950 *error = "scheduler VM bytecode buffer too small for proc count";
1951 }
1952 return false;
1953 }
1954 if (vm_words % proc_count != 0u) {
1955 if (error) {
1956 *error = "scheduler VM bytecode words not divisible by proc count";
1957 }
1958 return false;
1959 }
1960 words_per_proc = vm_words / proc_count;
1961 if (words_per_proc < kMinWordsPerProc) {
1962 if (error) {
1963 *error = "scheduler VM words per proc below minimum";
1964 }
1965 return false;
1966 }
1967 if (layout && layout_words_per_proc != 0u &&
1968 layout_words_per_proc != words_per_proc) {
1969 if (error) {
1970 *error = "scheduler VM layout words-per-proc mismatch";
1971 }
1972 return false;
1973 }
1974 }
1975 auto* bytecode_buf = FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_bytecode", "");
1976 auto* offset_buf =
1977 FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_proc_bytecode_offset", "");
1978 auto* length_buf =
1979 FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_proc_bytecode_length", "");
1980 auto* cond_val_buf = FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_cond_val", "");
1981 auto* cond_xz_buf = FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_cond_xz", "");
1982 auto* cond_entry_buf =
1983 FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_cond_entry", "");
1984 auto* signal_entry_buf =
1985 FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_signal_entry", "");
1986 auto* ip_buf = FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_ip", "");
1987 auto* call_sp_buf = FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_call_sp", "");
1988 auto* call_frame_buf = FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_call_frame", "");
1989 auto* case_header_buf =
1990 FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_case_header", "");
1991 auto* case_entry_buf =
1992 FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_case_entry", "");
1993 auto* case_words_buf =
1994 FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_case_words", "");
1995 auto* expr_buf = FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_expr", "");
1996 auto* expr_imm_buf = FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_expr_imm", "");
1997 auto* assign_entry_buf =
1998 FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_assign_entry", "");
1999 auto* delay_assign_buf =
2000 FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_delay_assign_entry", "");
2001 auto* force_entry_buf =
2002 FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_force_entry", "");
2003 auto* release_entry_buf =
2004 FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_release_entry", "");
2005 auto* service_entry_buf =
2006 FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_service_entry", "");
2007 auto* service_arg_buf =
2008 FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_service_arg", "");
2009 auto* service_ret_assign_buf =
2010 FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_service_ret_assign_entry", "");
2011 if (!bytecode_buf || !offset_buf || !length_buf || !cond_val_buf ||
2012 !cond_xz_buf || !cond_entry_buf || !signal_entry_buf || !ip_buf ||
2013 !call_sp_buf || !call_frame_buf || !case_header_buf ||
2014 !case_entry_buf || !case_words_buf || !expr_buf || !expr_imm_buf ||
2015 !assign_entry_buf || !delay_assign_buf || !force_entry_buf ||
2016 !release_entry_buf || !service_entry_buf || !service_arg_buf ||
2017 !service_ret_assign_buf) {
2018 if (error) {
2019 *error = "missing scheduler VM buffers";
2020 }
2021 return false;
2022 }
2023 auto* debug_buf = FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_vm_debug", "");
2024 if (!bytecode_buf->contents() || !offset_buf->contents() ||
2025 !length_buf->contents() || !cond_val_buf->contents() ||
2026 !cond_xz_buf->contents() || !cond_entry_buf->contents() ||
2027 !signal_entry_buf->contents() || !ip_buf->contents() ||
2028 !call_sp_buf->contents() || !call_frame_buf->contents() ||
2029 !case_header_buf->contents() || !case_entry_buf->contents() ||
2030 !case_words_buf->contents() || !expr_buf->contents() ||
2031 !expr_imm_buf->contents() || !assign_entry_buf->contents() ||
2032 !delay_assign_buf->contents() || !force_entry_buf->contents() ||
2033 !release_entry_buf->contents() || !service_entry_buf->contents() ||
2034 !service_arg_buf->contents() || !service_ret_assign_buf->contents()) {
2035 if (error) {
2036 *error = "scheduler VM buffers are not CPU-visible";
2037 }
2038 return false;
2039 }
2040 const size_t bytecode_words_needed =
2041 static_cast<size_t>(instance_count) * vm_words;
2042 if (bytecode_buf->length() < bytecode_words_needed * sizeof(uint32_t)) {
2043 if (error) {
2044 *error = "scheduler VM bytecode buffer length mismatch";
2045 }
2046 return false;
2047 }
2048 const size_t proc_entries =
2049 static_cast<size_t>(instance_count) * proc_count;
2050 if (offset_buf->length() < proc_entries * sizeof(uint32_t) ||
2051 length_buf->length() < proc_entries * sizeof(uint32_t) ||
2052 cond_val_buf->length() <
2053 proc_entries * sched.vm_cond_count * sizeof(uint32_t) ||
2054 cond_xz_buf->length() <
2055 proc_entries * sched.vm_cond_count * sizeof(uint32_t) ||
2056 ip_buf->length() < proc_entries * sizeof(uint32_t) ||
2057 call_sp_buf->length() < proc_entries * sizeof(uint32_t)) {
2058 if (error) {
2059 *error = "scheduler VM proc buffer length mismatch";
2060 }
2061 return false;
2062 }
2063 const size_t case_header_count =
2064 layout ? layout->case_headers.size()
2065 : static_cast<size_t>(sched.vm_case_header_count);
2066 const size_t case_entry_count =
2067 layout ? layout->case_entries.size()
2068 : static_cast<size_t>(sched.vm_case_entry_count);
2069 const size_t case_word_count =
2070 layout ? layout->case_words.size()
2071 : static_cast<size_t>(sched.vm_case_word_count);
2072 const size_t cond_entry_count =
2073 layout ? layout->cond_entries.size()
2074 : static_cast<size_t>(sched.vm_cond_count);
2075 const size_t signal_entry_count =
2076 layout ? layout->signal_entries.size()
2077 : static_cast<size_t>(sched.vm_signal_count);
2078 const size_t expr_word_count =
2079 layout ? layout->expr_table.words.size()
2080 : static_cast<size_t>(sched.vm_expr_word_count);
2081 const size_t expr_imm_word_count =
2082 layout ? layout->expr_table.imm_words.size()
2083 : static_cast<size_t>(sched.vm_expr_imm_word_count);
2084 const size_t assign_entry_count =
2085 layout ? layout->assign_entries.size()
2086 : static_cast<size_t>(sched.vm_assign_count);
2087 const size_t delay_assign_entry_count =
2088 layout ? layout->delay_assign_entries.size()
2089 : static_cast<size_t>(sched.delay_count);
2090 const size_t force_entry_count =
2091 layout ? layout->force_entries.size()
2092 : static_cast<size_t>(sched.vm_force_count);
2093 const size_t release_entry_count =
2094 layout ? layout->release_entries.size()
2095 : static_cast<size_t>(sched.vm_release_count);
2096 const size_t service_entry_count =
2097 layout ? layout->service_entries.size()
2098 : static_cast<size_t>(sched.vm_service_call_count);
2099 const size_t service_arg_count =
2100 layout ? layout->service_args.size()
2101 : static_cast<size_t>(sched.vm_service_arg_count);
2102 const size_t service_ret_entry_count =
2103 layout ? layout->service_ret_entries.size()
2104 : static_cast<size_t>(sched.vm_service_assign_count);
2105 if (case_header_count > 0u &&
2106 case_header_buf->length() <
2107 case_header_count * sizeof(GpgaSchedVmCaseHeader)) {
2108 if (error) {

2477uint32_t SignalBitWidth(const gpga::SignalInfo& sig) {
2478 uint32_t width = sig.is_real ? 64u : sig.width;
2479 return width == 0u ? 1u : width;
2480}
2481
2482size_t SignalWordSize(const gpga::SignalInfo& sig) {
2483 return (SignalBitWidth(sig) > 32u) ? sizeof(uint64_t) : sizeof(uint32_t);
2484}
2485
2486size_t SignalWordCount(const gpga::SignalInfo& sig) {
2487 uint32_t width = SignalBitWidth(sig);
2488 if (width <= 64u) {
2489 return 1u;
2490 }
2491 return (width + 63u) / 64u;
2492}
2493
2494size_t SignalElementSize(const gpga::SignalInfo& sig) {
2495 return SignalWordSize(sig) * SignalWordCount(sig);
2496}
2497
2498size_t SignalElementCount(const gpga::SignalInfo& sig,
2499 const gpga::MetalBuffer& buffer) {
2500 size_t word_size = SignalWordSize(sig);
2501 size_t word_count = SignalWordCount(sig);
2502 size_t stride = word_size * word_count;
2503 if (stride == 0) {
2504 return 0;
2505 }
2506 return buffer.length() / stride;
2507}
2508
2509bool ReadSignalWordFromBuffer(const gpga::SignalInfo& sig, uint32_t gid,
2510 uint64_t array_index,
2511 const gpga::MetalBuffer& buffer,
2512 size_t word_index, uint64_t* value_out) {
2513 if (!value_out || !buffer.contents()) {
2514 return false;
2515 }
2516 size_t word_count = SignalWordCount(sig);
2517 if (word_index >= word_count) {
2518 return false;
2519 }
2520 size_t array_size = sig.array_size > 0 ? sig.array_size : 1u;
2521 if (array_index >= array_size) {
2522 return false;
2523 }
2524 size_t element_count = SignalElementCount(sig, buffer);
2525 if (element_count == 0) {
2526 return false;
2527 }
2528 size_t element_index =
2529 static_cast<size_t>(gid) * array_size + static_cast<size_t>(array_index);
2530 if (element_index >= element_count) {
2531 return false;
2532 }
2533 size_t word_size = SignalWordSize(sig);
2534 size_t offset = (element_index * word_count + word_index) * word_size;
2535 if (buffer.length() < offset + word_size) {
2536 return false;
2537 }
2538 uint64_t value = 0;
2539 if (word_size == sizeof(uint64_t)) {
2540 std::memcpy(&value, static_cast<const uint8_t*>(buffer.contents()) + offset,
2541 sizeof(uint64_t));
2542 } else {
2543 uint32_t tmp = 0;
2544 std::memcpy(&tmp, static_cast<const uint8_t*>(buffer.contents()) + offset,
2545 sizeof(uint32_t));
2546 value = tmp;
2547 }
2548 *value_out = value;
2549 return true;
2550}
2551
2552bool ReadPackedSignalWordFromBuffer(const gpga::SignalInfo& sig, uint32_t gid,
2553 uint64_t array_index,
2554 const gpga::MetalBuffer& buffer,
2555 size_t base_offset, size_t word_index,
2556 uint64_t* value_out) {
2557 if (!value_out || !buffer.contents()) {
2558 return false;
2559 }
2560 size_t word_count = SignalWordCount(sig);
2561 if (word_index >= word_count) {
2562 return false;
2563 }
2564 size_t array_size = sig.array_size > 0 ? sig.array_size : 1u;
2565 if (array_index >= array_size) {
2566 return false;
2567 }
2568 size_t word_size = SignalWordSize(sig);
2569 size_t element_size = SignalElementSize(sig);
2570 size_t element_index =
2571 static_cast<size_t>(gid) * array_size + static_cast<size_t>(array_index);
2572 size_t offset =
2573 base_offset + (element_index * element_size) + (word_index * word_size);
2574 if (buffer.length() < offset + word_size) {
2575 return false;
2576 }
2577 uint64_t value = 0;
2578 if (word_size == sizeof(uint64_t)) {
2579 std::memcpy(&value, static_cast<const uint8_t*>(buffer.contents()) + offset,
2580 sizeof(uint64_t));
2581 } else {
2582 uint32_t tmp = 0;
2583 std::memcpy(&tmp, static_cast<const uint8_t*>(buffer.contents()) + offset,
2584 sizeof(uint32_t));
2585 value = tmp;
2586 }
2587 *value_out = value;
2588 return true;
2589}
2590
2591bool WritePackedSignalWordToBuffer(const gpga::SignalInfo& sig, uint32_t gid,
2592 uint64_t array_index,
2593 gpga::MetalBuffer* buffer,
2594 size_t base_offset, size_t word_index,
2595 uint64_t value) {
2596 if (!buffer || !buffer->contents()) {
2597 return false;
2598 }
2599 size_t word_count = SignalWordCount(sig);
2600 if (word_index >= word_count) {
2601 return false;
2602 }
2603 size_t array_size = sig.array_size > 0 ? sig.array_size : 1u;
2604 if (array_index >= array_size) {
2605 return false;
2606 }
2607 size_t word_size = SignalWordSize(sig);
2608 size_t element_size = SignalElementSize(sig);
2609 size_t element_index =
2610 static_cast<size_t>(gid) * array_size + static_cast<size_t>(array_index);
2611 size_t offset =
2612 base_offset + (element_index * element_size) + (word_index * word_size);
2613 if (buffer->length() < offset + word_size) {
2614 return false;
2615 }
2616 if (word_size == sizeof(uint64_t)) {
2617 std::memcpy(static_cast<uint8_t*>(buffer->contents()) + offset, &value,
2618 sizeof(uint64_t));
2619 } else {
2620 uint32_t tmp = static_cast<uint32_t>(value);
2621 std::memcpy(static_cast<uint8_t*>(buffer->contents()) + offset, &tmp,
2622 sizeof(uint32_t));
2623 }
2624 return true;
2625}
2626
2627bool ReadSignalWord(const gpga::SignalInfo& sig, uint32_t gid,
2628 uint64_t array_index,
2629 const std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>& buffers,
2630 size_t word_index, uint64_t* value_out) {
2631 const gpga::MetalBuffer* val_buf =
2632 FindBuffer(buffers, MslSignalName(sig.name), "_val");
2633 if (!val_buf) {
2634 return false;
2635 }
2636 return ReadSignalWordFromBuffer(sig, gid, array_index, *val_buf, word_index,
2637 value_out);
2638}
2639
2640bool WriteSignalWord(const gpga::SignalInfo& sig, uint32_t gid,
2641 uint64_t array_index, size_t word_index, uint64_t value,
2642 uint64_t xz, bool four_state,
2643 std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>* buffers) {
2644 gpga::MetalBuffer* val_buf =
2645 FindBufferMutable(buffers, MslSignalName(sig.name), "_val");
2646 if (!val_buf || !val_buf->contents()) {
2647 return false;
2648 }
2649 gpga::MetalBuffer* xz_buf = nullptr;
2650 if (four_state) {
2651 xz_buf = FindBufferMutable(buffers, MslSignalName(sig.name), "_xz");
2652 }
2653 size_t word_count = SignalWordCount(sig);
2654 if (word_index >= word_count) {
2655 return false;
2656 }
2657 size_t array_size = sig.array_size > 0 ? sig.array_size : 1u;
2658 if (array_index >= array_size) {
2659 return false;
2660 }
2661 size_t element_count = SignalElementCount(sig, *val_buf);
2662 if (element_count == 0) {
2663 return false;
2664 }
2665 size_t element_index =
2666 static_cast<size_t>(gid) * array_size + static_cast<size_t>(array_index);
2667 if (element_index >= element_count) {
2668 return false;
2669 }
2670 size_t word_size = SignalWordSize(sig);
2671 size_t offset = (element_index * word_count + word_index) * word_size;
2672 if (val_buf->length() < offset + word_size) {
2673 return false;
2674 }
2675 if (word_size == sizeof(uint64_t)) {
2676 std::memcpy(static_cast<uint8_t*>(val_buf->contents()) + offset, &value,
2677 sizeof(uint64_t));
2678 if (four_state && xz_buf && xz_buf->contents() &&
2679 xz_buf->length() >= offset + word_size) {
2680 std::memcpy(static_cast<uint8_t*>(xz_buf->contents()) + offset, &xz,
2681 sizeof(uint64_t));
2682 }
2683 } else {
2684 uint32_t tmp = static_cast<uint32_t>(value);
2685 std::memcpy(static_cast<uint8_t*>(val_buf->contents()) + offset, &tmp,
2686 sizeof(uint32_t));
2687 if (four_state && xz_buf && xz_buf->contents() &&
2688 xz_buf->length() >= offset + word_size) {
2689 uint32_t tmp_xz = static_cast<uint32_t>(xz);
2690 std::memcpy(static_cast<uint8_t*>(xz_buf->contents()) + offset, &tmp_xz,
2691 sizeof(uint32_t));
2692 }
2693 }
2694 return true;
2695}

2734uint64_t PackStringBits(const std::string& value, size_t max_bytes) {
2735 uint64_t bits = 0;
2736 size_t count = std::min(max_bytes, sizeof(uint64_t));
2737 if (value.size() < count) {
2738 count = value.size();
2739 }
2740 size_t start = value.size() > count ? (value.size() - count) : 0;
2741 for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
2742 size_t pos = count - 1u - i;
2743 bits |= (static_cast<uint64_t>(
2744 static_cast<unsigned char>(value[start + i])) << (8u * pos));
2745 }
2746 return bits;
2747}
2748
2749std::string UnpackStringBits(uint64_t bits, size_t max_bytes) {
2750 std::string out;
2751 out.reserve(max_bytes);
2752 size_t start = 0;
2753 for (; start < max_bytes; ++start) {
2754 size_t pos = max_bytes - 1u - start;
2755 char c = static_cast<char>((bits >> (8u * pos)) & 0xFFu);
2756 if (c != '\0') {
2757 break;
2758 }
2759 }
2760 for (size_t i = start; i < max_bytes; ++i) {
2761 size_t pos = max_bytes - 1u - i;
2762 char c = static_cast<char>((bits >> (8u * pos)) & 0xFFu);
2763 if (c == '\0') {
2764 break;
2765 }
2766 out.push_back(c);
2767 }
2768 return out;
2769}
2770
2771std::vector<uint64_t> PackStringWords(const std::string& value,
2772 size_t max_bytes) {
2773 size_t word_count = std::max<size_t>(1u, (max_bytes + 7u) / 8u);
2774 size_t byte_count = word_count * 8u;
2775 std::vector<uint8_t> bytes(byte_count, 0u);
2776 size_t usable_start = byte_count > max_bytes ? byte_count - max_bytes : 0u;
2777 size_t count = std::min(value.size(), max_bytes);
2778 size_t src_start = value.size() > count ? (value.size() - count) : 0u;
2779 size_t dest_start = usable_start + (max_bytes - count);
2780 for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
2781 bytes[dest_start + i] =
2782 static_cast<uint8_t>(value[src_start + i]);
2783 }
2784 std::vector<uint64_t> words(word_count, 0ull);
2785 for (size_t word_index = 0; word_index < word_count; ++word_index) {
2786 size_t byte_base = byte_count - (word_index + 1u) * 8u;
2787 uint64_t word = 0;
2788 for (size_t b = 0; b < 8u; ++b) {
2789 word |=
2790 static_cast<uint64_t>(bytes[byte_base + b]) << (8u * (7u - b));
2791 }
2792 words[word_index] = word;
2793 }
2794 return words;
2795}
2796
2797std::string UnpackStringWords(const std::vector<uint64_t>& words,
2798 size_t max_bytes) {
2799 if (words.empty() || max_bytes == 0u) {
2800 return {};
2801 }
2802 size_t word_count = words.size();
2803 size_t byte_count = word_count * 8u;
2804 std::vector<uint8_t> bytes(byte_count, 0u);
2805 for (size_t word_index = 0; word_index < word_count; ++word_index) {
2806 size_t byte_base = byte_count - (word_index + 1u) * 8u;
2807 uint64_t word = words[word_index];
2808 for (size_t b = 0; b < 8u; ++b) {
2809 bytes[byte_base + b] =
2810 static_cast<uint8_t>((word >> (8u * (7u - b))) & 0xFFu);
2811 }
2812 }
2813 size_t usable_start = byte_count > max_bytes ? byte_count - max_bytes : 0u;
2814 size_t start = usable_start;
2815 for (; start < byte_count; ++start) {
2816 if (bytes[start] != 0u) {
2817 break;
2818 }
2819 }
2820 std::string out;
2821 out.reserve(byte_count - start);
2822 for (size_t i = start; i < byte_count; ++i) {
2823 if (bytes[i] == 0u) {
2824 break;
2825 }
2826 out.push_back(static_cast<char>(bytes[i]));
2827 }
2828 return out;
2829}

2831std::string ReadSignalString(const gpga::SignalInfo& sig, uint32_t gid,
2832 const std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>& buffers) {
2833 size_t max_bytes = (SignalBitWidth(sig) + 7u) / 8u;
2834 size_t word_count = SignalWordCount(sig);
2835 std::vector<uint64_t> words(word_count, 0ull);
2836 for (size_t i = 0; i < word_count; ++i) {
2837 if (!ReadSignalWord(sig, gid, 0u, buffers, i, &words[i])) {
2838 return {};
2839 }
2840 }
2841 return UnpackStringWords(words, max_bytes);
2842}

2844struct FormatSpec {
2845 char spec = 0;
2846 bool suppress = false;
2847};
2848
2849std::vector<FormatSpec> ParseFormatSpecs(const std::string& format) {
2850 std::vector<FormatSpec> specs;
2851 for (size_t i = 0; i < format.size(); ++i) {
2852 if (format[i] != '%') {
2853 continue;
2854 }
2855 if (i + 1 < format.size() && format[i + 1] == '%') {
2856 ++i;
2857 continue;
2858 }
2859 bool suppress = false;
2860 size_t j = i + 1;
2861 while (j < format.size()) {
2862 char c = format[j];
2863 if (c == '*') {
2864 suppress = true;
2865 ++j;
2866 continue;
2867 }
2868 if (std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)) || c == '-' || c == '+' ||
2869 c == '#' || c == '.') {
2870 ++j;
2871 continue;
2872 }
2873 FormatSpec spec;
2874 spec.spec =
2875 static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
2876 spec.suppress = suppress;
2877 specs.push_back(spec);
2878 i = j;
2879 break;
2880 }
2881 }
2882 return specs;
2883}

2885bool ReadTokenFromFile(std::FILE* file, std::string* token, bool* saw_eof) {

2890 return false;
2891 }
2892 token->clear();
2893 int c = 0;
2894 do {
2895 c = std::fgetc(file);
2896 if (c == EOF) {
2897 if (saw_eof) {
2898 *saw_eof = true;
2899 }
2900 return false;
2901 }
2902 } while (std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(c)));
2903 while (c != EOF && !std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(c))) {
2904 token->push_back(static_cast<char>(c));
2905 c = std::fgetc(file);
2906 }
2907 return !token->empty();
2908}

2955bool ParseTokenValue(const std::string& token, char spec, uint64_t* out_value,
2956 std::string* out_string) {
2957 if (spec == 's') {
2958 if (out_string) {
2959 *out_string = token;
2960 }
2961 if (out_value) {
2962 *out_value = 0;
2963 }
2964 return true;
2965 }
2966 if (spec == 'c') {
2967 if (out_value) {
2968 unsigned char ch =
2969 token.empty() ? 0u : static_cast<unsigned char>(token[0]);
2970 *out_value = static_cast<uint64_t>(ch);
2971 }
2972 return true;
2973 }
2974 if (spec == 'f' || spec == 'e' || spec == 'g') {
2975 char* end = nullptr;
2976 double val = std::strtod(token.c_str(), &end);
2977 if (end == token.c_str()) {
2978 return false;
2979 }
2980 if (out_value) {
2981 uint64_t bits = 0;
2982 std::memcpy(&bits, &val, sizeof(bits));
2983 *out_value = bits;
2984 }
2985 return true;
2986 }
2987 int base = 10;
2988 if (spec == 'h' || spec == 'x') {
2989 base = 16;
2990 } else if (spec == 'o') {
2991 base = 8;
2992 } else if (spec == 'b') {
2993 base = 2;
2994 }
2995 char* end = nullptr;
2996 if (spec == 'd' || spec == 'i') {
2997 int parse_base = (spec == 'i') ? 0 : base;
2998 long long val = std::strtoll(token.c_str(), &end, parse_base);
2999 if (end == token.c_str()) {
3000 return false;
3001 }
3002 if (out_value) {
3003 *out_value = static_cast<uint64_t>(val);
3004 }
3005 return true;
3006 }
3007 unsigned long long val = std::strtoull(token.c_str(), &end, base);
3008 if (end == token.c_str()) {
3009 return false;
3010 }
3011 if (out_value) {
3012 *out_value = static_cast<uint64_t>(val);
3013 }
3014 return true;
3015}
3016
3017bool ParseTokenWords(const std::string& token_in, char spec, uint32_t width,
3018 std::vector<uint64_t>* out_words,
3019 std::string* out_string) {
3020 if (!out_words) {
3021 return false;
3022 }
3023 out_words->clear();
3024 if (spec == 's') {
3025 if (out_string) {
3026 *out_string = token_in;
3027 }
3028 return true;
3029 }
3030 if (width == 0u) {
3031 width = 1u;
3032 }
3033 size_t word_count = (width + 63u) / 64u;
3034 out_words->assign(word_count, 0ull);
3035 if (spec == 'c') {
3036 unsigned char ch =
3037 token_in.empty() ? 0u : static_cast<unsigned char>(token_in[0]);
3038 (*out_words)[0] = static_cast<uint64_t>(ch);
3039 } else if (spec == 'f' || spec == 'e' || spec == 'g') {
3040 char* end = nullptr;
3041 double val = std::strtod(token_in.c_str(), &end);
3042 if (end == token_in.c_str()) {
3043 return false;
3044 }
3045 uint64_t bits = 0;
3046 std::memcpy(&bits, &val, sizeof(bits));
3047 (*out_words)[0] = bits;
3048 } else {
3049 std::string token;
3050 token.reserve(token_in.size());
3051 for (char c : token_in) {
3052 if (c != '_') {
3053 token.push_back(c);
3054 }
3055 }
3056 if (token.empty()) {
3057 return false;
3058 }
3059 bool allow_sign = (spec == 'd' || spec == 'i');
3060 bool negative = false;
3061 if (!token.empty() && (token[0] == '+' || token[0] == '-')) {
3062 if (!allow_sign) {
3063 return false;
3064 }
3065 negative = (token[0] == '-');
3066 token.erase(token.begin());
3067 }
3068 int base = 10;
3069 if (spec == 'h' || spec == 'x') {
3070 base = 16;
3071 } else if (spec == 'o') {
3072 base = 8;
3073 } else if (spec == 'b') {
3074 base = 2;
3075 } else if (spec == 'i') {
3076 if (token.size() >= 2 && token[0] == '0' &&
3077 (token[1] == 'x' || token[1] == 'X')) {
3078 base = 16;
3079 token = token.substr(2);
3080 } else if (token.size() >= 2 && token[0] == '0' &&
3081 (token[1] == 'b' || token[1] == 'B')) {
3082 base = 2;
3083 token = token.substr(2);
3084 } else if (token.size() > 1 && token[0] == '0') {
3085 base = 8;
3086 token = token.substr(1);
3087 }
3088 } else {
3089 if (base == 16 && token.size() >= 2 && token[0] == '0' &&
3090 (token[1] == 'x' || token[1] == 'X')) {
3091 token = token.substr(2);
3092 } else if (base == 2 && token.size() >= 2 && token[0] == '0' &&
3093 (token[1] == 'b' || token[1] == 'B')) {
3094 token = token.substr(2);
3095 }
3096 }
3097 if (token.empty()) {
3098 return false;
3099 }
3100 for (char c : token) {
3101 int digit = -1;
3102 if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
3103 digit = c - '0';
3104 } else if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') {
3105 digit = 10 + (c - 'a');
3106 } else if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') {
3107 digit = 10 + (c - 'A');
3108 }
3109 if (digit < 0 || digit >= base) {
3110 return false;
3111 }
3112 uint64_t carry = static_cast<uint64_t>(digit);
3113 for (size_t i = 0; i < out_words->size(); ++i) {
3114 unsigned __int128 prod =
3115 static_cast<unsigned __int128>((*out_words)[i]) *
3116 static_cast<unsigned __int128>(base) +
3117 carry;
3118 (*out_words)[i] = static_cast<uint64_t>(prod);
3119 carry = static_cast<uint64_t>(prod >> 64);
3120 }
3121 }
3122 if (negative) {
3123 for (auto& word : *out_words) {
3124 word = ~word;
3125 }
3126 uint64_t carry = 1u;
3127 for (size_t i = 0; i < out_words->size(); ++i) {
3128 unsigned __int128 sum =
3129 static_cast<unsigned __int128>((*out_words)[i]) + carry;
3130 (*out_words)[i] = static_cast<uint64_t>(sum);
3131 carry = static_cast<uint64_t>(sum >> 64);
3132 }
3133 }
3134 }
3135 uint32_t tail_bits = width % 64u;
3136 if (tail_bits != 0u) {
3137 uint64_t mask = (1ull << tail_bits) - 1ull;
3138 (*out_words)[out_words->size() - 1u] &= mask;
3139 }
3140 return true;
3141}

3163uint64_t MaskForWidth(uint32_t width) {
3164 if (width >= 64u) {
3165 return 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull;
3166 }
3167 if (width == 0u) {
3168 return 0ull;
3169 }
3170 return (1ull << width) - 1ull;

3173int64_t SignExtend(uint64_t value, uint32_t width) {
3174 if (width == 0u || width >= 64u) {
3175 return static_cast<int64_t>(value);
3176 }
3177 uint64_t mask = MaskForWidth(width);
3178 uint64_t sign_bit = 1ull << (width - 1u);
3179 uint64_t masked = value & mask;
3180 if ((masked & sign_bit) != 0ull) {
3181 return static_cast<int64_t>(masked | ~mask);
3182 }
3183 return static_cast<int64_t>(masked);
3184}

3197std::string TrimString(const std::string& value) {
3198 size_t start = 0;
3199 while (start < value.size() &&
3200 std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(value[start]))) {
3201 ++start;
3202 }
3203 size_t end = value.size();
3204 while (end > start &&
3205 std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(value[end - 1u]))) {
3206 --end;
3207 }
3208 return value.substr(start, end - start);
3209}
3210
3211int ParseTimescaleExponent(const std::string& timescale) {
3212 std::string token = TrimString(timescale);
3213 size_t slash = token.find('/');
3214 if (slash != std::string::npos) {
3215 token = TrimString(token.substr(0, slash));
3216 }
3217 if (token.empty()) {
3218 return -9;
3219 }
3220 size_t pos = 0;
3221 while (pos < token.size() &&
3222 std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(token[pos]))) {
3223 ++pos;
3224 }
3225 int magnitude = 1;
3226 if (pos > 0) {
3227 magnitude = std::atoi(token.substr(0, pos).c_str());
3228 }
3229 std::string unit = TrimString(token.substr(pos));
3230 for (auto& ch : unit) {
3231 ch = static_cast<char>(std::tolower(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch)));
3232 }
3233 int unit_exp = -9;
3234 if (unit == "s") {
3235 unit_exp = 0;
3236 } else if (unit == "ms") {
3237 unit_exp = -3;
3238 } else if (unit == "us") {
3239 unit_exp = -6;
3240 } else if (unit == "ns") {
3241 unit_exp = -9;
3242 } else if (unit == "ps") {
3243 unit_exp = -12;
3244 } else if (unit == "fs") {
3245 unit_exp = -15;
3246 }
3247 int mag_exp = 0;
3248 if (magnitude == 10) {
3249 mag_exp = 1;
3250 } else if (magnitude == 100) {
3251 mag_exp = 2;
3252 }
3253 return unit_exp + mag_exp;
3254}
3255
3256std::string FormatBits(uint64_t value, uint64_t xz, uint32_t width, int base,
3257 bool has_xz) {
3258 if (width == 0u) {
3259 width = 1u;
3260 }
3261 if (width > 64u) {
3262 width = 64u;
3263 }
3264 uint64_t mask = MaskForWidth(width);
3265 value &= mask;
3266 xz &= mask;
3267
3268 int group = 1;
3269 if (base == 16) {
3270 group = 4;
3271 } else if (base == 8) {
3272 group = 3;
3273 }
3274 int digits = static_cast<int>((width + group - 1u) / group);
3275 std::string out;
3276 out.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(digits));
3277 for (int i = digits - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
3278 int shift = i * group;
3279 uint64_t group_mask = ((1ull << group) - 1ull) << shift;
3280 if (has_xz && (xz & group_mask) != 0ull) {
3281 out.push_back('x');
3282 continue;
3283 }
3284 uint64_t digit = (value >> shift) & ((1ull << group) - 1ull);
3285 if (base == 16) {
3286 out.push_back("0123456789abcdef"[digit & 0xF]);
3287 } else if (base == 8) {
3288 out.push_back("01234567"[digit & 0x7]);
3289 } else {
3290 out.push_back((digit & 1ull) ? '1' : '0');
3291 }
3292 }
3293 return out;
3294}
