3304
3305bool WideBit(const std::vector<uint64_t>& words, uint32_t bit) {
3306 size_t word_index = bit / 64u;
3307 if (word_index >= words.size()) {
3308 return false;
3309 }
3310 uint32_t shift = bit % 64u;
3311 return ((words[word_index] >> shift) & 1ull) != 0ull;
3312}
3313
3314std::vector<uint64_t> MaskWideWords(std::vector<uint64_t> words,
3315 uint32_t width) {
3316 if (width == 0u || words.empty()) {
3317 return words;
3318 }
3319 uint32_t word_count = (width + 63u) / 64u;
3320 if (words.size() > word_count) {
3321 words.resize(word_count);
3322 }
3323 uint32_t rem = width % 64u;
3324 if (rem != 0u && !words.empty()) {
3325 uint64_t mask = (1ull << rem) - 1ull;
3326 words.back() &= mask;
3327 }
3328 return words;
3329}
3330
3331std::string FormatWideBits(const std::vector<uint64_t>& value_words,
3332 const std::vector<uint64_t>& xz_words,
3333 uint32_t width, int base, bool has_xz) {
3334 if (width == 0u) {
3335 width = 1u;
3336 }
3337 int group = 1;
3338 if (base == 16) {
3339 group = 4;
3340 } else if (base == 8) {
3341 group = 3;
3342 }
3343 int digits = static_cast<int>((width + group - 1u) / group);
3344 std::string out;
3345 out.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(digits));
3346 for (int i = digits - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
3347 int shift = i * group;
3348 bool group_xz = false;
3349 uint64_t digit = 0;
3350 for (int bit = 0; bit < group; ++bit) {
3351 int bit_index = shift + bit;
3352 if (bit_index >= static_cast<int>(width)) {
3353 continue;
3354 }
3355 if (has_xz && WideBit(xz_words, static_cast<uint32_t>(bit_index))) {
3356 group_xz = true;
3357 }
3358 if (WideBit(value_words, static_cast<uint32_t>(bit_index))) {
3359 digit |= (1ull << bit);
3360 }
3361 }
3362 if (has_xz && group_xz) {
3363 out.push_back('x');
3364 continue;
3365 }
3366 if (base == 16) {
3367 out.push_back("0123456789abcdef"[digit & 0xF]);
3368 } else if (base == 8) {
3369 out.push_back("01234567"[digit & 0x7]);
3370 } else {
3371 out.push_back((digit & 1ull) ? '1' : '0');
3372 }
3373 }
3374 return out;
3375}
3376
3377std::string FormatWideUnsigned(std::vector<uint64_t> words, uint32_t width) {
3378 words = MaskWideWords(std::move(words), width);
3379 while (!words.empty() && words.back() == 0u) {
3380 words.pop_back();
3381 }
3382 if (words.empty()) {
3383 return "0";
3384 }
3385 std::string out;
3386 while (!words.empty()) {
3387 unsigned __int128 rem = 0;
3388 for (size_t i = words.size(); i-- > 0;) {
3389 unsigned __int128 cur = (rem << 64) | words[i];
3390 words[i] = static_cast<uint64_t>(cur / 10u);
3391 rem = cur % 10u;
3392 }
3393 out.push_back(static_cast<char>('0' + static_cast<uint32_t>(rem)));
3394 while (!words.empty() && words.back() == 0u) {
3395 words.pop_back();
3396 }
3397 }
3398 std::reverse(out.begin(), out.end());
3399 return out;
3400}
3401
3402std::string FormatWideSigned(std::vector<uint64_t> words, uint32_t width) {
3403 words = MaskWideWords(std::move(words), width);
3404 if (width == 0u || words.empty()) {
3405 return "0";
3406 }
3407 bool sign = WideBit(words, width - 1u);
3408 if (!sign) {
3409 return FormatWideUnsigned(words, width);
3410 }
3411 for (auto& word : words) {
3412 word = ~word;
3413 }
3414 words = MaskWideWords(std::move(words), width);
3415 uint64_t carry = 1u;
3416 for (auto& word : words) {
3417 uint64_t prev = word;
3418 word += carry;
3419 carry = (word < prev) ? 1u : 0u;
3420 }
3421 return "-" + FormatWideUnsigned(words, width);
3422}
3423
3424std::string ApplyPadding(std::string text, int width, bool zero_pad) {
3425 if (width <= 0 || static_cast<int>(text.size()) >= width) {
3426 return text;
3427 }
3428 char pad_char = zero_pad ? '0' : ' ';
3429 int pad_len = width - static_cast<int>(text.size());
3430 if (zero_pad && !text.empty() && text[0] == '-') {
3431 return "-" + std::string(pad_len, pad_char) + text.substr(1);
3432 }
3433 return std::string(pad_len, pad_char) + text;
3434}
3435
3436std::string FormatNumeric(const gpga::ServiceArgView& arg, char spec,
3437 bool has_xz) {
3438 if (arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kWide && !arg.wide_value.empty()) {
3439 const std::vector<uint64_t>& val = arg.wide_value;
3440 const std::vector<uint64_t>& xz = arg.wide_xz;
3441 if (has_xz && WideHasXz(xz) &&
3442 (spec == 'd' || spec == 'u' || spec == 't')) {
3443 return "x";
3444 }
3445 if (spec == 'b') {
3446 return FormatWideBits(val, xz, arg.width, 2, has_xz);
3447 }
3448 if (spec == 'o') {
3449 return FormatWideBits(val, xz, arg.width, 8, has_xz);
3450 }
3451 if (spec == 'h' || spec == 'x') {
3452 return FormatWideBits(val, xz, arg.width, 16, has_xz);
3453 }
3454 if (spec == 'u' || spec == 't') {
3455 return FormatWideUnsigned(val, arg.width);
3456 }
3457 return FormatWideSigned(val, arg.width);
3458 }
3459 if (has_xz && arg.xz != 0u &&
3460 (spec == 'd' || spec == 'u' || spec == 't')) {
3461 return "x";
3462 }
3463 uint32_t width = arg.width;
3464 if (spec == 'b') {
3465 return FormatBits(arg.value, arg.xz, width, 2, has_xz);
3466 }
3467 if (spec == 'o') {
3468 return FormatBits(arg.value, arg.xz, width, 8, has_xz);
3469 }
3470 if (spec == 'h' || spec == 'x') {
3471 return FormatBits(arg.value, arg.xz, width, 16, has_xz);
3472 }
3473 if (spec == 't') {
3474 if (!g_time_format.active) {
3475 return std::to_string(arg.value);
3476 }
3477 if (has_xz && arg.xz != 0u) {
3478 return "x";
3479 }
3480 double scaled = static_cast<double>(arg.value) *
3481 std::pow(10.0,
3482 static_cast<double>(g_timescale_exp -
3483 g_time_format.units));
3484 std::ostringstream oss;
3485 oss << std::fixed << std::setprecision(g_time_format.precision) << scaled;
3486 std::string text = oss.str();
3487 text = ApplyPadding(text, g_time_format.min_width, false);
3488 return text + g_time_format.suffix;
3489 }
3490 if (spec == 'u') {
3491 uint64_t mask = MaskForWidth(width);
3492 return std::to_string(arg.value & mask);
3493 }
3494int64_t signed_value = SignExtend(arg.value, width);
3495return std::to_string(signed_value);
3496}
3497
3498struct PackedSignalOffsets {
3499 size_t val_offset = 0u;
3500 size_t xz_offset = 0u;
3501 size_t elem_size = 0u;
3502 size_t array_size = 1u;
3503 bool has_val = false;
3504 bool has_xz = false;
3505};
3506
3507struct PackedStateLayout {
3508 std::unordered_map<std::string, PackedSignalOffsets> offsets;
3509
3510 const PackedSignalOffsets* Find(const std::string& name) const {
3511 auto it = offsets.find(name);
3512 if (it == offsets.end()) {
3513 return nullptr;
3514 }
3515 return &it->second;
3516 }
3517};
3518
3519size_t Align8(size_t value) {
3520 return (value + 7u) & ~static_cast<size_t>(7u);
3521}
3522
3523PackedStateLayout BuildPackedStateLayout(const gpga::Module& module,
3524 const gpga::ModuleInfo& info,
3525 bool four_state,
3526 uint32_t count,
3527 const std::vector<std::string>* extra_signals) {
3528 PackedStateLayout layout;
3529 std::unordered_set<std::string> scheduled_reads;
3530 for (const auto& block : module.always_blocks) {
3531 if (block.edge == gpga::EdgeKind::kCombinational) {
3532 continue;
3533 }
3534 if (block.edge == gpga::EdgeKind::kPosedge ||
3535 block.edge == gpga::EdgeKind::kNegedge) {
3536 if (!block.clock.empty()) {
3537 scheduled_reads.insert(block.clock);
3538 }
3539 }
3540 for (const auto& stmt : block.statements) {
3541 CollectReadSignals(stmt, &scheduled_reads);
3542 }
3543 }
3544 std::unordered_set<std::string> port_names;
3545 port_names.reserve(module.ports.size());
3546 for (const auto& port : module.ports) {
3547 port_names.insert(port.name);
3548 }
3549 std::vector<std::string> reg_names;
3550 for (const auto& net : module.nets) {
3551 if (net.array_size > 0) {
3552 continue;
3553 }
3554 if (port_names.count(net.name) > 0 || net.type == gpga::NetType::kTrireg) {
3555 continue;
3556 }
3557 if (net.type == gpga::NetType::kReg ||
3558 scheduled_reads.count(net.name) > 0) {
3559 reg_names.push_back(net.name);
3560 }
3561 }
3562 std::unordered_set<std::string> reg_name_set(reg_names.begin(),
3563 reg_names.end());
3564 auto is_array_or_trireg = [&](const std::string& name) -> bool {
3565 for (const auto& net : module.nets) {
3566 if (net.name == name) {
3567 return net.array_size > 0 || net.type == gpga::NetType::kTrireg;
3568 }
3569 }
3570 return false;
3571 };
3572 if (extra_signals) {
3573 for (const auto& name : *extra_signals) {
3574 if (name.empty() || port_names.count(name) > 0 ||
3575 reg_name_set.count(name) > 0 ||
3576 is_array_or_trireg(name)) {
3577 continue;
3578 }
3579 reg_names.push_back(name);
3580 reg_name_set.insert(name);
3581 }
3582 }
3583 std::vector<const gpga::Net*> trireg_nets;
3584 for (const auto& net : module.nets) {
3585 if (net.array_size > 0) {
3586 continue;
3587 }
3588 if (net.type == gpga::NetType::kTrireg &&
3589 !IsOutputPort(module, net.name)) {
3590 trireg_nets.push_back(&net);
3591 }
3592 }
3593 std::vector<const gpga::Net*> array_nets;
3594 for (const auto& net : module.nets) {
3595 if (net.array_size > 0) {
3596 array_nets.push_back(&net);
3597 }
3598 }
3599 size_t offset = 0;
3600 auto add_segment = [&](const std::string& base_name, bool is_xz) {
3601 const gpga::SignalInfo* sig = FindSignalInfo(info, base_name);
3602 if (!sig) {
3603 return;
3604 }
3605 size_t array_size = sig->array_size > 0 ? sig->array_size : 1u;
3606 size_t elem_size = SignalElementSize(*sig);
3607 offset = Align8(offset);
3608 PackedSignalOffsets& entry = layout.offsets[base_name];
3609 entry.elem_size = elem_size;
3610 entry.array_size = array_size;
3611 if (is_xz) {
3612 entry.has_xz = true;
3613 entry.xz_offset = offset;
3614 } else {
3615 entry.has_val = true;
3616 entry.val_offset = offset;
3617 }
3618 offset += static_cast<size_t>(count) * array_size * elem_size;
3619 };
3620 auto add_decay = [&]() {
3621 offset = Align8(offset);
3622 offset += static_cast<size_t>(count) * sizeof(uint64_t);
3623 };
3624 for (const auto& port : module.ports) {
3625 add_segment(port.name, false);
3626 if (four_state) {
3627 add_segment(port.name, true);
3628 }
3629 }
3630 for (const auto& reg : reg_names) {
3631 add_segment(reg, false);
3632 if (four_state) {
3633 add_segment(reg, true);
3634 }
3635 }
3636 for (const auto* reg : trireg_nets) {
3637 add_segment(reg->name, false);
3638 if (four_state) {
3639 add_segment(reg->name, true);
3640 }
3641 add_decay();
3642 }
3643 for (const auto* net : array_nets) {
3644 add_segment(net->name, false);
3645 if (four_state) {
3646 add_segment(net->name, true);
3647 }
3648 }
3649 return layout;
3650}
3651
3652std::string FormatReal(const gpga::ServiceArgView& arg, char spec,
3653 int precision, bool has_xz) {
3654 if (has_xz && arg.xz != 0u) {
3655 return "x";
3656 }
3657 double value = 0.0;
3658 if (arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kReal) {
3659 uint64_t bits = arg.value;
3660 std::memcpy(&value, &bits, sizeof(value));
3661 } else {
3662 int64_t signed_value = SignExtend(arg.value, arg.width);
3663 value = static_cast<double>(signed_value);
3664 }
3665 std::ostringstream oss;
3666 if (spec == 'f') {
3667 oss << std::fixed;
3668 } else if (spec == 'e') {
3669 oss << std::scientific;
3670 }
3671 if (precision >= 0) {
3672 oss << std::setprecision(precision);
3673 }
3674 oss << value;
3675 return oss.str();
3676}
3677
3678std::string FormatArg(const gpga::ServiceArgView& arg, char spec, int precision,
3679 const gpga::ServiceStringTable& strings, bool has_xz) {
3680 if (arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kString ||
3681 arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kIdent) {
3682 return ResolveString(strings, static_cast<uint32_t>(arg.value));
3683 }
3684 if (spec == 's') {
3685 return FormatNumeric(arg, 'd', has_xz);
3686 }
3687 if (spec == 'f' || spec == 'e' || spec == 'g') {
3688 return FormatReal(arg, spec, precision, has_xz);
3689 }
3690 return FormatNumeric(arg, spec, has_xz);
3691}
3692
3693std::string FormatWithSpec(const std::string& fmt,
3694 const std::vector<gpga::ServiceArgView>& args,
3695 size_t start_index,
3696 const gpga::ServiceStringTable& strings,
3697 bool has_xz,
3698 const gpga::ModuleInfo* module,
3699 const std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>* buffers,
3700 uint32_t gid) {
3701 std::ostringstream oss;
3702 size_t arg_index = start_index;
3703 for (size_t i = 0; i < fmt.size(); ++i) {
3704 char c = fmt[i];
3705 if (c != '%') {
3706 oss << c;
3707 continue;
3708 }
3709 if (i + 1 < fmt.size() && fmt[i + 1] == '%') {
3710 oss << '%';
3711 ++i;
3712 continue;
3713 }
3714 bool zero_pad = false;
3715 int width = 0;
3716 int precision = -1;
3717 size_t j = i + 1;
3718 if (j < fmt.size() && fmt[j] == '0') {
3719 zero_pad = true;
3720 ++j;
3721 }
3722 while (j < fmt.size() && fmt[j] >= '0' && fmt[j] <= '9') {
3723 width = (width * 10) + (fmt[j] - '0');
3724 ++j;
3725 }
3726 if (j < fmt.size() && fmt[j] == '.') {
3727 ++j;
3728 precision = 0;
3729 while (j < fmt.size() && fmt[j] >= '0' && fmt[j] <= '9') {
3730 precision = (precision * 10) + (fmt[j] - '0');
3731 ++j;
3732 }
3733 }
3734 if (j >= fmt.size()) {
3735 break;
3736 }
3737 char spec = fmt[j];
3738 if (spec >= 'A' && spec <= 'Z') {
3739 spec = static_cast<char>(spec - 'A' + 'a');
3740 }
3741 i = j;
3742 if (arg_index >= args.size()) {
3743 oss << ApplyPadding("<missing>", width, false);
3744 continue;
3745 }
3746 std::string text;
3747 if (spec == 's') {
3748 const auto& arg = args[arg_index];
3749 if (arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kIdent && module && buffers) {
3750 std::string name =
3751 ResolveString(strings, static_cast<uint32_t>(arg.value));
3752 const gpga::SignalInfo* sig = FindSignalInfo(*module, name);
3753 if (sig) {
3754 text = ReadSignalString(*sig, gid, *buffers);
3755 } else {
3756 text = name;
3757 }
3758 } else if (arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kString ||
3759 arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kIdent) {
3760 text = ResolveString(strings, static_cast<uint32_t>(arg.value));
3761 } else if (arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kWide &&
3762 !arg.wide_value.empty()) {
3763 size_t max_bytes = (arg.width + 7u) / 8u;
3764 text = UnpackStringWords(arg.wide_value, max_bytes);
3765 } else {
3766 size_t max_bytes = (arg.width + 7u) / 8u;
3767 max_bytes = std::min(max_bytes, sizeof(uint64_t));
3768 text = UnpackStringBits(arg.value, max_bytes);
3769 }
3770 } else {
3771 text = FormatArg(args[arg_index], spec, precision, strings, has_xz);
3772 }
3773 ++arg_index;
3774 oss << ApplyPadding(std::move(text), width, zero_pad);
3775 }
3776 return oss.str();
3777}
3778
3779std::string FormatDefaultArgs(const std::vector<gpga::ServiceArgView>& args,
3780 const gpga::ServiceStringTable& strings,
3781 bool has_xz) {
3782 std::ostringstream oss;
3783 for (size_t i = 0; i < args.size(); ++i) {
3784 if (i > 0) {
3785 oss << " ";
3786 }
3787 const auto& arg = args[i];
3788 if (arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kString ||
3789 arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kIdent) {
3790 oss << ResolveString(strings, static_cast<uint32_t>(arg.value));
3791 } else if (arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kReal) {
3792 oss << FormatReal(arg, 'g', -1, has_xz);
3793 } else {
3794 oss << FormatNumeric(arg, 'd', has_xz);
3795 }
3796 }
3797 return oss.str();
3798}
3799
3800struct DecodedServiceRecord {
3801 gpga::ServiceKind kind = gpga::ServiceKind::kDisplay;
3802 uint32_t pid = 0;
3803 uint32_t format_id = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
3804 std::vector<gpga::ServiceArgView> args;
3805};
3806
3807void DecodeServiceRecords(const void* records, uint32_t record_count,
3808 uint32_t max_args, uint32_t wide_words, bool has_xz,
3809 std::vector<DecodedServiceRecord>* out) {
3810 if (!out) {
3811 return;
3812 }
3813 out->clear();
3814 if (!records || record_count == 0 || max_args == 0) {
3815 return;
3816 }
3817 const auto* base = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(records);
3818 const size_t stride =
3819 gpga::ServiceRecordStride(max_args, wide_words, has_xz);
3820 out->reserve(record_count);
3821 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < record_count; ++i) {
3822 const uint8_t* rec = base + (stride * i);
3823 DecodedServiceRecord record;
3824 uint32_t kind_raw = ReadU32(rec, 0);
3825 record.kind = static_cast<gpga::ServiceKind>(kind_raw);
3826 record.pid = ReadU32(rec, sizeof(uint32_t));
3827 record.format_id = ReadU32(rec, sizeof(uint32_t) * 2u);
3828 uint32_t arg_count = ReadU32(rec, sizeof(uint32_t) * 3u);
3829 if (arg_count > max_args) {
3830 arg_count = max_args;
3831 }
3832
3833 size_t offset = sizeof(uint32_t) * 4u;
3834 const size_t arg_kind_offset = offset;
3835 const size_t arg_width_offset =
3836 arg_kind_offset + sizeof(uint32_t) * max_args;
3837 const size_t arg_val_offset =
3838 arg_width_offset + sizeof(uint32_t) * max_args;
3839 const size_t arg_xz_offset = arg_val_offset + sizeof(uint64_t) * max_args;
3840 const size_t arg_wide_val_offset =
3841 arg_xz_offset + (has_xz ? sizeof(uint64_t) * max_args : 0u);
3842 const size_t arg_wide_xz_offset =
3843 arg_wide_val_offset +
3844 sizeof(uint64_t) * max_args * static_cast<size_t>(wide_words);
3845
3846 record.args.reserve(arg_count);
3847 for (uint32_t a = 0; a < arg_count; ++a) {
3848 gpga::ServiceArgView arg;
3849 arg.kind = static_cast<gpga::ServiceArgKind>(
3850 ReadU32(rec, arg_kind_offset + sizeof(uint32_t) * a));
3851 arg.width = ReadU32(rec, arg_width_offset + sizeof(uint32_t) * a);
3852 arg.value = ReadU64(rec, arg_val_offset + sizeof(uint64_t) * a);
3853 if (has_xz) {
3854 arg.xz = ReadU64(rec, arg_xz_offset + sizeof(uint64_t) * a);
3855 }
3856 if (arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kWide && wide_words > 0u) {
3857 uint32_t word_count = (arg.width + 63u) / 64u;
3858 size_t base =
3859 arg_wide_val_offset +
3860 sizeof(uint64_t) * (static_cast<size_t>(a) * wide_words);
3861 arg.wide_value.resize(word_count, 0ull);
3862 for (uint32_t w = 0; w < word_count; ++w) {
3863 arg.wide_value[w] =
3864 ReadU64(rec, base + sizeof(uint64_t) * w);
3865 }
3866 if (has_xz) {
3867 size_t xz_base =
3868 arg_wide_xz_offset +
3869 sizeof(uint64_t) * (static_cast<size_t>(a) * wide_words);
3870 arg.wide_xz.resize(word_count, 0ull);
3871 for (uint32_t w = 0; w < word_count; ++w) {
3872 arg.wide_xz[w] =
3873 ReadU64(rec, xz_base + sizeof(uint64_t) * w);
3874 }
3875 }
3876 }
3877 record.args.push_back(arg);
3878 }
3879 out->push_back(std::move(record));
3880 }
3881}
3882
3883std::string VcdIdForIndex(size_t index) {
3884 const int base = 94;
3885 const int first = 33;
3886 std::string id;
3887 size_t value = index;
3888 do {
3889 int digit = static_cast<int>(value % base);
3890 id.push_back(static_cast<char>(first + digit));
3891 value /= base;
3892 } while (value > 0);
3893 return id;
3894}

3913class VcdWriter {
3914 public:
3915 void SetPackedLayout(const PackedStateLayout* layout) {
3916 packed_layout_ = layout;
3917 }
3918
3919 bool Start(const std::string& filename, const std::string& output_dir,
3920 const gpga::ModuleInfo& module,
3921 const std::vector<std::string>& filter, uint32_t depth,
3922 bool four_state,
3923 const std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>& buffers,
3924 const std::string& timescale,
3925 uint32_t instance_count,
3926 const std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string>* flat_to_hier,
3927 std::string* error) {
3928 if (active_) {
3929 return true;
3930 }
3931 std::string path = filename.empty() ? "dump.vcd" : filename;
3932 if (!output_dir.empty()) {
3933 std::filesystem::path base(output_dir);
3934 std::filesystem::path out_path(path);
3935 if (!out_path.is_absolute()) {
3936 out_path = base / out_path;
3937 }
3938 std::error_code ec;
3939 std::filesystem::create_directories(out_path.parent_path(), ec);
3940 if (ec) {
3941 if (error) {
3942 *error = "failed to create VCD directory: " +
3943 out_path.parent_path().string();
3944 }
3945 return false;
3946 }
3947 path = out_path.string();
3948 }
3949 out_.open(path, std::ios::out | std::ios::trunc);
3950 if (!out_) {
3951 if (error) {
3952 *error = "failed to open VCD file: " + path;
3953 }
3954 return false;
3955 }
3956 four_state_ = four_state;
3957 timescale_ = timescale.empty() ? "1ns" : timescale;
3958 dumping_ = true;
3959 bool dump_all = filter.empty();
3960 for (const auto& name : filter) {
3961 if (name == module.name) {
3962 dump_all = true;
3963 break;
3964 }
3965 }
3966 BuildSignals(module, filter, dump_all, depth, instance_count, flat_to_hier);
3967 WriteHeader(module.name);
3968 EmitInitialValues(buffers);
3969 active_ = true;
3970 return true;
3971 }
3972
3973 void Update(uint64_t time,
3974 const std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>& buffers) {
3975 if (!dumping_) {
3976 return;
3977 }
3978 EmitSnapshot(time, buffers, false);
3979 }
3980
3981 void FinalSnapshot(
3982 const std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>& buffers) {
3983 if (!active_) {
3984 return;
3985 }
3986 if (!dumping_) {
3987 return;
3988 }
3989 uint64_t time = has_time_ ? last_time_ : 0;
3990 if (!last_time_had_values_) {
3991 EmitSnapshot(time, buffers, true);
3992 }
3993 }
3994
3995 void ForceSnapshot(
3996 uint64_t time,
3997 const std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>& buffers) {
3998 if (!active_ || !dumping_) {
3999 return;
4000 }
4001 EmitSnapshot(time, buffers, true);
4002 }
4003
4004 void SetDumping(bool enabled) { dumping_ = enabled; }
4005
4006 void SetDumpLimit(uint64_t limit) {
4007 dump_limit_ = limit;
4008 CheckDumpLimit();
4009 }
4010
4011 void Flush() {
4012 if (out_) {
4013 out_.flush();
4014 }
4015 }
4016
4017 void Close() {
4018 if (out_) {
4019 out_.flush();
4020 out_.close();
4021 }
4022 active_ = false;
4023 }
4024
4025 bool active() const { return active_; }
4026
4027 private:
4028 void BuildSignals(const gpga::ModuleInfo& module,
4029 const std::vector<std::string>& filter, bool dump_all,
4030 uint32_t depth_limit, uint32_t instance_count,
4031 const std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string>* flat_to_hier) {
4032 std::unordered_set<std::string> wanted(filter.begin(), filter.end());
4033 signals_.clear();
4034 size_t index = 0;
4035 for (const auto& sig : module.signals) {
4036 std::string display_base = sig.name;
4037 if (flat_to_hier) {
4038 auto it = flat_to_hier->find(sig.name);
4039 if (it != flat_to_hier->end() && !it->second.empty()) {
4040 display_base = it->second;
4041 }
4042 }
4043 std::string display_rel = StripModulePrefix(display_base, module.name);
4044 if (display_rel.empty()) {
4045 display_rel = display_base;
4046 }
4047 uint32_t array_size = sig.array_size > 0 ? sig.array_size : 1u;
4048 uint32_t inst_count = std::max<uint32_t>(1u, instance_count);
4049 for (uint32_t inst = 0; inst < inst_count; ++inst) {
4050 std::string display_name = display_rel;
4051 if (inst_count > 1u) {
4052 display_name =
4053 "inst" + std::to_string(inst) + "." + display_rel;
4054 }
4055 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < array_size; ++i) {
4056 bool include = dump_all || wanted.empty();
4057 if (!include) {
4058 include =
4059 MatchesFilterName(wanted, module.name, display_name, i) ||
4060 MatchesFilterName(wanted, module.name, display_rel, i) ||
4061 MatchesFilterName(wanted, module.name, sig.name, i);
4062 }
4063 if (!include) {
4064 continue;
4065 }
4066 if (depth_limit > 0 && !PassesDepth(display_rel, depth_limit)) {
4067 continue;
4068 }
4069 VcdSignal entry;
4070 entry.base_name = sig.name;
4071 entry.array_size = array_size;
4072 entry.array_index = i;
4073 entry.instance_index = inst;
4074 entry.is_real = sig.is_real;
4075 entry.width = sig.is_real ? 64u : std::max<uint32_t>(1u, sig.width);
4076 entry.word_count = entry.width <= 64u ? 1u :
4077 static_cast<uint32_t>((entry.width + 63u) / 64u);
4078 entry.id = VcdIdForIndex(index++);
4079 if (array_size > 1u) {
4080 entry.name = display_name + "[" + std::to_string(i) + "]";
4081 } else {
4082 entry.name = display_name;
4083 }
4084 signals_.push_back(std::move(entry));
4085 }
4086 }
4087 }
4088 }
4089
4090 bool PassesDepth(const std::string& name, uint32_t depth_limit) const {
4091 if (depth_limit == 0u) {
4092 return true;
4093 }
4094 std::vector<std::string> scope;
4095 std::string leaf;
4096 SplitHierName(name, &scope, &leaf);
4097 uint32_t depth = scope.empty() ? 1u
4098 : static_cast<uint32_t>(scope.size() + 1u);
4099 return depth <= depth_limit;
4100 }
4101
4102 bool MatchesFilterName(const std::unordered_set<std::string>& wanted,
4103 const std::string& module_name,
4104 const std::string& name, uint32_t index) const {
4105 if (wanted.empty()) {
4106 return true;
4107 }
4108 const std::string indexed = name + "[" + std::to_string(index) + "]";
4109 for (const auto& raw : wanted) {
4110 std::string filter = raw;
4111 if (!module_name.empty() && StartsWith(filter, module_name + ".")) {
4112 filter = filter.substr(module_name.size() + 1);
4113 } else if (!module_name.empty() &&
4114 StartsWith(filter, module_name + "__")) {
4115 filter = filter.substr(module_name.size() + 2);
4116 }
4117 if (filter == name || filter == indexed) {
4118 return true;
4119 }
4120 if (StartsWith(name, filter)) {
4121 if (name.size() == filter.size()) {
4122 return true;
4123 }
4124 char next = name[filter.size()];
4125 if (next == '.') {
4126 return true;
4127 }
4128 if (next == '_' && filter.size() + 1 < name.size() &&
4129 name[filter.size() + 1] == '_') {
4130 return true;
4131 }
4132 }
4133 }
4134 return false;
4135 }
4136
4137 bool StartsWith(const std::string& value, const std::string& prefix) const {
4138 return value.size() >= prefix.size() &&
4139 value.compare(0, prefix.size(), prefix) == 0;
4140 }
4141
4142 std::string StripModulePrefix(const std::string& name,
4143 const std::string& module_name) const {
4144 if (module_name.empty()) {
4145 return name;
4146 }
4147 const std::string dot_prefix = module_name + ".";
4148 const std::string flat_prefix = module_name + "__";
4149 if (StartsWith(name, dot_prefix)) {
4150 return name.substr(dot_prefix.size());
4151 }
4152 if (StartsWith(name, flat_prefix)) {
4153 return name.substr(flat_prefix.size());
4154 }
4155 return name;
4156 }
4157
4158 void SplitHierName(const std::string& name, std::vector<std::string>* scope,
4159 std::string* leaf) const {
4160 if (scope) {
4161 scope->clear();
4162 }
4163 if (leaf) {
4164 *leaf = name;
4165 }
4166 if (!scope || !leaf) {
4167 return;
4168 }
4169 std::vector<std::string> parts;
4170 std::string current;
4171 int bracket_depth = 0;
4172 for (size_t i = 0; i < name.size(); ++i) {
4173 char c = name[i];
4174 if (c == '[') {
4175 bracket_depth++;
4176 current.push_back(c);
4177 continue;
4178 }
4179 if (c == ']') {
4180 if (bracket_depth > 0) {
4181 bracket_depth--;
4182 }
4183 current.push_back(c);
4184 continue;
4185 }
4186 if (bracket_depth == 0 && c == '.') {
4187 if (!current.empty()) {
4188 parts.push_back(current);
4189 current.clear();
4190 }
4191 continue;
4192 }
4193 if (bracket_depth == 0 && c == '_' && i + 1 < name.size() &&
4194 name[i + 1] == '_') {
4195 if (!current.empty()) {
4196 parts.push_back(current);
4197 current.clear();
4198 }
4199 i++;
4200 continue;
4201 }
4202 current.push_back(c);
4203 }
4204 if (!current.empty()) {
4205 parts.push_back(current);
4206 }
4207 if (parts.empty()) {
4208 return;
4209 }
4210 if (parts.size() == 1) {
4211 *leaf = parts[0];
4212 return;
4213 }
4214 scope->assign(parts.begin(), parts.end() - 1);
4215 *leaf = parts.back();
4216 }
4217
4218 void WriteHeader(const std::string& module_name) {
4219 out_ << "$date\n today\n$end\n";
4220 out_ << "$version\n metalfpga\n$end\n";
4221 out_ << "$timescale " << timescale_ << " $end\n";
4222 out_ << "$scope module " << module_name << " $end\n";
4223 struct ScopedSignal {
4224 std::vector<std::string> scope;
4225 std::string leaf;
4226 const VcdSignal* signal = nullptr;
4227 };
4228 std::vector<ScopedSignal> ordered;
4229 ordered.reserve(signals_.size());
4230 for (const auto& sig : signals_) {
4231 ScopedSignal entry;
4232 entry.signal = &sig;
4233 SplitHierName(sig.name, &entry.scope, &entry.leaf);
4234 if (entry.leaf.empty()) {
4235 entry.leaf = sig.name;
4236 }
4237 ordered.push_back(std::move(entry));
4238 }
4239 std::sort(ordered.begin(), ordered.end(),
4240 [](const ScopedSignal& a, const ScopedSignal& b) {
4241 if (a.scope != b.scope) {
4242 return std::lexicographical_compare(
4243 a.scope.begin(), a.scope.end(), b.scope.begin(),
4244 b.scope.end());
4245 }
4246 return a.leaf < b.leaf;
4247 });
4248 std::vector<std::string> current;
4249 for (const auto& entry : ordered) {
4250 size_t common = 0;
4251 while (common < current.size() && common < entry.scope.size() &&
4252 current[common] == entry.scope[common]) {
4253 common++;
4254 }
4255 for (size_t i = current.size(); i > common; --i) {
4256 out_ << "$upscope $end\n";
4257 }
4258 for (size_t i = common; i < entry.scope.size(); ++i) {
4259 out_ << "$scope module " << entry.scope[i] << " $end\n";
4260 }
4261 current = entry.scope;
4262 const auto& sig = *entry.signal;
4263 if (sig.is_real) {
4264 out_ << "$var real 64 " << sig.id << " " << entry.leaf << " $end\n";
4265 } else {
4266 out_ << "$var wire " << sig.width << " " << sig.id << " "
4267 << entry.leaf << " $end\n";
4268 }
4269 }
4270 for (size_t i = current.size(); i > 0; --i) {
4271 out_ << "$upscope $end\n";
4272 }
4273 out_ << "$upscope $end\n";
4274 out_ << "$enddefinitions $end\n";
4275 CheckDumpLimit();
4276 }
4277
4278 void EmitInitialValues(
4279 const std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>& buffers) {
4280 out_ << "#0\n";
4281 for (auto& sig : signals_) {
4282 if (sig.word_count <= 1u) {
4283 uint64_t val = 0;
4284 uint64_t xz = 0;
4285 if (!ReadSignal(sig, buffers, &val, &xz)) {
4286 continue;
4287 }
4288 sig.last_val = val;
4289 sig.last_xz = xz;
4290 sig.has_value = true;
4291 EmitValue(sig, val, xz);
4292 continue;
4293 }
4294 std::vector<uint64_t> val_words;
4295 std::vector<uint64_t> xz_words;
4296 if (!ReadSignalWords(sig, buffers, &val_words, &xz_words)) {
4297 continue;
4298 }
4299 sig.last_val_words = val_words;
4300 sig.last_xz_words = xz_words;
4301 sig.has_value = true;
4302 EmitValueWords(sig, val_words, xz_words);
4303 }
4304 last_time_ = 0;
4305 has_time_ = true;
4306 last_time_had_values_ = true;
4307 CheckDumpLimit();
4308 }
4309
4310 bool ReadSignal(const VcdSignal& sig,
4311 const std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>& buffers,
4312 uint64_t* val, uint64_t* xz) const {
4313 if (!val || !xz) {
4314 return false;
4315 }
4316 const gpga::MetalBuffer* val_buf =
4317 FindBuffer(buffers, MslSignalName(sig.base_name), "_val");
4318 const gpga::MetalBuffer* xz_buf = nullptr;
4319 const gpga::MetalBuffer* packed_buf = nullptr;
4320 const PackedSignalOffsets* packed = nullptr;
4321 if (four_state_) {
4322 xz_buf = FindBuffer(buffers, MslSignalName(sig.base_name), "_xz");
4323 }
4324 if (!val_buf && packed_layout_) {
4325 packed = packed_layout_->Find(sig.base_name);
4326 if (packed) {
4327 packed_buf = FindBuffer(buffers, "gpga_state", "");
4328 }
4329 }
4330 if (!val_buf && (!packed || !packed_buf || !packed->has_val)) {
4331 return false;
4332 }
4333 gpga::SignalInfo info;
4334 info.name = sig.base_name;
4335 info.width = sig.width;
4336 info.array_size = sig.array_size;
4337 info.is_real = sig.is_real;
4338 uint64_t val_word = 0;
4339 if (packed) {
4340 if (!ReadPackedSignalWordFromBuffer(
4341 info, sig.instance_index, sig.array_index, *packed_buf,
4342 packed->val_offset, 0u, &val_word)) {
4343 return false;
4344 }
4345 } else {
4346 if (!ReadSignalWordFromBuffer(info, sig.instance_index, sig.array_index,
4347 *val_buf, 0u, &val_word)) {
4348 return false;
4349 }
4350 }
4351 *val = val_word;
4352 if (four_state_) {
4353 if (packed && packed_buf && packed->has_xz) {
4354 return ReadPackedSignalWordFromBuffer(
4355 info, sig.instance_index, sig.array_index, *packed_buf,
4356 packed->xz_offset, 0u, xz);
4357 }
4358 if (xz_buf && xz_buf->contents() &&
4359 ReadSignalWordFromBuffer(info, sig.instance_index, sig.array_index,
4360 *xz_buf, 0u, xz)) {
4361 return true;
4362 }
4363 *xz = 0;
4364 } else {
4365 *xz = 0;
4366 }
4367 return true;
4368 }
4369
4370 bool ReadSignalWords(
4371 const VcdSignal& sig,
4372 const std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>& buffers,
4373 std::vector<uint64_t>* val_words,
4374 std::vector<uint64_t>* xz_words) const {
4375 if (!val_words || !xz_words) {
4376 return false;
4377 }
4378 const gpga::MetalBuffer* val_buf =
4379 FindBuffer(buffers, MslSignalName(sig.base_name), "_val");
4380 const gpga::MetalBuffer* xz_buf = nullptr;
4381 const gpga::MetalBuffer* packed_buf = nullptr;
4382 const PackedSignalOffsets* packed = nullptr;
4383 if (four_state_) {
4384 xz_buf = FindBuffer(buffers, MslSignalName(sig.base_name), "_xz");
4385 }
4386 if (!val_buf && packed_layout_) {
4387 packed = packed_layout_->Find(sig.base_name);
4388 if (packed) {
4389 packed_buf = FindBuffer(buffers, "gpga_state", "");
4390 }
4391 }
4392 if (!val_buf && (!packed || !packed_buf || !packed->has_val)) {
4393 return false;
4394 }
4395 gpga::SignalInfo info;
4396 info.name = sig.base_name;
4397 info.width = sig.width;
4398 info.array_size = sig.array_size;
4399 info.is_real = sig.is_real;
4400 val_words->assign(sig.word_count, 0ull);
4401 xz_words->assign(sig.word_count, 0ull);
4402 for (uint32_t word = 0; word < sig.word_count; ++word) {
4403 if (packed) {
4404 if (!ReadPackedSignalWordFromBuffer(
4405 info, sig.instance_index, sig.array_index, *packed_buf,
4406 packed->val_offset, word, &(*val_words)[word])) {
4407 return false;
4408 }
4409 } else {
4410 if (!ReadSignalWordFromBuffer(info, sig.instance_index, sig.array_index,
4411 *val_buf, word, &(*val_words)[word])) {
4412 return false;
4413 }
4414 }
4415 if (four_state_) {
4416 if (packed && packed_buf && packed->has_xz) {
4417 if (!ReadPackedSignalWordFromBuffer(
4418 info, sig.instance_index, sig.array_index, *packed_buf,
4419 packed->xz_offset, word, &(*xz_words)[word])) {
4420 return false;
4421 }
4422 continue;
4423 }
4424 if (xz_buf && xz_buf->contents()) {
4425 if (!ReadSignalWordFromBuffer(
4426 info, sig.instance_index, sig.array_index, *xz_buf, word,
4427 &(*xz_words)[word])) {
4428 return false;
4429 }
4430 }
4431 }
4432 }
4433 return true;
4434 }
4435
4436 const gpga::MetalBuffer* FindBuffer(
4437 const std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>& buffers,
4438 const std::string& base, const char* suffix) const {
4439 auto it = buffers.find(base + suffix);
4440 if (it != buffers.end()) {
4441 return &it->second;
4442 }
4443 it = buffers.find(base);
4444 if (it != buffers.end()) {
4445 return &it->second;
4446 }
4447 return nullptr;
4448 }
4449
4450 void EmitValue(const VcdSignal& sig, uint64_t val, uint64_t xz) {
4451 if (sig.is_real) {
4452 if (xz != 0) {
4453 out_ << "rnan " << sig.id << "\n";
4454 return;
4455 }
4456 double real_val = 0.0;
4457 std::memcpy(&real_val, &val, sizeof(real_val));
4458 out_ << "r" << real_val << " " << sig.id << "\n";
4459 return;
4460 }
4461 std::string bits;
4462 bits.reserve(sig.width);
4463 for (int i = static_cast<int>(sig.width) - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
4464 uint64_t mask = 1ull << static_cast<uint32_t>(i);
4465 bool bit_xz = (xz & mask) != 0ull;
4466 bool bit_val = (val & mask) != 0ull;
4467 if (bit_xz) {
4468 bits.push_back(bit_val ? 'x' : 'z');
4469 } else {
4470 bits.push_back(bit_val ? '1' : '0');
4471 }
4472 }
4473 if (sig.width == 1u) {
4474 out_ << bits[0] << sig.id << "\n";
4475 } else {
4476 out_ << "b" << bits << " " << sig.id << "\n";
4477 }
4478 }
4479
4480 void EmitValueWords(const VcdSignal& sig,
4481 const std::vector<uint64_t>& val_words,
4482 const std::vector<uint64_t>& xz_words) {
4483 if (sig.is_real) {
4484 EmitValue(sig, val_words.empty() ? 0ull : val_words[0],
4485 xz_words.empty() ? 0ull : xz_words[0]);
4486 return;
4487 }
4488 std::string bits;
4489 bits.reserve(sig.width);
4490 for (int i = static_cast<int>(sig.width) - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
4491 uint32_t bit_index = static_cast<uint32_t>(i);
4492 uint32_t word_index = bit_index / 64u;
4493 uint32_t word_bit = bit_index % 64u;
4494 uint64_t mask = 1ull << word_bit;
4495 bool bit_xz = word_index < xz_words.size() &&
4496 (xz_words[word_index] & mask) != 0ull;
4497 bool bit_val = word_index < val_words.size() &&
4498 (val_words[word_index] & mask) != 0ull;
4499 if (bit_xz) {
4500 bits.push_back(bit_val ? 'x' : 'z');
4501 } else {
4502 bits.push_back(bit_val ? '1' : '0');
4503 }
4504 }
4505 if (sig.width == 1u) {
4506 out_ << bits[0] << sig.id << "\n";
4507 } else {
4508 out_ << "b" << bits << " " << sig.id << "\n";
4509 }
4510 }
4511
4512 void EmitSnapshot(
4513 uint64_t time,
4514 const std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>& buffers,
4515 bool force_values) {
4516 if (!active_) {
4517 return;
4518 }
4519 if (dump_limit_ != 0u && out_) {
4520 std::streampos pos = out_.tellp();
4521 if (pos >= 0 &&
4522 static_cast<uint64_t>(pos) >= dump_limit_) {
4523 dumping_ = false;
4524 return;
4525 }
4526 }
4527 if (!has_time_ || time != last_time_) {
4528 out_ << "#" << time << "\n";
4529 last_time_ = time;
4530 has_time_ = true;
4531 last_time_had_values_ = false;
4532 }
4533 for (auto& sig : signals_) {
4534 if (sig.word_count <= 1u) {
4535 uint64_t val = 0;
4536 uint64_t xz = 0;
4537 if (!ReadSignal(sig, buffers, &val, &xz)) {
4538 continue;
4539 }
4540 if (!force_values && sig.has_value && sig.last_val == val &&
4541 sig.last_xz == xz) {
4542 continue;
4543 }
4544 sig.last_val = val;
4545 sig.last_xz = xz;
4546 sig.has_value = true;
4547 EmitValue(sig, val, xz);
4548 last_time_had_values_ = true;
4549 continue;
4550 }
4551 std::vector<uint64_t> val_words;
4552 std::vector<uint64_t> xz_words;
4553 if (!ReadSignalWords(sig, buffers, &val_words, &xz_words)) {
4554 continue;
4555 }
4556 if (!force_values && sig.has_value &&
4557 sig.last_val_words == val_words &&
4558 sig.last_xz_words == xz_words) {
4559 continue;
4560 }
4561 sig.last_val_words = val_words;
4562 sig.last_xz_words = xz_words;
4563 sig.has_value = true;
4564 EmitValueWords(sig, val_words, xz_words);
4565 last_time_had_values_ = true;
4566 }
4567 CheckDumpLimit();
4568 }
4569
4570 void CheckDumpLimit() {
4571 if (!dumping_ || dump_limit_ == 0u || !out_) {
4572 return;
4573 }
4574 std::streampos pos = out_.tellp();
4575 if (pos < 0) {
4576 return;
4577 }
4578 uint64_t written = static_cast<uint64_t>(pos);
4579 if (written >= dump_limit_) {
4580 dumping_ = false;
4581 }
4582 }
4583
4584 bool active_ = false;
4585 bool four_state_ = false;
4586 bool has_time_ = false;
4587 bool last_time_had_values_ = false;
4588 bool dumping_ = true;
4589 uint64_t last_time_ = 0;
4590 uint64_t dump_limit_ = 0;
4591 std::string timescale_ = "1ns";
4592 const PackedStateLayout* packed_layout_ = nullptr;
4593 std::ofstream out_;
4594 std::vector<VcdSignal> signals_;
4595};
4596
4597std::string StripComments(const std::string& line) {
4598 size_t pos = line.find("//");
4599 std::string out = (pos == std::string::npos) ? line : line.substr(0, pos);
4600 pos = out.find('#');
4601 if (pos != std::string::npos) {
4602 out = out.substr(0, pos);
4603 }
4604 return out;
4605}
4606
4607std::string NormalizeToken(const std::string& token) {
4608 std::string out;
4609 out.reserve(token.size());
4610 for (char c : token) {
4611 if (c != '_') {
4612 out.push_back(c);
4613 }
4614 }
4615 return out;
4616}
4617
4618bool LooksLikeBinaryLiteral(const std::string& token) {
4619 if (token.empty()) {
4620 return false;
4621 }
4622 for (char c : token) {
4623 if (c == '0' || c == '1' || c == 'x' || c == 'X' || c == 'z' || c == 'Z') {
4624 continue;
4625 }
4626 return false;
4627 }
4628 return true;
4629}
4630
4631bool ParseUnsigned(const std::string& token, int base, uint64_t* out) {
4632 if (!out) {
4633 return false;
4634 }
4635 try {
4636 size_t pos = 0;
4637 uint64_t value = std::stoull(token, &pos, base);
4638 if (pos != token.size()) {
4639 return false;
4640 }
4641 *out = value;
4642 return true;
4643 } catch (...) {
4644 return false;
4645 }
4646}
4647
4648bool ParseMemValue(const std::string& token_in, bool is_hex, uint32_t width,
4649 uint64_t* val, uint64_t* xz) {
4650 if (!val || !xz) {
4651 return false;
4652 }
4653 std::string token = NormalizeToken(token_in);
4654 if (token.size() >= 2 && token[0] == '0' &&
4655 (token[1] == 'x' || token[1] == 'X')) {
4656 is_hex = true;
4657 token = token.substr(2);
4658 } else if (token.size() >= 2 && token[0] == '0' &&
4659 (token[1] == 'b' || token[1] == 'B')) {
4660 std::string rest = token.substr(2);
4661 if (LooksLikeBinaryLiteral(rest)) {
4662 is_hex = false;
4663 token = std::move(rest);
4664 }
4665 }
4666 uint64_t out_val = 0;
4667 uint64_t out_xz = 0;
4668 uint32_t max_bits = std::min<uint32_t>(width, 64u);
4669 if (is_hex) {
4670 int bit_pos = 0;
4671 for (int i = static_cast<int>(token.size()) - 1; i >= 0 && bit_pos < static_cast<int>(max_bits); --i) {
4672 char c = token[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
4673 uint8_t nibble = 0;
4674 bool is_x = false;
4675 bool is_z = false;
4676 if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
4677 nibble = static_cast<uint8_t>(c - '0');
4678 } else if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') {
4679 nibble = static_cast<uint8_t>(10 + (c - 'a'));
4680 } else if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') {
4681 nibble = static_cast<uint8_t>(10 + (c - 'A'));
4682 } else if (c == 'x' || c == 'X') {
4683 is_x = true;
4684 } else if (c == 'z' || c == 'Z') {
4685 is_z = true;
4686 } else {
4687 return false;
4688 }
4689 for (int b = 0; b < 4 && bit_pos < static_cast<int>(max_bits); ++b, ++bit_pos) {
4690 uint64_t mask = 1ull << static_cast<uint32_t>(bit_pos);
4691 if (is_x || is_z) {
4692 out_xz |= mask;
4693 if (is_x) {
4694 out_val |= mask;
4695 }
4696 } else if (nibble & (1u << b)) {
4697 out_val |= mask;
4698 }
4699 }
4700 }
4701 } else {
4702 int bit_pos = 0;
4703 for (int i = static_cast<int>(token.size()) - 1; i >= 0 && bit_pos < static_cast<int>(max_bits); --i, ++bit_pos) {
4704 char c = token[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
4705 uint64_t mask = 1ull << static_cast<uint32_t>(bit_pos);
4706 if (c == '1') {
4707 out_val |= mask;
4708 } else if (c == '0') {
4709 continue;
4710 } else if (c == 'x' || c == 'X') {
4711 out_xz |= mask;
4712 out_val |= mask;
4713 } else if (c == 'z' || c == 'Z') {
4714 out_xz |= mask;
4715 } else {
4716 return false;
4717 }
4718 }
4719 }
4720 *val = out_val;
4721 *xz = out_xz;
4722 return true;
4723}
4724
4725bool ParseMemValueWords(const std::string& token_in, bool is_hex,
4726 uint32_t width, std::vector<uint64_t>* val_words,
4727 std::vector<uint64_t>* xz_words) {
4728 if (!val_words || !xz_words) {
4729 return false;
4730 }
4731 if (width == 0u) {
4732 width = 1u;
4733 }
4734 const uint32_t word_count = (width + 63u) / 64u;
4735 val_words->assign(word_count, 0ull);
4736 xz_words->assign(word_count, 0ull);
4737 std::string token = NormalizeToken(token_in);
4738 if (token.size() >= 2 && token[0] == '0' &&
4739 (token[1] == 'x' || token[1] == 'X')) {
4740 is_hex = true;
4741 token = token.substr(2);
4742 } else if (token.size() >= 2 && token[0] == '0' &&
4743 (token[1] == 'b' || token[1] == 'B')) {
4744 std::string rest = token.substr(2);
4745 if (LooksLikeBinaryLiteral(rest)) {
4746 is_hex = false;
4747 token = std::move(rest);
4748 }
4749 }
4750 auto set_bit = [&](std::vector<uint64_t>* words, uint32_t bit) {
4751 size_t word_index = bit / 64u;
4752 if (word_index >= words->size()) {
4753 return;
4754 }
4755 uint32_t word_bit = bit % 64u;
4756 (*words)[word_index] |= (1ull << word_bit);
4757 };
4758 uint32_t bit_pos = 0;
4759 if (is_hex) {
4760 for (int i = static_cast<int>(token.size()) - 1;
4761 i >= 0 && bit_pos < width; --i) {
4762 char c = token[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
4763 uint8_t nibble = 0;
4764 bool is_x = false;
4765 bool is_z = false;
4766 if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
4767 nibble = static_cast<uint8_t>(c - '0');
4768 } else if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') {
4769 nibble = static_cast<uint8_t>(10 + (c - 'a'));
4770 } else if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') {
4771 nibble = static_cast<uint8_t>(10 + (c - 'A'));
4772 } else if (c == 'x' || c == 'X') {
4773 is_x = true;
4774 } else if (c == 'z' || c == 'Z') {
4775 is_z = true;
4776 } else {
4777 return false;
4778 }
4779 for (int b = 0; b < 4 && bit_pos < width; ++b, ++bit_pos) {
4780 if (is_x || is_z) {
4781 set_bit(xz_words, bit_pos);
4782 if (is_x) {
4783 set_bit(val_words, bit_pos);
4784 }
4785 } else if (nibble & (1u << b)) {
4786 set_bit(val_words, bit_pos);
4787 }
4788 }
4789 }
4790 } else {
4791 for (int i = static_cast<int>(token.size()) - 1;
4792 i >= 0 && bit_pos < width; --i, ++bit_pos) {
4793 char c = token[static_cast<size_t>(i)];
4794 if (c == '1') {
4795 set_bit(val_words, bit_pos);
4796 } else if (c == '0') {
4797 continue;
4798 } else if (c == 'x' || c == 'X') {
4799 set_bit(xz_words, bit_pos);
4800 set_bit(val_words, bit_pos);
4801 } else if (c == 'z' || c == 'Z') {
4802 set_bit(xz_words, bit_pos);
4803 } else {
4804 return false;
4805 }
4806 }
4807 }
4808 return true;
4809}
4810
4811bool ApplyReadmem(const std::string& filename, bool is_hex,
4812 const gpga::SignalInfo& signal, bool four_state,
4813 std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>* buffers,
4814 const PackedStateLayout* packed_layout,
4815 gpga::MetalBuffer* packed_state_buf,
4816 uint32_t instance_count, uint64_t start, uint64_t end,
4817 std::string* error) {
4818 if (!buffers) {
4819 return false;
4820 }
4821 std::ifstream in(filename);
4822 if (!in) {
4823 if (error) {
4824 *error = "failed to open readmem file: " + filename;
4825 }
4826 return false;
4827 }
4828 gpga::MetalBuffer* val_buf = nullptr;
4829 const PackedSignalOffsets* packed = nullptr;
4830 const std::string base = MslSignalName(signal.name);
4831 auto it_val = buffers->find(base + "_val");
4832 if (it_val == buffers->end()) {
4833 it_val = buffers->find(base);
4834 }
4835 if (it_val != buffers->end()) {
4836 val_buf = &it_val->second;
4837 } else if (packed_layout && packed_state_buf &&
4838 packed_state_buf->contents()) {
4839 packed = packed_layout->Find(signal.name);
4840 }
4841 if (!val_buf && (!packed || !packed->has_val)) {
4842 if (error) {
4843 *error = "readmem target buffer not found: " + signal.name;
4844 }
4845 return false;
4846 }
4847 auto write_word = [&](uint32_t gid, uint64_t array_index, size_t word_index,
4848 uint64_t value, uint64_t xz) -> void {
4849 if (val_buf) {
4850 WriteSignalWord(signal, gid, array_index, word_index, value, xz,
4851 four_state, buffers);
4852 return;
4853 }
4854 if (!packed || !packed_state_buf || !packed_state_buf->contents()) {
4855 return;
4856 }
4857 WritePackedSignalWordToBuffer(signal, gid, array_index, packed_state_buf,
4858 packed->val_offset, word_index, value);
4859 if (four_state && packed->has_xz) {
4860 WritePackedSignalWordToBuffer(signal, gid, array_index, packed_state_buf,
4861 packed->xz_offset, word_index, xz);
4862 }
4863 };
4864 uint32_t width = signal.is_real ? 64u : signal.width;
4865 if (width == 0u) {
4866 width = 1u;
4867 }
4868 uint32_t array_size = signal.array_size > 0 ? signal.array_size : 1u;
4869 if (end == std::numeric_limits<uint64_t>::max()) {
4870 end = (array_size > 0) ? static_cast<uint64_t>(array_size - 1u) : 0u;
4871 }
4872 if (start > end) {
4873 std::swap(start, end);
4874 }
4875 uint64_t address = start;
4876 std::string line;
4877 while (std::getline(in, line)) {
4878 line = StripComments(line);
4879 std::stringstream ss(line);
4880 std::string token;
4881 while (ss >> token) {
4882 token = NormalizeToken(token);
4883 if (token.empty()) {
4884 continue;
4885 }
4886 if (token[0] == '@') {
4887 uint64_t addr = 0;
4888 std::string addr_token = token.substr(1);
4889 if (!ParseUnsigned(addr_token, is_hex ? 16 : 2, &addr)) {
4890 if (error) {
4891 *error = "invalid readmem address: " + token;
4892 }
4893 return false;
4894 }
4895 address = addr;
4896 continue;
4897 }
4898 if (address > end) {
4899 return true;
4900 }
4901 if (address >= array_size) {
4902 address++;
4903 continue;
4904 }
4905 if (width <= 64u) {
4906 uint64_t val = 0;
4907 uint64_t xz = 0;
4908 if (!ParseMemValue(token, is_hex, width, &val, &xz)) {
4909 if (error) {
4910 *error = "invalid readmem value: " + token;
4911 }
4912 return false;
4913 }
4914 for (uint32_t gid = 0; gid < instance_count; ++gid) {
4915 write_word(gid, address, 0u, val, xz);
4916 }
4917 } else {
4918 std::vector<uint64_t> val_words;
4919 std::vector<uint64_t> xz_words;
4920 if (!ParseMemValueWords(token, is_hex, width, &val_words,
4921 &xz_words)) {
4922 if (error) {
4923 *error = "invalid readmem value: " + token;
4924 }
4925 return false;
4926 }
4927 for (uint32_t gid = 0; gid < instance_count; ++gid) {
4928 size_t word_count = SignalWordCount(signal);
4929 for (size_t word = 0; word < word_count; ++word) {
4930 uint64_t val = (word < val_words.size()) ? val_words[word] : 0ull;
4931 uint64_t xz = (word < xz_words.size()) ? xz_words[word] : 0ull;
4932 write_word(gid, address, word, val, xz);
4933 }
4934 }
4935 }
4936 address++;
4937 }
4938 }
4939 return true;
4940}
4941
4942std::string FormatMemWords(const std::vector<uint64_t>& val_words,
4943 const std::vector<uint64_t>& xz_words,
4944 uint32_t width, bool is_hex, bool four_state) {
4945 if (width == 0u) {
4946 width = 1u;
4947 }
4948 auto get_bit = [&](const std::vector<uint64_t>& words,
4949 uint32_t bit) -> bool {
4950 size_t word_index = bit / 64u;
4951 if (word_index >= words.size()) {
4952 return false;
4953 }
4954 uint32_t word_bit = bit % 64u;
4955 return (words[word_index] & (1ull << word_bit)) != 0ull;
4956 };
4957 if (!is_hex) {
4958 std::string out;
4959 out.reserve(width);
4960 for (int bit = static_cast<int>(width) - 1; bit >= 0; --bit) {
4961 uint32_t bit_index = static_cast<uint32_t>(bit);
4962 bool bit_xz = four_state && get_bit(xz_words, bit_index);
4963 bool bit_val = get_bit(val_words, bit_index);
4964 if (!bit_xz) {
4965 out.push_back(bit_val ? '1' : '0');
4966 } else {
4967 out.push_back(bit_val ? 'x' : 'z');
4968 }
4969 }
4970 return out;
4971 }
4972 uint32_t digits = (width + 3u) / 4u;
4973 std::string out;
4974 out.reserve(digits);
4975 for (uint32_t d = 0; d < digits; ++d) {
4976 int start_bit = static_cast<int>(width) - 1 - static_cast<int>(d * 4u);
4977 uint32_t nibble_val = 0u;
4978 uint32_t nibble_xz = 0u;
4979 uint32_t nibble_mask = 0u;
4980 for (int b = 0; b < 4; ++b) {
4981 int bit_index = start_bit - b;
4982 if (bit_index < 0) {
4983 continue;
4984 }
4985 uint32_t nibble_bit = 1u << (3 - b);
4986 nibble_mask |= nibble_bit;
4987 uint32_t bit_u = static_cast<uint32_t>(bit_index);
4988 if (get_bit(val_words, bit_u)) {
4989 nibble_val |= nibble_bit;
4990 }
4991 if (four_state && get_bit(xz_words, bit_u)) {
4992 nibble_xz |= nibble_bit;
4993 }
4994 }
4995 if (four_state && nibble_xz != 0u) {
4996 if (nibble_xz == nibble_mask && nibble_val == 0u) {
4997 out.push_back('z');
4998 } else {
4999 out.push_back('x');
5000 }
5001 } else {
5002 static const char kDigits[] = "0123456789abcdef";
5003 out.push_back(kDigits[nibble_val & 0xFu]);
5004 }
5005 }
5006 return out;
5007}
5008
5009std::string FormatMemWord(uint64_t val, uint64_t xz, uint32_t width,
5010 bool is_hex, bool four_state) {
5011 if (width == 0u) {
5012 width = 1u;
5013 }
5014 if (width > 64u) {
5015 width = 64u;
5016 }
5017 if (!is_hex) {
5018 std::string out;
5019 out.reserve(width);
5020 for (int bit = static_cast<int>(width) - 1; bit >= 0; --bit) {
5021 uint64_t mask = 1ull << static_cast<uint32_t>(bit);
5022 bool has_xz = four_state && ((xz & mask) != 0u);
5023 if (!has_xz) {
5024 out.push_back((val & mask) ? '1' : '0');
5025 } else {
5026 out.push_back((val & mask) ? 'x' : 'z');
5027 }
5028 }
5029 return out;
5030 }
5031 uint32_t digits = (width + 3u) / 4u;
5032 std::string out;
5033 out.reserve(digits);
5034 for (uint32_t d = 0; d < digits; ++d) {
5035 int start_bit = static_cast<int>(width) - 1 - static_cast<int>(d * 4u);
5036 uint32_t nibble_val = 0u;
5037 uint32_t nibble_xz = 0u;
5038 uint32_t nibble_mask = 0u;
5039 for (int b = 0; b < 4; ++b) {
5040 int bit_index = start_bit - b;
5041 if (bit_index < 0) {
5042 continue;
5043 }
5044 uint32_t nibble_bit = 1u << (3 - b);
5045 nibble_mask |= nibble_bit;
5046 uint64_t mask = 1ull << static_cast<uint32_t>(bit_index);
5047 if (val & mask) {
5048 nibble_val |= nibble_bit;
5049 }
5050 if (xz & mask) {
5051 nibble_xz |= nibble_bit;
5052 }
5053 }
5054 if (four_state && nibble_xz != 0u) {
5055 if (nibble_xz == nibble_mask && nibble_val == 0u) {
5056 out.push_back('z');
5057 } else {
5058 out.push_back('x');
5059 }
5060 } else {
5061 static const char kDigits[] = "0123456789abcdef";
5062 out.push_back(kDigits[nibble_val & 0xFu]);
5063 }
5064 }
5065 return out;
5066}
5067
5068bool ApplyWritemem(const std::string& filename, bool is_hex,
5069 const gpga::SignalInfo& signal, bool four_state,
5070 std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>* buffers,
5071 uint64_t start, uint64_t end, std::string* error) {
5072 if (!buffers) {
5073 return false;
5074 }
5075 std::ofstream out(filename, std::ios::out | std::ios::trunc);
5076 if (!out) {
5077 if (error) {
5078 *error = "failed to open writemem file: " + filename;
5079 }
5080 return false;
5081 }
5082 const std::string base = MslSignalName(signal.name);
5083 auto it_val = buffers->find(base + "_val");
5084 if (it_val == buffers->end()) {
5085 it_val = buffers->find(base);
5086 }
5087 if (it_val == buffers->end()) {
5088 if (error) {
5089 *error = "writemem target buffer not found: " + signal.name;
5090 }
5091 return false;
5092 }
5093 gpga::MetalBuffer* val_buf = &it_val->second;
5094 gpga::MetalBuffer* xz_buf = nullptr;
5095 if (four_state) {
5096 auto it_xz = buffers->find(base + "_xz");
5097 if (it_xz != buffers->end()) {
5098 xz_buf = &it_xz->second;
5099 }
5100 }
5101 uint32_t width = signal.is_real ? 64u : signal.width;
5102 if (width == 0u) {
5103 width = 1u;
5104 }
5105 uint32_t array_size = signal.array_size > 0 ? signal.array_size : 1u;
5106 if (end == std::numeric_limits<uint64_t>::max()) {
5107 end = (array_size > 0) ? static_cast<uint64_t>(array_size - 1u) : 0u;
5108 }
5109 if (start > end) {
5110 std::swap(start, end);
5111 }
5112 if (array_size == 0 || start >= array_size) {
5113 return true;
5114 }
5115 uint64_t limit_end = std::min<uint64_t>(end, array_size - 1u);
5116 for (uint64_t addr = start; addr <= limit_end; ++addr) {
5117 if (width <= 64u) {
5118 uint64_t val = 0;
5119 uint64_t xz = 0;
5120 if (!ReadSignalWordFromBuffer(signal, 0u, addr, *val_buf, 0u, &val)) {
5121 break;
5122 }
5123 if (four_state && xz_buf) {
5124 ReadSignalWordFromBuffer(signal, 0u, addr, *xz_buf, 0u, &xz);
5125 }
5126 out << FormatMemWord(val, xz, width, is_hex, four_state) << "\n";
5127 } else {
5128 const size_t word_count = SignalWordCount(signal);
5129 std::vector<uint64_t> val_words(word_count, 0ull);
5130 std::vector<uint64_t> xz_words(word_count, 0ull);
5131 bool ok = true;
5132 for (size_t word = 0; word < word_count; ++word) {
5133 if (!ReadSignalWordFromBuffer(signal, 0u, addr, *val_buf, word,
5134 &val_words[word])) {
5135 ok = false;
5136 break;
5137 }
5138 if (four_state && xz_buf) {
5139 ReadSignalWordFromBuffer(signal, 0u, addr, *xz_buf, word,
5140 &xz_words[word]);
5141 }
5142 }
5143 if (!ok) {
5144 break;
5145 }
5146 out << FormatMemWords(val_words, xz_words, width, is_hex, four_state)
5147 << "\n";
5148 }
5149 if (!out) {
5150 if (error) {
5151 *error = "failed to write writemem file: " + filename;
5152 }
5153 return false;
5154 }
5155 }
5156 return true;
5157}
5158
5159bool HandleServiceRecords(
5160 const std::vector<DecodedServiceRecord>& records,
5161 const gpga::ServiceStringTable& strings, const gpga::ModuleInfo& module,
5162 const std::string& vcd_dir,
5163 const std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string>* flat_to_hier,
5164 const PackedStateLayout* packed_layout,
5165 const std::string& timescale,
5166 bool four_state, uint32_t instance_count, uint32_t gid,
5167 uint32_t proc_count, FileTable* files,
5168 const std::vector<std::string>& plusargs,
5169 std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>* buffers,
5170 VcdWriter* vcd, gpga::ServiceDrainResult* result,
5171 std::string* dumpfile, std::string* error) {
5172 if (!buffers || !vcd || !dumpfile || !files) {
5173 return false;
5174 }
5175 if (result) {
5176 result->saw_finish = false;
5177 result->saw_stop = false;
5178 result->saw_error = false;
5179 }
5180 g_timescale_exp = ParseTimescaleExponent(timescale);
5181 auto current_time = [&]() -> uint64_t {
5182 auto time_it = buffers->find("sched_time");
5183 if (time_it != buffers->end() && time_it->second.contents()) {
5184 uint64_t time = 0;
5185 std::memcpy(&time, time_it->second.contents(), sizeof(time));
5186 return time;
5187 }
5188 return 0;
5189 };
5190 constexpr uint32_t kWaitNone = 0u;
5191 constexpr uint32_t kWaitService = 7u;
5192 constexpr uint32_t kProcReady = 0u;
5193 gpga::MetalBuffer* wait_kind_buf =
5194 FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_wait_kind", "");
5195 gpga::MetalBuffer* wait_time_buf =
5196 FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_wait_time", "");
5197 gpga::MetalBuffer* state_buf =
5198 FindBufferMutable(buffers, "sched_state", "");
5199 auto* wait_kind_ptr =
5200 wait_kind_buf ? static_cast<uint32_t*>(wait_kind_buf->contents()) : nullptr;
5201 auto* wait_time_ptr =
5202 wait_time_buf ? static_cast<uint64_t*>(wait_time_buf->contents()) : nullptr;
5203 auto* state_ptr =
5204 state_buf ? static_cast<uint32_t*>(state_buf->contents()) : nullptr;
5205 auto resume_service = [&](uint32_t pid, uint64_t value) {
5206 if (!wait_kind_ptr || !wait_time_ptr || !state_ptr) {
5207 return;
5208 }
5209 size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(gid) * proc_count + pid;
5210 if (wait_kind_buf &&
5211 wait_kind_buf->length() < (idx + 1u) * sizeof(uint32_t)) {
5212 return;
5213 }
5214 if (wait_time_buf &&
5215 wait_time_buf->length() < (idx + 1u) * sizeof(uint64_t)) {
5216 return;
5217 }
5218 if (state_buf &&
5219 state_buf->length() < (idx + 1u) * sizeof(uint32_t)) {
5220 return;
5221 }
5222 if (wait_kind_ptr[idx] != kWaitService) {
5223 return;
5224 }
5225 wait_time_ptr[idx] = value;
5226 wait_kind_ptr[idx] = kWaitNone;
5227 state_ptr[idx] = kProcReady;
5228 };
5229 const gpga::MetalBuffer* packed_state_buf =
5230 packed_layout ? FindBuffer(*buffers, "gpga_state", "") : nullptr;
5231 gpga::MetalBuffer* packed_state_buf_mut =
5232 packed_layout ? FindBufferMutable(buffers, "gpga_state", "") : nullptr;
5233 auto read_signal_word = [&](const gpga::SignalInfo& sig, uint64_t array_index,
5234 size_t word_index, uint64_t* value_out) -> bool {
5235 if (ReadSignalWord(sig, gid, array_index, *buffers, word_index, value_out)) {
5236 return true;
5237 }
5238 if (!packed_layout || !packed_state_buf) {
5239 return false;
5240 }
5241 const PackedSignalOffsets* packed = packed_layout->Find(sig.name);
5242 if (!packed || !packed->has_val) {
5243 return false;
5244 }
5245 return ReadPackedSignalWordFromBuffer(
5246 sig, gid, array_index, *packed_state_buf, packed->val_offset,
5247 word_index, value_out);
5248 };
5249 auto read_signal_string =
5250 [&](const gpga::SignalInfo& sig) -> std::string {
5251 size_t max_bytes = (SignalBitWidth(sig) + 7u) / 8u;
5252 size_t word_count = SignalWordCount(sig);
5253 std::vector<uint64_t> words(word_count, 0ull);
5254 for (size_t i = 0; i < word_count; ++i) {
5255 if (!read_signal_word(sig, 0u, i, &words[i])) {
5256 return {};
5257 }
5258 }
5259 return UnpackStringWords(words, max_bytes);
5260 };
5261 auto write_signal_word =
5262 [&](const gpga::SignalInfo& sig, uint64_t array_index, size_t word_index,
5263 uint64_t value, uint64_t xz) -> bool {
5264 if (WriteSignalWord(sig, gid, array_index, word_index, value, xz,
5265 four_state, buffers)) {
5266 return true;
5267 }
5268 if (!packed_layout || !packed_state_buf_mut ||
5269 !packed_state_buf_mut->contents()) {
5270 return false;
5271 }
5272 const PackedSignalOffsets* packed = packed_layout->Find(sig.name);
5273 if (!packed || !packed->has_val) {
5274 return false;
5275 }
5276 if (!WritePackedSignalWordToBuffer(sig, gid, array_index,
5277 packed_state_buf_mut,
5278 packed->val_offset, word_index, value)) {
5279 return false;
5280 }
5281 if (four_state && packed->has_xz) {
5282 if (!WritePackedSignalWordToBuffer(sig, gid, array_index,
5283 packed_state_buf_mut,
5284 packed->xz_offset, word_index, xz)) {
5285 return false;
5286 }
5287 }
5288 return true;
5289 };
5290 auto write_signal_value = [&](const gpga::SignalInfo& sig,
5291 uint64_t array_index, uint64_t value,
5292 uint64_t xz) -> bool {
5293 size_t word_count = SignalWordCount(sig);
5294 if (!write_signal_word(sig, array_index, 0u, value, xz)) {
5295 return false;
5296 }
5297 for (size_t i = 1; i < word_count; ++i) {
5298 if (!write_signal_word(sig, array_index, i, 0ull, 0ull)) {
5299 return false;
5300 }
5301 }
5302 return true;
5303 };
5304 auto resolve_string_or_ident = [&](const gpga::ServiceArgView& arg) -> std::string {
5305 if (arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kString ||
5306 arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kIdent) {
5307 std::string value =
5308 ResolveString(strings, static_cast<uint32_t>(arg.value));
5309 if (arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kIdent) {
5310 const gpga::SignalInfo* sig = FindSignalInfo(module, value);
5311 if (sig) {
5312 return read_signal_string(*sig);
5313 }
5314 }
5315 return value;
5316 }
5317 return {};
5318 };
5319 auto write_output_arg =
5320 [&](const gpga::ServiceArgView& arg, uint64_t value,
5321 const std::string& str_value,
5322 const std::vector<uint64_t>* wide_words) -> bool {
5323 if (arg.kind != gpga::ServiceArgKind::kIdent) {
5324 return false;
5325 }
5326 std::string name = ResolveString(strings, static_cast<uint32_t>(arg.value));
5327 const gpga::SignalInfo* sig = FindSignalInfo(module, name);
5328 if (!sig) {
5329 return false;
5330 }
5331 if (!str_value.empty()) {
5332 size_t max_bytes = (SignalBitWidth(*sig) + 7u) / 8u;
5333 std::vector<uint64_t> words = PackStringWords(str_value, max_bytes);
5334 for (size_t i = 0; i < words.size(); ++i) {
5335 if (!write_signal_word(*sig, 0u, i, words[i], 0ull)) {
5336 return false;
5337 }
5338 }
5339 return true;
5340 }
5341 uint32_t width = arg.width > 0 ? arg.width : sig->width;
5342 if (width > 64u && wide_words && !wide_words->empty()) {
5343 size_t word_count = SignalWordCount(*sig);
5344 for (size_t i = 0; i < word_count; ++i) {
5345 uint64_t word = (i < wide_words->size()) ? (*wide_words)[i] : 0ull;
5346 if (!write_signal_word(*sig, 0u, i, word, 0ull)) {
5347 return false;
5348 }
5349 }
5350 return true;
5351 }
5352 uint64_t masked = value & MaskForWidth(width);
5353 return write_signal_value(*sig, 0u, masked, 0ull);
5354 };
5355 std::unordered_map<uint32_t, size_t> last_record_for_pid;
5356 last_record_for_pid.reserve(records.size());
5357 for (size_t i = 0; i < records.size(); ++i) {
5358 last_record_for_pid[records[i].pid] = i;
5359 }
5360 auto should_resume = [&](const DecodedServiceRecord& rec,
5361 size_t record_index) -> bool {
5362 auto it = last_record_for_pid.find(rec.pid);
5363 return it != last_record_for_pid.end() && it->second == record_index;
5364 };
5365 auto resume_if_waiting = [&](const DecodedServiceRecord& rec,
5366 size_t record_index, uint64_t value) -> void {
5367 if (!should_resume(rec, record_index)) {
5368 return;
5369 }
5370 resume_service(rec.pid, value);

5372 for (size_t record_index = 0; record_index < records.size();
5373 ++record_index) {
5374 const auto& rec = records[record_index];
5375 switch (rec.kind) {

5382 case gpga::ServiceKind::kDumpvars: {

5394 arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kIdent) {
5395 targets.push_back(ResolveString(strings,
5396 static_cast<uint32_t>(arg.value)));

5399 if (!vcd->Start(*dumpfile, vcd_dir, module, targets, depth, four_state,
5400 *buffers, timescale, instance_count, flat_to_hier,

5402 return false;

5407 if (arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kString ||
5408 arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kIdent) {

5410 << ResolveString(strings, static_cast<uint32_t>(arg.value));
5411 } else {
5412 std::cout << FormatNumeric(arg, 'h', four_state);

5415 std::cout << "\n";

5418 case gpga::ServiceKind::kShowcancelled: {

5426 }
5427 if (rec.args.size() > 2) {

5484 std::string fmt = (rec.format_id != 0xFFFFFFFFu)

5624 case gpga::ServiceKind::kFdisplay:

5781 case gpga::ServiceKind::kFeof: {

5786 }
5787 uint32_t fd = static_cast<uint32_t>(rec.args.front().value);
5788 auto file_it = files->handles.find(fd);
5789 uint64_t value = 1;
5790 if (file_it != files->handles.end() && file_it->second.file) {
5791 value = std::feof(file_it->second.file) ? 1u : 0u;
5792 }
5793 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, value);
5794 break;
5795 }
5796 case gpga::ServiceKind::kFerror: {
5797 if (rec.args.empty() ||
5798 rec.args.front().kind != gpga::ServiceArgKind::kValue) {
5799 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, 1);
5800 break;
5801 }
5802 uint32_t fd = static_cast<uint32_t>(rec.args.front().value);
5803 auto file_it = files->handles.find(fd);
5804 uint64_t value = 1;
5805 if (file_it != files->handles.end() && file_it->second.file) {
5806 value = std::ferror(file_it->second.file) ? 1u : 0u;
5807 }
5808 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, value);
5809 break;
5810 }
5811 case gpga::ServiceKind::kFseek: {
5812 if (rec.args.size() < 3 ||
5813 rec.args[0].kind != gpga::ServiceArgKind::kValue ||
5814 rec.args[1].kind != gpga::ServiceArgKind::kValue ||
5815 rec.args[2].kind != gpga::ServiceArgKind::kValue) {
5816 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, 1);
5817 break;
5818 }
5819 uint32_t fd = static_cast<uint32_t>(rec.args[0].value);
5820 int64_t offset = SignExtend(rec.args[1].value, rec.args[1].width);
5821 int origin = static_cast<int>(rec.args[2].value);
5822 auto file_it = files->handles.find(fd);
5823 uint64_t value = 1;
5824 if (file_it != files->handles.end() && file_it->second.file) {
5825 int rc = std::fseek(file_it->second.file, static_cast<long>(offset),
5826 origin);
5827 value = (rc == 0) ? 0u : 1u;
5828 }
5829 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, value);
5830 break;
5831 }
5832 case gpga::ServiceKind::kFungetc: {
5833 if (rec.args.size() < 2 ||
5834 rec.args[0].kind != gpga::ServiceArgKind::kValue ||
5835 rec.args[1].kind != gpga::ServiceArgKind::kValue) {
5836 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, 0xFFFFFFFFull);
5837 break;
5838 }
5839 uint64_t ch = rec.args[0].value & 0xFFu;
5840 uint32_t fd = static_cast<uint32_t>(rec.args[1].value);
5841 auto file_it = files->handles.find(fd);
5842 uint64_t value = 0xFFFFFFFFull;
5843 if (file_it != files->handles.end() && file_it->second.file) {
5844 int rc = std::ungetc(static_cast<unsigned char>(ch),
5845 file_it->second.file);
5846 if (rc != EOF) {
5847 value = static_cast<uint32_t>(static_cast<unsigned char>(rc));
5848 }
5849 }
5850 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, value);
5851 break;
5852 }
5853 case gpga::ServiceKind::kFread: {
5854 if (rec.args.size() < 2 ||
5855 rec.args[0].kind != gpga::ServiceArgKind::kIdent ||
5856 rec.args[1].kind != gpga::ServiceArgKind::kValue) {
5857 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, 0);
5858 break;
5859 }
5860 std::string target =
5861 ResolveString(strings, static_cast<uint32_t>(rec.args[0].value));
5862 const gpga::SignalInfo* sig = FindSignalInfo(module, target);
5863 if (!sig) {
5864 if (error) {
5865 *error = "fread target not found: " + target;
5866 }
5867 return false;
5868 }
5869 uint32_t fd = static_cast<uint32_t>(rec.args[1].value);
5870 auto file_it = files->handles.find(fd);
5871 if (file_it == files->handles.end() || !file_it->second.file) {
5872 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, 0);
5873 break;
5874 }
5875 uint32_t width = sig->is_real ? 64u : sig->width;
5876 if (width == 0u) {
5877 width = 1u;
5878 }
5879 size_t elem_bytes = (width + 7u) / 8u;
5880 size_t word_count = SignalWordCount(*sig);
5881 if (elem_bytes == 0) {
5882 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, 0);
5883 break;
5884 }
5885 auto read_element =
5886 [&](std::vector<uint64_t>* out_val_words,
5887 std::vector<uint64_t>* out_xz_words) -> size_t {
5888 if (!out_val_words || !out_xz_words) {
5889 return 0;
5890 }
5891 std::vector<unsigned char> buffer(elem_bytes, 0);
5892 size_t bytes_read =
5893 std::fread(buffer.data(), 1, elem_bytes, file_it->second.file);
5894 if (bytes_read == 0) {
5895 return 0;
5896 }
5897 out_val_words->assign(word_count, 0ull);
5898 out_xz_words->assign(word_count, 0ull);
5899 size_t start_pos = elem_bytes - bytes_read;
5900 for (size_t i = 0; i < bytes_read; ++i) {
5901 size_t pos = start_pos + (bytes_read - 1u - i);
5902 uint32_t bit_pos = static_cast<uint32_t>(pos * 8u);
5903 uint32_t word_index = bit_pos / 64u;
5904 uint32_t word_bit = bit_pos % 64u;
5905 uint64_t byte_val = static_cast<uint64_t>(buffer[i]);
5906 if (word_index < out_val_words->size()) {
5907 (*out_val_words)[word_index] |= (byte_val << word_bit);
5908 }
5909 if (word_bit > 56u && word_index + 1u < out_val_words->size()) {
5910 (*out_val_words)[word_index + 1u] |=
5911 (byte_val >> (64u - word_bit));
5912 }
5913 }
5914 if (four_state && bytes_read < elem_bytes) {
5915 for (size_t pos = 0; pos < start_pos; ++pos) {
5916 uint32_t bit_pos = static_cast<uint32_t>(pos * 8u);
5917 uint32_t word_index = bit_pos / 64u;
5918 uint32_t word_bit = bit_pos % 64u;
5919 uint64_t byte_mask = 0xFFull;
5920 if (word_index < out_xz_words->size()) {
5921 (*out_xz_words)[word_index] |= (byte_mask << word_bit);
5922 }
5923 if (word_bit > 56u && word_index + 1u < out_xz_words->size()) {
5924 (*out_xz_words)[word_index + 1u] |=
5925 (byte_mask >> (64u - word_bit));
5926 }
5927 }
5928 }
5929 uint32_t tail_bits = width % 64u;
5930 if (tail_bits != 0u && !out_val_words->empty()) {
5931 uint64_t mask = (1ull << tail_bits) - 1ull;
5932 (*out_val_words)[out_val_words->size() - 1u] &= mask;
5933 (*out_xz_words)[out_xz_words->size() - 1u] &= mask;
5934 }
5935 return bytes_read;
5936 };
5937
5938 size_t array_size = sig->array_size > 0 ? sig->array_size : 1u;
5939 if (array_size <= 1u) {
5940 std::vector<uint64_t> val_words;
5941 std::vector<uint64_t> xz_words;
5942 size_t bytes_read = read_element(&val_words, &xz_words);
5943 if (bytes_read == 0) {
5944 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, 0);
5945 break;
5946 }
5947 for (size_t w = 0; w < word_count; ++w) {
5948 uint64_t word = w < val_words.size() ? val_words[w] : 0ull;
5949 uint64_t xz_word = w < xz_words.size() ? xz_words[w] : 0ull;
5950 write_signal_word(*sig, 0u, w, word, xz_word);
5951 }
5952 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, static_cast<uint64_t>(bytes_read));
5953 break;
5954 }
5955
5956 int64_t start = 0;
5957 int64_t count = -1;
5958 if (rec.args.size() >= 3 &&
5959 rec.args[2].kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kValue) {
5960 start = SignExtend(rec.args[2].value, rec.args[2].width);
5961 }
5962 if (rec.args.size() >= 4 &&
5963 rec.args[3].kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kValue) {
5964 count = SignExtend(rec.args[3].value, rec.args[3].width);
5965 }
5966 if (start < 0 || count == 0) {
5967 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, 0);
5968 break;
5969 }
5970 uint64_t start_index = static_cast<uint64_t>(start);
5971 if (start_index >= array_size) {
5972 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, 0);
5973 break;
5974 }
5975 uint64_t max_elements = array_size - start_index;
5976 if (count > 0) {
5977 max_elements = std::min<uint64_t>(max_elements, count);
5978 }
5979 uint64_t total_read = 0;
5980 for (uint64_t i = 0; i < max_elements; ++i) {
5981 std::vector<uint64_t> val_words;
5982 std::vector<uint64_t> xz_words;
5983 size_t bytes_read = read_element(&val_words, &xz_words);
5984 if (bytes_read == 0) {
5985 break;
5986 }
5987 for (size_t w = 0; w < word_count; ++w) {
5988 uint64_t word = w < val_words.size() ? val_words[w] : 0ull;
5989 uint64_t xz_word = w < xz_words.size() ? xz_words[w] : 0ull;
5990 write_signal_word(*sig, start_index + i, w, word, xz_word);
5991 }
5992 total_read += bytes_read;
5993 if (bytes_read < elem_bytes) {
5994 break;
5995 }
5996 }
5997 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, total_read);
5998 break;
5999 }
6000 case gpga::ServiceKind::kFtell: {
6001 if (rec.args.empty() ||
6002 rec.args.front().kind != gpga::ServiceArgKind::kValue) {
6003 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull);
6004 break;
6005 }
6006 uint32_t fd = static_cast<uint32_t>(rec.args.front().value);
6007 auto file_it = files->handles.find(fd);
6008 uint64_t value = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull;
6009 if (file_it != files->handles.end() && file_it->second.file) {

6017 }
6018 case gpga::ServiceKind::kFscanf: {
6019 if (rec.args.size() < 2 ||
6020 rec.args[0].kind != gpga::ServiceArgKind::kValue) {

6022 break;
6023 }
6024 uint32_t fd = static_cast<uint32_t>(rec.args[0].value);
6025 auto file_it = files->handles.find(fd);

6030 std::string fmt = (rec.format_id != 0xFFFFFFFFu)

6033 std::vector<FormatSpec> specs = ParseFormatSpecs(fmt);
6034 int assigned = 0;
6035 bool eof_before = false;
6036 size_t arg_index = 1;
6037 for (size_t spec_index = 0; spec_index < specs.size(); ++spec_index) {
6038 const FormatSpec& spec = specs[spec_index];
6039 std::string token;
6040 bool token_eof = false;
6041 if (!ReadTokenFromFile(file_it->second.file, &token, &token_eof)) {
6042 eof_before = token_eof && (assigned == 0);

6044 }
6045 if (spec.suppress) {
6046 std::vector<uint64_t> ignored_words;
6047 std::string ignored_str;

6049 &ignored_str)) {
6050 break;

6057 }
6058 if (arg_index >= rec.args.size()) {
6059 break;
6060 }
6061 uint32_t target_width = rec.args[arg_index].width;
6062 if (target_width == 0u) {
6063 target_width = 64u;
6064 }
6065 std::vector<uint64_t> words;
6066 std::string str_value;
6067 if (!ParseTokenWords(token, spec.spec, target_width, &words,
6068 &str_value)) {
6069 break;
6070 }
6071 uint64_t value = words.empty() ? 0ull : words[0];
6072 const std::vector<uint64_t>* wide_words =
6073 (target_width > 64u) ? &words : nullptr;
6074 write_output_arg(rec.args[arg_index], value, str_value, wide_words);
6075 assigned++;
6076 ++arg_index;
6077 }
6078 if (specs.empty()) {
6079 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, 0);
6080 break;
6081 }
6082 if (eof_before) {
6083 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, 0xFFFFFFFFull);
6084 } else {
6085 resume_if_waiting(rec, record_index, static_cast<uint64_t>(assigned));
6086 }
6087 break;
6088 }

6149 case gpga::ServiceKind::kDumpoff: {
6150 vcd->SetDumping(false);
6151 std::cout << "$dumpoff (pid=" << rec.pid << ")\n";
6152 break;
6153 }
6154 case gpga::ServiceKind::kDumpon: {
6155 vcd->SetDumping(true);
6156 vcd->ForceSnapshot(current_time(), *buffers);
6157 std::cout << "$dumpon (pid=" << rec.pid << ")\n";

6159 }
6160 case gpga::ServiceKind::kDumpflush: {
6161 vcd->Flush();
6162 std::cout << "$dumpflush (pid=" << rec.pid << ")\n";
6163 break;
6164 }
6165 case gpga::ServiceKind::kDumpall: {
6166 vcd->ForceSnapshot(current_time(), *buffers);

6168 break;
6169 }
6170 case gpga::ServiceKind::kDumplimit: {
6171 uint64_t limit = 0;
6172 if (!rec.args.empty() &&
6173 rec.args[0].kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kValue) {
6174 limit = rec.args[0].value;
6175 }
6176 vcd->SetDumpLimit(limit);
6177 std::cout << "$dumplimit (pid=" << rec.pid << ")";
6178 if (!rec.args.empty()) {
6179 std::cout << " " << FormatNumeric(rec.args.front(), 'h', four_state);
6180 }
6181 std::cout << "\n";
6182 break;
6183 }
6184 case gpga::ServiceKind::kReadmemh:
6185 case gpga::ServiceKind::kReadmemb: {
6186 std::string label =
6187 (rec.kind == gpga::ServiceKind::kReadmemh) ? "$readmemh"
6188 : "$readmemb";
6189 std::string filename_expr = ResolveString(strings, rec.format_id);
6190 std::string filename = filename_expr;
6191 if (buffers && !filename_expr.empty()) {
6192 const gpga::SignalInfo* file_sig =
6193 FindSignalInfo(module, filename_expr);
6194 if (file_sig) {
6195 std::string file_value = read_signal_string(*file_sig);
6196 if (!file_value.empty()) {
6197 filename = file_value;
6198 }
6199 }
6200 }
6201 std::string target;
6202 uint64_t start = 0;
6203 uint64_t end = std::numeric_limits<uint64_t>::max();
6204 bool seen_target = false;
6205 bool seen_start = false;
6206 for (const auto& arg : rec.args) {
6207 if (arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kIdent ||
6208 arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kString) {
6209 if (!seen_target) {
6210 std::string arg_text =
6211 ResolveString(strings, static_cast<uint32_t>(arg.value));
6212 if (!filename_expr.empty() && arg_text == filename_expr) {
6213 continue;
6214 }
6215 target = std::move(arg_text);
6216 seen_target = true;
6217 continue;
6218 }
6219 }
6220 if (seen_target && arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kValue) {
6221 if (!seen_start) {
6222 start = arg.value;
6223 seen_start = true;
6224 } else if (end == std::numeric_limits<uint64_t>::max()) {
6225 end = arg.value;
6226 }
6227 }
6228 }
6229 if (target.empty()) {
6230 continue;
6231 }
6232 auto it = std::find_if(module.signals.begin(), module.signals.end(),
6233 [&](const gpga::SignalInfo& sig) {

6242 bool is_hex = rec.kind == gpga::ServiceKind::kReadmemh;
6243 if (!ApplyReadmem(filename, is_hex, *it, four_state, buffers,

6245 instance_count, start, end, error)) {
6246 return false;
6247 }
6248 std::cout << label << " \"" << filename << "\" (pid=" << rec.pid << ")";
6249 for (const auto& arg : rec.args) {
6250 std::cout << " ";
6251 if (arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kString ||
6252 arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kIdent) {
6253 std::cout
6254 << ResolveString(strings, static_cast<uint32_t>(arg.value));
6255 } else {
6256 std::cout << FormatNumeric(arg, 'h', four_state);
6257 }
6258 }
6259 std::cout << "\n";
6260 break;
6261 }
6262 case gpga::ServiceKind::kWritememh:
6263 case gpga::ServiceKind::kWritememb: {
6264 std::string label =
6265 (rec.kind == gpga::ServiceKind::kWritememh) ? "$writememh"
6266 : "$writememb";
6267 std::string filename = ResolveString(strings, rec.format_id);
6268 std::string target;
6269 uint64_t start = 0;
6270 uint64_t end = std::numeric_limits<uint64_t>::max();
6271 bool seen_target = false;
6272 bool seen_start = false;
6273 for (const auto& arg : rec.args) {
6274 if (arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kIdent ||
6275 arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kString) {
6276 if (!seen_target &&
6277 arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kString &&
6278 arg.value == static_cast<uint64_t>(rec.format_id)) {
6279 continue;
6280 }
6281 if (!seen_target) {
6282 target =
6283 ResolveString(strings, static_cast<uint32_t>(arg.value));
6284 seen_target = true;
6285 continue;
6286 }
6287 }
6288 if (seen_target && arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kValue) {
6289 if (!seen_start) {
6290 start = arg.value;
6291 seen_start = true;
6292 } else if (end == std::numeric_limits<uint64_t>::max()) {
6293 end = arg.value;
6294 }
6295 }
6296 }
6297 if (target.empty()) {
6298 continue;
6299 }
6300 auto it = std::find_if(module.signals.begin(), module.signals.end(),
6301 [&](const gpga::SignalInfo& sig) {
6302 return sig.name == target;
6303 });
6304 if (it == module.signals.end()) {
6305 if (error) {
6306 *error = "writemem target not found: " + target;
6307 }
6308 return false;
6309 }
6310 bool is_hex = rec.kind == gpga::ServiceKind::kWritememh;
6311 if (!ApplyWritemem(filename, is_hex, *it, four_state, buffers, start,
6312 end, error)) {
6313 return false;
6314 }
6315 std::cout << label << " \"" << filename << "\" (pid=" << rec.pid << ")";
6316 for (const auto& arg : rec.args) {
6317 std::cout << " ";
6318 if (arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kString ||
6319 arg.kind == gpga::ServiceArgKind::kIdent) {

6321 << ResolveString(strings, static_cast<uint32_t>(arg.value));
6322 } else {
6323 std::cout << FormatNumeric(arg, 'h', four_state);
6324 }
6325 }
6326 std::cout << "\n";
6327 break;
6328 }
6329 default:
6330 if (result) {
6331 result->saw_error = true;
6332 }
6333 std::cout << "unknown service kind " << static_cast<uint32_t>(rec.kind)
6334 << " (pid=" << rec.pid << ")\n";
6335 break;
6336 }
6337 }
6338 return true;
6339}
