6341bool HasKernel(const std::string& msl, const std::string& name) {
6342 return msl.find("kernel void " + name) != std::string::npos;
6343}
6344
6345void MergeSpecs(std::unordered_map<std::string, size_t>* lengths,
6346 const std::vector<gpga::BufferSpec>& specs) {
6347 if (!lengths) {
6348 return;
6349 }
6350 for (const auto& spec : specs) {
6351 size_t& current = (*lengths)[spec.name];
6352 current = std::max(current, spec.length);
6353 }
6354}
6355
6356bool BuildBindings(const gpga::MetalKernel& kernel,
6357 const std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>& buffers,
6358 std::vector<gpga::MetalBufferBinding>* bindings,
6359 std::string* error) {
6360 if (!bindings) {
6361 return false;
6362 }
6363 bindings->clear();
6364 for (const auto& entry : kernel.BufferIndices()) {
6365 auto it = buffers.find(entry.first);
6366 if (it == buffers.end()) {
6367 if (error) {
6368 *error = "missing buffer for " + entry.first;
6369 }
6370 return false;
6371 }
6372 bindings->push_back({entry.second, &it->second, 0});
6373 }
6374 return true;
6375}

6377bool BuildSchedulerArgBuffer(
6378 gpga::MetalRuntime* runtime, const gpga::MetalKernel& kernel,
6379 const gpga::SchedulerConstants& sched, bool four_state,

6474 !add_binding("sched_join_tag")) {

6476 }
6477 if (has_repeat) {

6481 }
6482 }
6483 if (!add_binding("sched_time") || !add_binding("sched_phase") ||

6496 if (has_delayed_assigns) {

6502 }
6503 if (!add_binding("sched_delay_index_val")) {

6505 }
6506 if (four_state && !add_binding("sched_delay_index_xz")) {

6508 }
6509 }
6510 if (has_delayed_nba) {
6511 if (!add_binding("sched_dnba_count") ||
6512 !add_binding("sched_dnba_time") ||
6513 !add_binding("sched_dnba_id") ||
6514 !add_binding("sched_dnba_val")) {
6515 return false;
6516 }
6517 if (four_state && !add_binding("sched_dnba_xz")) {
6518 return false;
6519 }
6520 if (!add_binding("sched_dnba_index_val")) {
6521 return false;
6522 }
6523 if (four_state && !add_binding("sched_dnba_index_xz")) {
6524 return false;
6525 }
6526 }
6527 if (has_monitor) {
6528 if (!add_binding("sched_monitor_active") ||

6552 const uint32_t arg_index = kernel.BufferIndex("sched_args");
6553 gpga::MetalBuffer arg_buffer;
6554 if (!runtime->EncodeArgumentBuffer(kernel, arg_index, bindings, &arg_buffer,
6555 error)) {

6645
6646void SwapNextBuffers(std::unordered_map<std::string, gpga::MetalBuffer>* buffers) {
6647 if (!buffers) {
6648 return;
6649 }
6650 std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> swaps;
6651 for (const auto& entry : *buffers) {
6652 const std::string& name = entry.first;
6653 if (name.size() > 9 && name.compare(name.size() - 9, 9, "_next_val") == 0) {
6654 swaps.emplace_back(name.substr(0, name.size() - 9) + "_val", name);
6655 } else if (name.size() > 8 &&
6656 name.compare(name.size() - 8, 8, "_next_xz") == 0) {
6657 swaps.emplace_back(name.substr(0, name.size() - 8) + "_xz", name);
6658 } else if (name.size() > 5 &&
6659 name.compare(name.size() - 5, 5, "_next") == 0) {
6660 swaps.emplace_back(name.substr(0, name.size() - 5), name);
6661 }
6662 }
6663 for (const auto& pair : swaps) {
6664 auto it_a = buffers->find(pair.first);
6665 auto it_b = buffers->find(pair.second);
6666 if (it_a != buffers->end() && it_b != buffers->end()) {
6667 std::swap(it_a->second, it_b->second);
6668 }
6669 }
6670}
6671
6672bool RunMetal(const gpga::Module& module, const std::string& msl,
6673 const std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string>& flat_to_hier,
6674 bool enable_4state, uint32_t count, uint32_t service_capacity,
6675 uint32_t max_steps, uint32_t max_proc_steps,
6676 uint32_t dispatch_timeout_ms,
6677 bool run_verbose,
6678 bool source_bindings,
6679 const std::string& vcd_dir, uint32_t vcd_steps,
6680 const std::vector<std::string>& plusargs,
6681 std::string* error) {
6682 gpga::MetalRuntime runtime;
6683 runtime.SetPreferSourceBindings(source_bindings);
6684 if (run_verbose) {
6685 std::cerr << "Compiling Metal source (" << msl.size() << " bytes)...\n";
6686 }
6687 auto compile_start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
6688 if (!runtime.CompileSource(msl, {"include"}, error)) {
6689 return false;
6690 }
6691 if (run_verbose) {
6692 auto compile_ms = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
6693 std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - compile_start);
6694 std::cerr << "Compile finished in " << compile_ms.count() << " ms\n";
6695 }
6696
6697 const std::string base = "gpga_" + gpga::MslMangleIdentifier(module.name);
6698 const bool has_sched = HasKernel(msl, base + "_sched_step");
6699 const bool has_fallback_kernel = HasKernel(msl, base);
6700 const bool has_init = HasKernel(msl, base + "_init");
6701 const bool has_tick = HasKernel(msl, base + "_tick");
6702 const bool ready_diag = EnvEnabled("METALFPGA_SCHED_READY_DIAG");
6703 const bool exec_ready_diag = EnvEnabled("METALFPGA_SCHED_EXEC_READY_DIAG");
6704 const bool wait_eval_diag = EnvEnabled("METALFPGA_SCHED_WAIT_EVAL_DIAG");
6705 const bool exec_ready_enabled =
6706 exec_ready_diag || EnvEnabled("METALFPGA_SCHED_EXEC_READY");
6707 const bool ready_enabled =
6708 ready_diag || exec_ready_enabled ||
6709 EnvEnabled("METALFPGA_SCHED_READY");
6710 const bool wait_eval_enabled =
6711 wait_eval_diag || exec_ready_enabled ||
6712 EnvEnabled("METALFPGA_SCHED_WAIT_EVAL");
6713 const auto ready_batch_pref =
6714 EnvTriState("METALFPGA_SCHED_READY_BATCH");
6715 const auto sched_batch_pref =
6716 EnvTriState("METALFPGA_SCHED_BATCH");
6717 bool ready_batch = ready_batch_pref.value_or(exec_ready_enabled);
6718 bool sched_batch = sched_batch_pref.value_or(exec_ready_enabled);
6719 uint32_t ready_every =
6720 std::max<uint32_t>(1u, EnvUint("METALFPGA_SCHED_READY_EVERY", 1u));
6721 uint32_t service_drain_every =
6722 std::max<uint32_t>(1u,
6723 EnvUint("METALFPGA_SCHED_SERVICE_DRAIN_EVERY", 1u));
6724 if (exec_ready_enabled && ready_every != 1u) {
6725 if (run_verbose) {
6726 std::cerr << "sched ready every overridden to 1 for exec-ready mode\n";
6727 }
6728 ready_every = 1u;
6729 }
6730 const bool has_sched_ready_flags =
6731 has_sched && HasKernel(msl, base + "_sched_ready_flags");
6732 const bool has_sched_ready_reset =
6733 has_sched && HasKernel(msl, base + "_sched_ready_reset");
6734 const bool has_sched_ready_compact =
6735 has_sched && HasKernel(msl, base + "_sched_ready_compact");
6736 const bool has_sched_ready_dispatch =
6737 has_sched && HasKernel(msl, base + "_sched_ready_dispatch");
6738 const bool has_sched_wait_eval =
6739 has_sched && HasKernel(msl, base + "_sched_wait_eval");
6740 const bool has_sched_exec_ready =
6741 has_sched && HasKernel(msl, base + "_sched_exec_ready");
6742 bool use_sched_ready =
6743 ready_enabled && has_sched_ready_reset &&
6744 has_sched_ready_flags && has_sched_ready_compact;
6745 bool use_sched_exec_ready =
6746 exec_ready_enabled && has_sched_exec_ready;
6747 bool use_sched_wait_eval =
6748 wait_eval_enabled && has_sched_wait_eval;
6749 bool use_sched_ready_dispatch =
6750 use_sched_ready && use_sched_exec_ready && has_sched_ready_dispatch;
6751 bool use_exec_ready_indirect = false;
6752 size_t sched_ready_dispatch_offset = 0u;
6753 if (!has_sched && !has_fallback_kernel) {
6754 if (error) {
6755 *error = "missing primary kernel in Metal source (" + base + ")";
6756 }
6757 return false;
6758 }
6759 {
6760 std::vector<std::string> precompile;
6761 if (has_sched) {
6762 precompile.push_back(base + "_sched_step");
6763 if (use_sched_ready) {
6764 precompile.push_back(base + "_sched_ready_reset");
6765 precompile.push_back(base + "_sched_ready_flags");
6766 precompile.push_back(base + "_sched_ready_compact");
6767 }
6768 if (use_sched_wait_eval) {
6769 precompile.push_back(base + "_sched_wait_eval");
6770 }
6771 if (use_sched_ready_dispatch) {
6772 precompile.push_back(base + "_sched_ready_dispatch");
6773 }
6774 if (use_sched_exec_ready) {
6775 precompile.push_back(base + "_sched_exec_ready");
6776 }
6777 } else {
6778 precompile.push_back(base);
6779 if (has_init) {
6780 precompile.push_back(base + "_init");
6781 }
6782 if (has_tick) {
6783 precompile.push_back(base + "_tick");
6784 }
6785 }
6786 if (!runtime.PrecompileKernels(precompile, error)) {
6787 return false;
6788 }
6789 }
6790
6791 gpga::SchedulerConstants sched;
6792 gpga::ParseSchedulerConstants(msl, &sched, error);
6793 if (ready_enabled && has_sched && sched.vm_enabled && sched.proc_count > 0u &&
6794 (!has_sched_ready_reset ||
6795 !has_sched_ready_flags || !has_sched_ready_compact)) {
6796 if (error) {
6797 *error = "sched-ready kernels requested but missing in Metal source";
6798 }
6799 return false;
6800 }
6801 if (exec_ready_enabled && has_sched && sched.vm_enabled &&
6802 sched.proc_count > 0u && !has_sched_exec_ready) {
6803 if (error) {
6804 *error = "sched-exec-ready kernel requested but missing in Metal source";
6805 }
6806 return false;
6807 }
6808 if (wait_eval_enabled && has_sched && sched.vm_enabled &&
6809 sched.proc_count > 0u && !has_sched_wait_eval) {
6810 if (error) {
6811 *error = "sched-wait-eval kernel requested but missing in Metal source";
6812 }
6813 return false;
6814 }
6815 gpga::SchedulerVmLayout vm_layout;
6816 std::vector<std::string> vm_extra_signals;
6817 const gpga::SchedulerVmLayout* vm_layout_ptr = nullptr;
6818 uint32_t callgroup_procs = 0u;
6819 uint32_t empty_procs = 0u;
6820 size_t vm_proc_count = 0u;
6821 bool vm_needs_call_group = false;
6822 struct VmWatchProc {
6823 uint32_t pid;
6824 gpga::SchedulerVmOp op;
6825 const char* label;
6826 };
6827 std::vector<VmWatchProc> vm_watch_procs;
6828 if (sched.vm_enabled) {
6829 if (!gpga::BuildSchedulerVmLayoutFromModule(
6830 module, &vm_layout, error, enable_4state, &vm_extra_signals)) {
6831 return false;
6832 }
6833 if (!vm_layout.bytecode.empty()) {
6834 sched.vm_bytecode_words =
6835 static_cast<uint32_t>(vm_layout.bytecode.size());
6836 sched.vm_case_header_count =
6837 static_cast<uint32_t>(vm_layout.case_headers.size());
6838 sched.vm_case_entry_count =
6839 static_cast<uint32_t>(vm_layout.case_entries.size());
6840 sched.vm_case_word_count =
6841 static_cast<uint32_t>(vm_layout.case_words.size());
6842 sched.vm_cond_count =
6843 static_cast<uint32_t>(vm_layout.cond_entries.size());
6844 if (sched.vm_cond_count == 0u) {
6845 sched.vm_cond_count = 1u;
6846 }
6847 sched.vm_assign_count =
6848 static_cast<uint32_t>(vm_layout.assign_entries.size());
6849 sched.vm_signal_count =
6850 static_cast<uint32_t>(vm_layout.signal_entries.size());
6851 sched.vm_service_call_count =
6852 static_cast<uint32_t>(vm_layout.service_entries.size());
6853 sched.vm_service_assign_count =
6854 static_cast<uint32_t>(vm_layout.service_ret_entries.size());
6855 sched.vm_service_arg_count =
6856 static_cast<uint32_t>(vm_layout.service_args.size());
6857 sched.vm_expr_word_count =
6858 static_cast<uint32_t>(vm_layout.expr_table.words.size());
6859 sched.vm_expr_imm_word_count =
6860 static_cast<uint32_t>(vm_layout.expr_table.imm_words.size());
6861 }
6862 vm_layout_ptr = &vm_layout;
6863 if (vm_layout_ptr) {
6864 vm_proc_count = std::min(vm_layout.proc_offsets.size(),
6865 vm_layout.proc_lengths.size());
6866 for (size_t pid = 0; pid < vm_proc_count; ++pid) {
6867 const uint32_t len = vm_layout.proc_lengths[pid];
6868 if (len == 0u) {
6869 empty_procs += 1u;
6870 continue;
6871 }
6872 const size_t offset = vm_layout.proc_offsets[pid];
6873 if (offset >= vm_layout.bytecode.size()) {
6874 callgroup_procs += 1u;
6875 continue;
6876 }
6877 if (gpga::DecodeSchedulerVmOp(vm_layout.bytecode[offset]) ==
6878 gpga::SchedulerVmOp::kCallGroup) {
6879 callgroup_procs += 1u;
6880 }
6881 }
6882 vm_needs_call_group = (callgroup_procs > 0u);
6883 } else {
6884 vm_needs_call_group = true;
6885 }
6886 if (has_sched && vm_needs_call_group && !has_fallback_kernel) {
6887 if (error) {
6888 *error =
6889 "sched-vm: CallGroup fallbacks present but fallback kernel missing";
6890 }
6891 return false;
6892 }
6893 if (run_verbose) {
6894 if (!vm_layout_ptr) {
6895 std::cerr << "sched-vm: missing bytecode layout; assuming CallGroup fallback\n";
6896 } else if (callgroup_procs == 0u) {
6897 std::cerr << "sched-vm: no CallGroup fallbacks; A-full helpers skipped\n";
6898 } else {
6899 std::cerr << "sched-vm: CallGroup fallbacks in " << callgroup_procs
6900 << " of " << vm_proc_count << " procs";
6901 if (empty_procs > 0u) {
6902 std::cerr << " (" << empty_procs << " empty bytecode)";
6903 }
6904 std::cerr << "\n";
6905 }
6906 if (vm_layout_ptr) {
6907 std::vector<uint32_t> first_op_counts(256, 0u);
6908 std::vector<uint32_t> len_bins(9, 0u);
6909 uint32_t len_over_8 = 0u;
6910 uint32_t zero_len = 0u;
6911 for (uint32_t pid = 0u; pid < vm_proc_count; ++pid) {
6912 const uint32_t len = vm_layout.proc_lengths[pid];
6913 if (len == 0u) {
6914 zero_len += 1u;
6915 }
6916 if (len < len_bins.size()) {
6917 len_bins[len] += 1u;
6918 } else {
6919 len_over_8 += 1u;
6920 }
6921 if (len == 0u) {
6922 continue;
6923 }
6924 const size_t offset = vm_layout.proc_offsets[pid];
6925 if (offset < vm_layout.bytecode.size()) {
6926 const auto op = gpga::DecodeSchedulerVmOp(vm_layout.bytecode[offset]);

6962 for (uint32_t pid = 0u; pid < vm_proc_count; ++pid) {
6963 const uint32_t len = vm_layout.proc_lengths[pid];

6972 vm_watch_procs.push_back(VmWatchProc{pid, op, label});
6973 break;
6974 }
6975 }

7422 ? static_cast<uint32_t*>(head_it->second.contents())
7423 : nullptr;

7428 const size_t min_words = static_cast<size_t>(count) * 2u;
7429 if (count_it->second.length() >= min_words * sizeof(uint32_t)) {

7431 }
7432 }

7440 };
7441 auto drain_services = [&](bool force) -> bool {

7443 return true;
7444 }
7445 auto count_it = buffers.find("sched_service_count");
7446 auto record_it = buffers.find("sched_service");
7447 if (count_it == buffers.end() || record_it == buffers.end()) {
7448 return true;
7449 }
7450 auto head_it = buffers.find("sched_service_head");
7451 auto* counts =
7452 static_cast<uint32_t*>(count_it->second.contents());
7453 auto* heads = (head_it != buffers.end())
7454 ? static_cast<uint32_t*>(head_it->second.contents())
7455 : nullptr;
7456 auto* records =
7457 static_cast<uint8_t*>(record_it->second.contents());
7458 if (!counts || !records) {
7459 return true;
7460 }
7461 if (!heads) {
7462 const size_t min_words = static_cast<size_t>(count) * 2u;
7463 if (count_it->second.length() >= min_words * sizeof(uint32_t)) {
7464 heads = counts + count;
7465 }
7466 }
7467 size_t stride =
7468 gpga::ServiceRecordStride(
7469 std::max<uint32_t>(1u, sched.service_max_args),
7470 sched.service_wide_words, enable_4state);
7471 for (uint32_t gid = 0; gid < count; ++gid) {
7472 uint32_t tail = counts[gid];
7473 uint32_t head = heads ? heads[gid] : 0u;
7474 uint32_t used = tail - head;
7475 if (used > service_capacity) {
7476 std::cerr << "warning: service record overflow (gid=" << gid
7477 << ", used=" << used << ", capacity="
7478 << service_capacity << ")\n";
7479 used = service_capacity;
7480 }
7481 if (used == 0u) {
7482 continue;
7483 }
7484 const uint8_t* rec_base =
7485 records + (gid * service_capacity * stride);
7486 std::vector<uint8_t> staging;
7487 staging.resize(static_cast<size_t>(used) * stride);
7488 uint32_t head_slot =
7489 service_capacity ? (head % service_capacity) : 0u;
7490 uint32_t first_span =
7491 std::min<uint32_t>(used, service_capacity - head_slot);
7492 std::memcpy(staging.data(),
7493 rec_base + (static_cast<size_t>(head_slot) * stride),
7494 static_cast<size_t>(first_span) * stride);
7495 if (used > first_span) {
7496 std::memcpy(
7497 staging.data() + (static_cast<size_t>(first_span) * stride),
7498 rec_base,
7499 static_cast<size_t>(used - first_span) * stride);
7500 }
7501 std::vector<DecodedServiceRecord> decoded;
7502 DecodeServiceRecords(staging.data(), used,
7503 std::max<uint32_t>(1u,
7504 sched.service_max_args),
7505 sched.service_wide_words, enable_4state,
7506 &decoded);
7507 gpga::ServiceDrainResult result;
7508 if (!HandleServiceRecords(decoded, strings, info, vcd_dir,
7509 &flat_to_hier,
7510 has_packed_layout ? &packed_layout
7511 : nullptr,
7512 module.timescale,
7513 enable_4state, count, gid,
7514 sched.proc_count, &file_tables[gid],
7515 plusargs, &buffers, &vcd, &result,
7516 &dumpfile, error)) {
7517 return false;
7518 }
7519 if (result.saw_finish || result.saw_stop || result.saw_error) {
7520 saw_finish = true;
7521 }
7522 if (heads) {
7523 heads[gid] = tail;
7524 } else {
7525 counts[gid] = 0u;
7526 }
7527 }
7528 return true;
7529 };
7530 if (do_service_drain) {
7531 if (!exec_ready_late || service_records_pending()) {
7532 if (!drain_services(false)) {
7533 return false;
7534 }
7535 }
7536 }
7537 if (vcd.active()) {
7538 auto time_it = buffers.find("sched_time");
7539 if (time_it != buffers.end() && time_it->second.contents()) {
7540 uint64_t time = 0;
7541 std::memcpy(&time, time_it->second.contents(), sizeof(time));
7542 vcd.Update(time, buffers);
7543 } else {
7544 vcd.Update(static_cast<uint64_t>(iter), buffers);
7545 }
7546 }
7547 if (do_ready) {
7548 if (!sched_batch) {
7549 if (ready_batch) {
7550 std::vector<gpga::MetalDispatch> ready_dispatches;
7551 ready_dispatches.push_back(
7552 gpga::MetalDispatch{&sched_ready_reset_kernel,
7553 &ready_reset_bindings, count});
7554 if (use_sched_wait_eval) {
7555 ready_dispatches.push_back(
7556 gpga::MetalDispatch{&sched_wait_eval_kernel,
7557 &wait_eval_bindings,
7558 static_cast<uint32_t>(ready_grid)});
7559 }
7560 ready_dispatches.push_back(
7561 gpga::MetalDispatch{&sched_ready_flags_kernel,
7562 &ready_flags_bindings,
7563 static_cast<uint32_t>(ready_grid)});
7564 ready_dispatches.push_back(
7565 gpga::MetalDispatch{&sched_ready_compact_kernel,
7566 &ready_compact_bindings,
7567 static_cast<uint32_t>(ready_grid)});
7568 if (use_exec_ready_indirect) {
7569 ready_dispatches.push_back(
7570 gpga::MetalDispatch{&sched_ready_dispatch_kernel,
7571 &ready_dispatch_bindings, 1u});
7572 }
7573 if (use_sched_exec_ready) {
7574 if (use_exec_ready_indirect) {
7575 auto ready_it = buffers.find("sched_ready");
7576 if (ready_it == buffers.end()) {
7577 if (error) {
7578 *error =
7579 "sched_ready buffer missing for indirect dispatch";
7580 }
7581 return false;
7582 }
7583 gpga::MetalDispatch exec_dispatch{
7584 &sched_exec_ready_kernel, &exec_ready_bindings, 1u};
7585 exec_dispatch.indirect_buffer = &ready_it->second;
7586 exec_dispatch.indirect_offset = sched_ready_dispatch_offset;
7587 ready_dispatches.push_back(exec_dispatch);
7588 } else {
7589 ready_dispatches.push_back(
7590 gpga::MetalDispatch{&sched_exec_ready_kernel,
7591 &exec_ready_bindings,
7592 static_cast<uint32_t>(ready_grid)});
7593 }
7594 exec_ready_batched = true;
7595 exec_ready_after_drain = true;
7596 }
7597 if (!runtime.DispatchBatch(ready_dispatches, count, error,
7598 dispatch_timeout_ms)) {
7599 return false;
7600 }
7601 } else {
7602 if (!runtime.Dispatch(sched_ready_reset_kernel,
7603 ready_reset_bindings, count, error,
7604 dispatch_timeout_ms)) {
7605 return false;
7606 }
7607 if (use_sched_wait_eval) {
7608 if (!runtime.Dispatch(sched_wait_eval_kernel, wait_eval_bindings,
7609 static_cast<uint32_t>(ready_grid), error,
7610 dispatch_timeout_ms)) {
7611 return false;
7612 }
7613 }
7614 if (!runtime.Dispatch(sched_ready_flags_kernel,
7615 ready_flags_bindings,
7616 static_cast<uint32_t>(ready_grid), error,
7617 dispatch_timeout_ms)) {
7618 return false;
7619 }
7620 if (!runtime.Dispatch(sched_ready_compact_kernel,
7621 ready_compact_bindings,
7622 static_cast<uint32_t>(ready_grid), error,
7623 dispatch_timeout_ms)) {
7624 return false;
7625 }
7626 if (use_exec_ready_indirect) {
7627 if (!runtime.Dispatch(sched_ready_dispatch_kernel,
7628 ready_dispatch_bindings, 1u, error,
7629 dispatch_timeout_ms)) {
7630 return false;
7631 }
7632 }
7633 }
7634 }
7635 if (use_sched_exec_ready && !exec_ready_batched) {
7636 if (use_exec_ready_indirect) {
7637 auto ready_it = buffers.find("sched_ready");
7638 if (ready_it == buffers.end()) {
7639 if (error) {
7640 *error = "sched_ready buffer missing for indirect dispatch";
7641 }
7642 return false;
7643 }
7644 if (!runtime.DispatchIndirectThreads(
7645 sched_exec_ready_kernel, exec_ready_bindings,
7646 ready_it->second, sched_ready_dispatch_offset, error,
7647 dispatch_timeout_ms)) {
7648 return false;
7649 }
7650 exec_ready_after_drain = true;
7651 } else {
7652 if (!runtime.Dispatch(sched_exec_ready_kernel,
7653 exec_ready_bindings,
7654 static_cast<uint32_t>(ready_grid), error,
7655 dispatch_timeout_ms)) {
7656 return false;
7657 }
7658 exec_ready_after_drain = true;
7659 }
7660 }
7661 if (exec_ready_after_drain) {
7662 if (do_service_drain && service_records_pending()) {
7663 if (!drain_services(false)) {
7664 return false;
7665 }
7666 }
7667 }
7668 if (run_verbose) {
7669 auto ready_it = buffers.find("sched_ready");
7670 if (ready_it != buffers.end() && ready_it->second.contents()) {
7671 auto* ready_u32 =
7672 static_cast<uint32_t*>(ready_it->second.contents());
7673 const size_t stride =
7674 static_cast<size_t>(count) *
7675 static_cast<size_t>(sched.proc_count);
7676 auto* ready_counts = ready_u32 + (stride * 2u);
7677 std::cerr << "sched ready (compact): total=" << ready_counts[0]
7678 << "\n";
7679 }
7680 }
7681 if (run_verbose && (iter == 0ull || (iter % 1000ull) == 0ull)) {
7682 auto ready_it = buffers.find("sched_ready");
7683 if (ready_it != buffers.end() && ready_it->second.contents()) {
7684 auto* ready_u32 =
7685 static_cast<uint32_t*>(ready_it->second.contents());
7686 const size_t stride =
7687 static_cast<size_t>(count) *
7688 static_cast<size_t>(sched.proc_count);
7689 auto* ready_counts = ready_u32 + (stride * 2u);
7690 std::cerr << "sched ready: total=" << ready_counts[0] << "\n";
7691 }
7692 }
7693 }
7694 auto* status =
7695 static_cast<uint32_t*>(buffers["sched_status"].contents());
7696 if (!status) {
7697 if (run_verbose) {
7698 std::cerr << "warning: sched_status buffer missing\n";
7699 }
7700 break;
7701 }
7702 const uint32_t status_val = status[0];
7703 if (run_verbose &&
7704 status_val != last_status_val &&
7705 (status_val == kStatusStopped || status_val == kStatusFinished ||
7706 status_val == kStatusError)) {
7707 uint32_t halt_val = 0u;
7708 auto* halt_buf =
7709 static_cast<uint32_t*>(buffers["sched_halt_mode"].contents());
7710 if (halt_buf) {
7711 halt_val = halt_buf[0];
7712 }
7713 std::cerr << "sched stop: iter=" << iter
7714 << " status=" << status_val
7715 << "(" << SchedulerStatusLabel(status_val) << ")"
7716 << " halt=" << halt_val
7717 << "(" << HaltModeLabel(halt_val) << ")";
7718 auto* error_buf =
7719 static_cast<uint32_t*>(buffers["sched_error"].contents());
7720 if (error_buf) {
7721 std::cerr << " error=" << error_buf[0];
7722 }
7723 std::cerr << "\n";
7724 }
7725 last_status_val = status_val;
7726 if (run_verbose &&
7727 (iter == 0u || status_val != GPGA_SCHED_STATUS_RUNNING)) {
7728 auto* phase =
7729 static_cast<uint32_t*>(buffers["sched_phase"].contents());
7730 auto* flags =
7731 static_cast<uint32_t*>(buffers["sched_flags"].contents());
7732 auto* error_buf =
7733 static_cast<uint32_t*>(buffers["sched_error"].contents());
7734 auto* halt_buf =
7735 static_cast<uint32_t*>(buffers["sched_halt_mode"].contents());
7736 auto* time_buf =
7737 static_cast<uint64_t*>(buffers["sched_time"].contents());
7738 auto* wait_kind =
7739 static_cast<uint32_t*>(buffers["sched_wait_kind"].contents());
7740 auto* sched_state =
7741 static_cast<uint32_t*>(buffers["sched_state"].contents());
7742 auto* vm_len =
7743 static_cast<uint32_t*>(
7744 buffers["sched_vm_proc_bytecode_length"].contents());
7745 auto* vm_ip =
7746 static_cast<uint32_t*>(buffers["sched_vm_ip"].contents());
7747 uint32_t* vm_debug = nullptr;
7748 auto debug_it = buffers.find("sched_vm_debug");
7749 if (debug_it != buffers.end() && debug_it->second.contents()) {
7750 vm_debug = static_cast<uint32_t*>(debug_it->second.contents());
7751 }
7752 uint32_t wait_counts[8] = {0u};
7753 if (wait_kind && sched.proc_count > 0u) {
7754 for (uint32_t pid = 0u; pid < sched.proc_count; ++pid) {
7755 uint32_t kind = wait_kind[pid];
7756 if (kind < 8u) {
7757 wait_counts[kind] += 1u;
7758 }
7759 }
7760 }
7761 uint32_t state_counts[3] = {0u};
7762 if (sched_state && sched.proc_count > 0u) {
7763 for (uint32_t pid = 0u; pid < sched.proc_count; ++pid) {
7764 uint32_t state = sched_state[pid];
7765 if (state < 3u) {
7766 state_counts[state] += 1u;
7767 }
7768 }
7769 }
7770 uint32_t vm_len_vals[3] = {0u, 0u, 0u};
7771 uint32_t vm_ip_vals[3] = {0u, 0u, 0u};
7772 if (vm_len && vm_ip && sched.proc_count > 0u) {
7773 const uint32_t limit =
7774 std::min<uint32_t>(3u, sched.proc_count);
7775 for (uint32_t pid = 0u; pid < limit; ++pid) {
7776 vm_len_vals[pid] = vm_len[pid];
7777 vm_ip_vals[pid] = vm_ip[pid];
7778 }
7779 }
7780 std::cerr << "sched status: iter=" << iter
7781 << " status=" << status_val
7782 << "(" << SchedulerStatusLabel(status_val) << ")"
7783 << " error=" << (error_buf ? error_buf[0] : 0u)
7784 << " halt=" << (halt_buf ? halt_buf[0] : 0u)
7785 << " phase=" << (phase ? phase[0] : 0u)
7786 << " flags=" << (flags ? flags[0] : 0u)
7787 << " time=" << (time_buf ? time_buf[0] : 0ull)
7788 << " state=[ready:" << state_counts[GPGA_SCHED_PROC_READY]
7789 << " blocked:" << state_counts[GPGA_SCHED_PROC_BLOCKED]
7790 << " done:" << state_counts[GPGA_SCHED_PROC_DONE]
7791 << "]"
7792 << " vm=[len:" << vm_len_vals[0] << "," << vm_len_vals[1]
7793 << "," << vm_len_vals[2] << " ip:" << vm_ip_vals[0]
7794 << "," << vm_ip_vals[1] << "," << vm_ip_vals[2] << "]"
7795 << " waits=[none:" << wait_counts[GPGA_SCHED_WAIT_NONE]
7796 << " time:" << wait_counts[GPGA_SCHED_WAIT_TIME]
7797 << " event:" << wait_counts[GPGA_SCHED_WAIT_EVENT]
7798 << " cond:" << wait_counts[GPGA_SCHED_WAIT_COND]
7799 << " join:" << wait_counts[GPGA_SCHED_WAIT_JOIN]
7800 << " delta:" << wait_counts[GPGA_SCHED_WAIT_DELTA]
7801 << " edge:" << wait_counts[GPGA_SCHED_WAIT_EDGE]
7802 << " service:" << wait_counts[GPGA_SCHED_WAIT_SERVICE]
7803 << "]\n";
7804 if (vm_debug && flags &&
7805 (flags[0] & GPGA_SCHED_FLAG_VM_DEBUG) != 0u) {
7806 uint32_t op = 0u;
7807 uint32_t arg = 0u;
7808 if (vm_debug) {
7809 const uint32_t instr = vm_debug[4];
7810 op = static_cast<uint32_t>(gpga::DecodeSchedulerVmOp(instr));
7811 arg = gpga::DecodeSchedulerVmArg(instr);
7812 }
7813 const std::array<uint32_t, 3> dbg_gids = {0u, 1u, 32u};
7814 uint32_t dbg_count = std::min<uint32_t>(2u, count);
7815 if (count > 32u) {
7816 dbg_count = 3u;
7817 }
7818 for (uint32_t idx = 0u; idx < dbg_count; ++idx) {
7819 const uint32_t dbg_gid = dbg_gids[idx];
7820 if (dbg_gid >= count) {
7821 continue;
7822 }
7823 const uint32_t* dbg =
7824 vm_debug + (dbg_gid * GPGA_SCHED_VM_DEBUG_WORDS);
7825 const uint32_t magic = dbg[0];
7826 const uint32_t instr = dbg[4];
7827 const uint32_t dbg_op =
7828 static_cast<uint32_t>(gpga::DecodeSchedulerVmOp(instr));
7829 const uint32_t dbg_arg = gpga::DecodeSchedulerVmArg(instr);
7830 std::cerr << "sched-vm-debug[g=" << dbg_gid << "]: magic=0x"
7831 << std::hex << magic << std::dec
7832 << " bc_base=" << dbg[1]
7833 << " len=" << dbg[2]
7834 << " ip=" << dbg[3]
7835 << " instr=0x" << std::hex << instr << std::dec
7836 << " op=" << dbg_op << " arg=" << dbg_arg
7837 << " instr0=0x" << std::hex << dbg[5] << std::dec
7838 << " instr1=0x" << std::hex << dbg[6] << std::dec
7839 << " vm_idx=" << dbg[10]
7840 << " flags=" << dbg[11]
7841 << " gid=" << dbg[12]
7842 << " tg=" << dbg[13]
7843 << " tid=" << dbg[14] << "\n";
7844 }
7845 if (status_val == GPGA_SCHED_STATUS_ERROR) {
7846 auto bc_it = buffers.find("sched_vm_bytecode");
7847 if (bc_it != buffers.end() && bc_it->second.contents()) {
7848 auto* bytecode_buf =
7849 static_cast<uint32_t*>(bc_it->second.contents());
7850 const size_t bytecode_words =
7851 bc_it->second.length() / sizeof(uint32_t);
7852 const uint32_t bc_base = vm_debug[1];
7853 const uint32_t bc_len = vm_debug[2];
7854 const uint32_t ip = vm_debug[3];
7855 const uint32_t next_ip = ip + 1u;
7856 uint32_t target = 0u;
7857 bool target_ok = false;
7858 if (next_ip < bc_len &&
7859 (static_cast<size_t>(bc_base) + next_ip) < bytecode_words) {
7860 target = bytecode_buf[bc_base + next_ip];
7861 target_ok = true;
7862 }
7863 std::cerr << "sched-vm-debug-error: op=" << op
7864 << " arg=" << arg
7865 << " next_ip=" << next_ip
7866 << " target=" << (target_ok ? target : 0u)
7867 << " target_ok=" << (target_ok ? 1 : 0)
7868 << " bc_len=" << bc_len
7869 << " cond_count=" << sched.vm_cond_count
7870 << " case_header_count="
7871 << sched.vm_case_header_count
7872 << " case_entry_count="
7873 << sched.vm_case_entry_count
7874 << " service_call_count=" << sched.vm_service_call_count
7875 << " service_assign_count="
7876 << sched.vm_service_assign_count
7877 << "\n";
7878 if (op == static_cast<uint32_t>(gpga::SchedulerVmOp::kCase)) {
7879 uint32_t case_count = 0u;
7880 uint32_t default_target = 0u;
7881 bool default_ok = false;
7882 if (next_ip < bc_len &&
7883 (static_cast<size_t>(bc_base) + next_ip) < bytecode_words) {
7884 case_count = bytecode_buf[bc_base + next_ip];
7885 }
7886 const uint32_t target_base = next_ip + 1u;
7887 const uint32_t default_index = target_base + case_count;
7888 if (default_index < bc_len &&
7889 (static_cast<size_t>(bc_base) + default_index) <
7890 bytecode_words) {
7891 default_target = bytecode_buf[bc_base + default_index];
7892 default_ok = true;
7893 }
7894 std::cerr << "sched-vm-case-bytecode: case_id=" << arg
7895 << " case_count=" << case_count
7896 << " target_base=" << target_base
7897 << " default_index=" << default_index
7898 << " default_target="
7899 << (default_ok ? default_target : 0u)
7900 << " default_ok=" << (default_ok ? 1 : 0)
7901 << "\n";
7902 if (case_count > 0u) {
7903 const uint32_t max_targets =
7904 std::min<uint32_t>(case_count, 8u);
7905 std::cerr << "sched-vm-case-targets:";
7906 for (uint32_t i = 0u; i < max_targets; ++i) {
7907 const uint32_t index = target_base + i;
7908 uint32_t val = 0u;
7909 bool ok = false;
7910 if (index < bc_len &&
7911 (static_cast<size_t>(bc_base) + index) <
7912 bytecode_words) {
7913 val = bytecode_buf[bc_base + index];
7914 ok = true;
7915 }
7916 std::cerr << " [" << i << "]="
7917 << (ok ? val : 0u)
7918 << (ok ? "" : "(bad)");
7919 }
7920 if (case_count > max_targets) {
7921 std::cerr << " ...";
7922 }
7923 std::cerr << "\n";
7924 }
7925 auto case_it = buffers.find("sched_vm_case_header");
7926 if (case_it != buffers.end() &&
7927 case_it->second.contents()) {
7928 auto* headers =
7929 static_cast<gpga::SchedulerVmCaseHeader*>(
7930 case_it->second.contents());
7931 if (arg < sched.vm_case_header_count) {
7932 const auto& header = headers[arg];
7933 std::cerr << "sched-vm-case-header: case_id=" << arg
7934 << " kind=" << header.kind
7935 << " strategy=" << header.strategy
7936 << " width=" << header.width
7937 << " entry_count=" << header.entry_count
7938 << " entry_offset=" << header.entry_offset
7939 << " expr_offset=" << header.expr_offset
7940 << " default_target=" << header.default_target
7941 << "\n";
7942 } else {
7943 std::cerr << "sched-vm-case-header: case_id=" << arg
7944 << " out_of_range count="
7945 << sched.vm_case_header_count << "\n";
7946 }
7947 }
7948 }
7949 }
7950 }
7951 }
7952 if (!vm_watch_procs.empty()) {
7953 auto* bytecode_buf =
7954 static_cast<uint32_t*>(buffers["sched_vm_bytecode"].contents());
7955 auto* offsets =
7956 static_cast<uint32_t*>(
7957 buffers["sched_vm_proc_bytecode_offset"].contents());
7958 auto* lengths =
7959 static_cast<uint32_t*>(
7960 buffers["sched_vm_proc_bytecode_length"].contents());
7961 const size_t bytecode_words =
7962 buffers["sched_vm_bytecode"].length() / sizeof(uint32_t);
7963 auto state_name = [](uint32_t state) -> const char* {
7964 switch (state) {
7965 case GPGA_SCHED_PROC_READY:
7966 return "ready";
7967 case GPGA_SCHED_PROC_BLOCKED:
7968 return "blocked";
7969 case GPGA_SCHED_PROC_DONE:
7970 return "done";
7971 default:
7972 return "unknown";
7973 }
7974 };
7975 auto wait_name = [](uint32_t kind) -> const char* {
7976 switch (kind) {
7977 case GPGA_SCHED_WAIT_NONE:
7978 return "none";
7979 case GPGA_SCHED_WAIT_TIME:
7980 return "time";
7981 case GPGA_SCHED_WAIT_EVENT:
7982 return "event";
7983 case GPGA_SCHED_WAIT_COND:
7984 return "cond";
7985 case GPGA_SCHED_WAIT_JOIN:
7986 return "join";
7987 case GPGA_SCHED_WAIT_DELTA:
7988 return "delta";
7989 case GPGA_SCHED_WAIT_EDGE:
7990 return "edge";
7991 case GPGA_SCHED_WAIT_SERVICE:
7992 return "service";
7993 default:
7994 return "unknown";
7995 }
7996 };
7997 if (bytecode_buf && offsets && lengths &&
7998 sched_state && wait_kind && vm_ip) {
7999 std::cerr << "sched-vm: watch";
8000 for (const auto& watch : vm_watch_procs) {
8001 const uint32_t pid = watch.pid;
8002 const uint32_t idx = pid;
8003 const uint32_t offset = offsets[idx];
8004 const uint32_t len = lengths[idx];
8005 uint32_t instr = 0u;
8006 gpga::SchedulerVmOp op = gpga::SchedulerVmOp::kDone;
8007 if (len > 0u && offset < bytecode_words) {
8008 instr = bytecode_buf[offset];
8009 op = gpga::DecodeSchedulerVmOp(instr);
8010 }
8011 std::cerr << " " << watch.label
8012 << "(pid=" << pid
8013 << " op=" << static_cast<uint32_t>(op)
8014 << " len=" << len
8015 << " ip=" << vm_ip[idx]
8016 << " state=" << state_name(sched_state[idx])
8017 << " wait=" << wait_name(wait_kind[idx])
8018 << ")";
8019 }
8020 std::cerr << "\n";
8021 }
8022 }
8023 }
8024 const bool should_stop = status_val == kStatusFinished ||
8025 status_val == kStatusStopped || status_val == kStatusError ||
8026 saw_finish;
8027 if (status_val == kStatusIdle && has_dumpvars && !should_stop) {
8028 continue;
8029 }
8030 if (should_stop || status_val == kStatusIdle) {
8031 if (!drain_services(true)) {
8032 return false;
8033 }
8034 vcd.FinalSnapshot(buffers);
8035 vcd.Close();
8036 break;
8037 }
8038 }
8039 } else {
8040 std::vector<gpga::MetalBufferBinding> bindings;
8041 if (!BuildBindings(comb_kernel, buffers, &bindings, error)) {
8042 return false;
8043 }
8044 std::vector<gpga::MetalBufferBinding> init_bindings;
8045 std::vector<gpga::MetalBufferBinding> tick_bindings;
8046 std::vector<gpga::MetalDispatch> dispatches;
8047 if (has_init) {
8048 if (!BuildBindings(init_kernel, buffers, &init_bindings, error)) {
8049 return false;
8050 }
8051 dispatches.push_back(gpga::MetalDispatch{&init_kernel, &init_bindings});
8052 }
8053 dispatches.push_back(gpga::MetalDispatch{&comb_kernel, &bindings});
8054 if (has_tick) {
8055 if (!BuildBindings(tick_kernel, buffers, &tick_bindings, error)) {
8056 return false;
8057 }
8058 dispatches.push_back(gpga::MetalDispatch{&tick_kernel, &tick_bindings});
8059 }
8060 if (!runtime.DispatchBatch(dispatches, count, error,
8061 dispatch_timeout_ms)) {
8062 return false;
8063 }
8064 if (has_tick) {
8065 SwapNextBuffers(&buffers);
8066 }
8067 }
8068 for (auto& table : file_tables) {
8069 for (auto& entry : table.handles) {
8070 if (entry.second.file) {
8071 std::fclose(entry.second.file);
8072 }
8073 }
8074 table.handles.clear();
8075 }
8076 return true;
8077}
8078
8079int SignalWidth(const gpga::Module& module, const std::string& name) {
8080 for (const auto& port : module.ports) {
8081 if (port.name == name) {
8082 return port.width;
8083 }
8084 }
8085 for (const auto& net : module.nets) {
8086 if (net.name == name) {
8087 return net.width;
8088 }
8089 }
8090 return 32;
8091}
8092
8093bool SignalSigned(const gpga::Module& module, const std::string& name) {
8094 for (const auto& port : module.ports) {
8095 if (port.name == name) {
8096 return port.is_signed;
8097 }
8098 }
8099 for (const auto& net : module.nets) {
8100 if (net.name == name) {
8101 return net.is_signed;
8102 }
8103 }
8104 return false;
8105}
8106
8107bool IsArrayNet(const gpga::Module& module, const std::string& name,
8108 int* element_width) {
8109 for (const auto& net : module.nets) {
8110 if (net.name == name &&
8111 (net.array_size > 0 || !net.array_dims.empty())) {
8112 if (element_width) {
8113 *element_width = net.width;
8114 }
8115 return true;
8116 }
8117 }
8118 return false;
8119}
8120
8121int MinimalWidth(uint64_t value) {
8122 if (value == 0) {
8123 return 1;
8124 }
8125 int width = 0;
8126 while (value > 0) {
8127 value >>= 1;
8128 ++width;
8129 }
8130 return width;
8131}
8132
8133int ExprWidth(const gpga::Expr& expr, const gpga::Module& module) {
8134 switch (expr.kind) {
8135 case gpga::ExprKind::kIdentifier:
8136 return SignalWidth(module, expr.ident);
8137 case gpga::ExprKind::kNumber:
8138 if (expr.has_width && expr.number_width > 0) {
8139 return expr.number_width;
8140 }
8141 return std::max(32, MinimalWidth(expr.number));
8142 case gpga::ExprKind::kString:
8143 return std::max<int>(
8144 1, static_cast<int>(expr.string_value.size() * 8));
8145 case gpga::ExprKind::kUnary:
8146 if (expr.unary_op == '!' || expr.unary_op == '&' ||
8147 expr.unary_op == '|' || expr.unary_op == '^') {
8148 return 1;
8149 }
8150 if (expr.unary_op == 'C') {
8151 return 32;
8152 }
8153 return expr.operand ? ExprWidth(*expr.operand, module) : 32;
8154 case gpga::ExprKind::kBinary:
8155 if (expr.op == 'E' || expr.op == 'N' || expr.op == '<' ||
8156 expr.op == '>' || expr.op == 'L' || expr.op == 'G' ||
8157 expr.op == 'A' || expr.op == 'O') {
8158 return 1;
8159 }
8160 if (expr.op == 'l' || expr.op == 'r' || expr.op == 'R') {
8161 return expr.lhs ? ExprWidth(*expr.lhs, module) : 32;
8162 }
8163 if (expr.op == 'p') {
8164 return expr.lhs ? ExprWidth(*expr.lhs, module) : 32;
8165 }
8166 return std::max(expr.lhs ? ExprWidth(*expr.lhs, module) : 32,
8167 expr.rhs ? ExprWidth(*expr.rhs, module) : 32);
8168 case gpga::ExprKind::kTernary:
8169 return std::max(expr.then_expr ? ExprWidth(*expr.then_expr, module) : 32,
8170 expr.else_expr ? ExprWidth(*expr.else_expr, module) : 32);
8171 case gpga::ExprKind::kSelect: {
8172 if (expr.indexed_range && expr.indexed_width > 0) {
8173 return expr.indexed_width;
8174 }
8175 int lo = std::min(expr.msb, expr.lsb);
8176 int hi = std::max(expr.msb, expr.lsb);
8177 return hi - lo + 1;
8178 }
8179 case gpga::ExprKind::kIndex: {
8180 if (expr.base && expr.base->kind == gpga::ExprKind::kIdentifier) {
8181 int element_width = 0;
8182 if (IsArrayNet(module, expr.base->ident, &element_width)) {
8183 return element_width;
8184 }
8185 }
8186 return 1;
8187 }
8188 case gpga::ExprKind::kCall:
8189 if (expr.ident == "$time") {
8190 return 64;
8191 }
8192 if (expr.ident == "$realtobits") {
8193 return 64;
8194 }
8195 return 32;
8196 case gpga::ExprKind::kConcat: {
8197 int total = 0;
8198 for (const auto& element : expr.elements) {
8199 total += ExprWidth(*element, module);
8200 }
8201 int repeats = std::max(0, expr.repeat);
8202 return total * repeats;
8203 }
8204 }
8205 return 32;
8206}
8207
8208bool ExprSigned(const gpga::Expr& expr, const gpga::Module& module) {
8209 switch (expr.kind) {
8210 case gpga::ExprKind::kIdentifier:
8211 return SignalSigned(module, expr.ident);
8212 case gpga::ExprKind::kNumber:
8213 return expr.is_signed || !expr.has_base;
8214 case gpga::ExprKind::kString:
8215 return false;
8216 case gpga::ExprKind::kUnary:
8217 if (expr.unary_op == 'S') {
8218 return true;
8219 }
8220 if (expr.unary_op == 'U') {
8221 return false;
8222 }
8223 if (expr.unary_op == 'C') {
8224 return false;
8225 }
8226 if (expr.unary_op == '!' || expr.unary_op == '&' ||
8227 expr.unary_op == '|' || expr.unary_op == '^') {
8228 return false;
8229 }
8230 if (expr.unary_op == '-' && expr.operand &&
8231 expr.operand->kind == gpga::ExprKind::kNumber) {
8232 return true;
8233 }
8234 return expr.operand ? ExprSigned(*expr.operand, module) : false;
8235 case gpga::ExprKind::kBinary: {
8236 if (expr.op == 'E' || expr.op == 'N' || expr.op == '<' ||
8237 expr.op == '>' || expr.op == 'L' || expr.op == 'G' ||
8238 expr.op == 'A' || expr.op == 'O') {
8239 return false;
8240 }
8241 if (expr.op == 'l' || expr.op == 'r' || expr.op == 'R') {
8242 return expr.lhs ? ExprSigned(*expr.lhs, module) : false;
8243 }
8244 bool lhs_signed = expr.lhs ? ExprSigned(*expr.lhs, module) : false;
8245 bool rhs_signed = expr.rhs ? ExprSigned(*expr.rhs, module) : false;
8246 return lhs_signed && rhs_signed;
8247 }
8248 case gpga::ExprKind::kTernary: {
8249 bool t_signed =
8250 expr.then_expr ? ExprSigned(*expr.then_expr, module) : false;
8251 bool e_signed =
8252 expr.else_expr ? ExprSigned(*expr.else_expr, module) : false;
8253 return t_signed && e_signed;
8254 }
8255 case gpga::ExprKind::kSelect:
8256 case gpga::ExprKind::kIndex:
8257 case gpga::ExprKind::kConcat:
8258 return false;
8259 case gpga::ExprKind::kCall:
8260 return false;
8261 }
8262 return false;
8263}
8264
8265bool IsAllOnesExpr(const gpga::Expr& expr, const gpga::Module& module,
8266 int* width_out) {
8267 switch (expr.kind) {
8268 case gpga::ExprKind::kNumber: {
8269 if (expr.x_bits != 0 || expr.z_bits != 0) {
8270 return false;
8271 }
8272 int width = expr.has_width && expr.number_width > 0
8273 ? expr.number_width
8274 : MinimalWidth(expr.number);
8275 if (width_out) {
8276 *width_out = width;
8277 }
8278 if (width <= 0) {
8279 return false;
8280 }
8281 if (width > 64) {
8282 return false;
8283 }
8284 uint64_t mask = (width == 64)
8285 ? std::numeric_limits<uint64_t>::max()
8286 : ((1ULL << width) - 1ULL);
8287 return expr.number == mask;
8288 }
8289 case gpga::ExprKind::kString:
8290 return false;
8291 case gpga::ExprKind::kConcat: {
8292 int base_width = 0;
8293 for (const auto& element : expr.elements) {
8294 int element_width = 0;
8295 if (!IsAllOnesExpr(*element, module, &element_width)) {
8296 return false;
8297 }
8298 base_width += element_width;
8299 }
8300 if (base_width <= 0) {
8301 return false;
8302 }
8303 int repeats = std::max(0, expr.repeat);
8304 if (repeats == 0) {
8305 return false;
8306 }
8307 int total = base_width * repeats;
8308 if (width_out) {
8309 *width_out = total;
8310 }
8311 return true;
8312 }
8313 default:
8314 return false;
8315 }
8316}
8317
8318const gpga::Expr* SimplifyAssignMask(const gpga::Expr& expr,
8319 const gpga::Module& module,
8320 int lhs_width) {
8321 if (expr.kind != gpga::ExprKind::kBinary || expr.op != '&') {
8322 return nullptr;
8323 }
8324 if (!expr.lhs || !expr.rhs) {
8325 return nullptr;
8326 }
8327 int lhs_expr_width = ExprWidth(*expr.lhs, module);
8328 int rhs_expr_width = ExprWidth(*expr.rhs, module);
8329 int target = std::max(lhs_expr_width, rhs_expr_width);
8330 if (lhs_expr_width == lhs_width &&
8331 IsAllOnesExpr(*expr.rhs, module, nullptr) &&
8332 ExprWidth(*expr.rhs, module) == target) {
8333 return expr.lhs.get();
8334 }
8335 if (rhs_expr_width == lhs_width &&
8336 IsAllOnesExpr(*expr.lhs, module, nullptr) &&
8337 ExprWidth(*expr.lhs, module) == target) {
8338 return expr.rhs.get();
8339 }
8340 return nullptr;
8341}
8342
8343bool IsCompareOp(char op) {
8344 return op == 'E' || op == 'N' || op == '<' || op == '>' || op == 'L' ||
8345 op == 'G';
8346}
8347
8348bool IsShiftOp(char op) { return op == 'l' || op == 'r' || op == 'R'; }
8349
8350bool IsLogicalOp(char op) { return op == 'A' || op == 'O'; }
8351
8352std::string ExprToString(const gpga::Expr& expr, const gpga::Module& module) {
8353 switch (expr.kind) {
8354 case gpga::ExprKind::kIdentifier:
8355 return expr.ident;
8356 case gpga::ExprKind::kNumber: {
8357 const char* digits = "0123456789ABCDEF";
8358 if (expr.has_base) {
8359 if (expr.x_bits != 0 || expr.z_bits != 0) {
8360 int width = expr.has_width && expr.number_width > 0
8361 ? expr.number_width
8362 : MinimalWidth(expr.number);
8363 int bits_per_digit = 1;
8364 switch (expr.base_char) {
8365 case 'b':
8366 bits_per_digit = 1;
8367 break;
8368 case 'o':
8369 bits_per_digit = 3;
8370 break;
8371 case 'h':
8372 bits_per_digit = 4;
8373 break;
8374 default:
8375 bits_per_digit = 1;
8376 break;
8377 }
8378 int digit_count =
8379 std::max(1, (width + bits_per_digit - 1) / bits_per_digit);
8380 std::string repr;
8381 repr.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(digit_count));
8382 for (int i = 0; i < digit_count; ++i) {
8383 int shift = (digit_count - 1 - i) * bits_per_digit;
8384 uint64_t mask_bits =
8385 (bits_per_digit >= 64) ? 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull
8386 : ((1ull << bits_per_digit) - 1ull);
8387 uint64_t x =
8388 (shift >= 64) ? 0 : (expr.x_bits >> shift) & mask_bits;
8389 uint64_t z =
8390 (shift >= 64) ? 0 : (expr.z_bits >> shift) & mask_bits;
8391 if (x != 0) {
8392 repr.push_back('x');
8393 continue;
8394 }
8395 if (z != 0) {
8396 repr.push_back('z');
8397 continue;
8398 }
8399 uint64_t val = (shift >= 64)
8400 ? 0
8401 : (expr.value_bits >> shift) & mask_bits;
8402 repr.push_back(digits[static_cast<int>(val)]);
8403 }
8404 std::string prefix;
8405 if (expr.has_width && expr.number_width > 0) {
8406 prefix = std::to_string(expr.number_width);
8407 }
8408 std::string sign = expr.is_signed ? "s" : "";
8409 return prefix + "'" + sign + std::string(1, expr.base_char) + repr;
8410 }
8411 uint64_t value = expr.number;
8412 int base = 10;
8413 switch (expr.base_char) {
8414 case 'b':
8415 base = 2;
8416 break;
8417 case 'o':
8418 base = 8;
8419 break;
8420 case 'd':
8421 base = 10;
8422 break;
8423 case 'h':
8424 base = 16;
8425 break;
8426 default:
8427 base = 10;
8428 break;
8429 }
8430 std::string repr;
8431 if (value == 0) {
8432 repr = "0";
8433 } else {
8434 while (value > 0) {
8435 int digit = static_cast<int>(value % base);
8436 repr.insert(repr.begin(), digits[digit]);
8437 value /= static_cast<uint64_t>(base);
8438 }
8439 }
8440 std::string prefix;
8441 if (expr.has_width && expr.number_width > 0) {
8442 prefix = std::to_string(expr.number_width);
8443 }
8444 std::string sign = expr.is_signed ? "s" : "";
8445 return prefix + "'" + sign + std::string(1, expr.base_char) + repr;
8446 }
8447 if (expr.has_width && expr.number_width > 0) {
8448 return std::to_string(expr.number_width) + "'d" +
8449 std::to_string(expr.number);
8450 }
8451 return std::to_string(expr.number);
8452 }
8453 case gpga::ExprKind::kString:
8454 return "\"" + expr.string_value + "\"";
8455 case gpga::ExprKind::kUnary: {
8456 std::string operand =
8457 expr.operand ? ExprToString(*expr.operand, module) : "0";
8458 if (expr.unary_op == 'S') {
8459 return "$signed(" + operand + ")";
8460 }
8461 if (expr.unary_op == 'U') {
8462 return "$unsigned(" + operand + ")";
8463 }
8464 if (expr.unary_op == 'C') {
8465 return "$clog2(" + operand + ")";
8466 }
8467 return std::string(1, expr.unary_op) + operand;
8468 }
8469 case gpga::ExprKind::kBinary:
8470 {
8471 int lhs_width = expr.lhs ? ExprWidth(*expr.lhs, module) : 32;
8472 int rhs_width = expr.rhs ? ExprWidth(*expr.rhs, module) : 32;
8473 int target = std::max(lhs_width, rhs_width);
8474 bool signed_op = expr.lhs && expr.rhs &&
8475 ExprSigned(*expr.lhs, module) &&
8476 ExprSigned(*expr.rhs, module);
8477 std::string lhs = expr.lhs ? ExprToString(*expr.lhs, module) : "0";
8478 std::string rhs = expr.rhs ? ExprToString(*expr.rhs, module) : "0";
8479 if (!IsShiftOp(expr.op) && !IsLogicalOp(expr.op)) {
8480 if (lhs_width < target) {
8481 lhs = (signed_op ? "sext(" : "zext(") + lhs + ", " +
8482 std::to_string(target) + ")";
8483 }
8484 if (rhs_width < target) {
8485 rhs = (signed_op ? "sext(" : "zext(") + rhs + ", " +
8486 std::to_string(target) + ")";
8487 }
8488 }
8489 if (expr.op == 'E') {
8490 return "(" + lhs + " == " + rhs + ")";
8491 }
8492 if (expr.op == 'N') {
8493 return "(" + lhs + " != " + rhs + ")";
8494 }
8495 if (expr.op == 'C') {
8496 return "(" + lhs + " === " + rhs + ")";
8497 }
8498 if (expr.op == 'c') {
8499 return "(" + lhs + " !== " + rhs + ")";
8500 }
8501 if (expr.op == 'W') {
8502 return "(" + lhs + " ==? " + rhs + ")";
8503 }
8504 if (expr.op == 'w') {
8505 return "(" + lhs + " !=? " + rhs + ")";
8506 }
8507 if (expr.op == 'L') {
8508 return "(" + lhs + " <= " + rhs + ")";
8509 }
8510 if (expr.op == 'G') {
8511 return "(" + lhs + " >= " + rhs + ")";
8512 }
8513 if (expr.op == 'l') {
8514 return "(" + lhs + " << " + rhs + ")";
8515 }
8516 if (expr.op == 'r') {
8517 return "(" + lhs + " >> " + rhs + ")";
8518 }
8519 if (expr.op == 'R') {
8520 return "(" + lhs + " >>> " + rhs + ")";
8521 }
8522 if (expr.op == 'A') {
8523 return "(" + lhs + " && " + rhs + ")";
8524 }
8525 if (expr.op == 'O') {
8526 return "(" + lhs + " || " + rhs + ")";
8527 }
8528 return "(" + lhs + " " + expr.op + " " + rhs + ")";
8529 }
8530 case gpga::ExprKind::kTernary: {
8531 std::string cond =
8532 expr.condition ? ExprToString(*expr.condition, module) : "0";
8533 std::string then_expr =
8534 expr.then_expr ? ExprToString(*expr.then_expr, module) : "0";
8535 std::string else_expr =
8536 expr.else_expr ? ExprToString(*expr.else_expr, module) : "0";
8537 return "(" + cond + " ? " + then_expr + " : " + else_expr + ")";
8538 }
8539 case gpga::ExprKind::kSelect: {
8540 std::string base = ExprToString(*expr.base, module);
8541 if (expr.indexed_range && expr.indexed_width > 0) {
8542 const gpga::Expr* start =
8543 expr.indexed_desc ? expr.msb_expr.get() : expr.lsb_expr.get();
8544 std::string start_expr =
8545 start ? ExprToString(*start, module)
8546 : std::to_string(expr.indexed_desc ? expr.msb : expr.lsb);
8547 std::string op = expr.indexed_desc ? "-:" : "+:";
8548 return base + "[" + start_expr + " " + op + " " +
8549 std::to_string(expr.indexed_width) + "]";
8550 }
8551 if (expr.has_range) {
8552 return base + "[" + std::to_string(expr.msb) + ":" +
8553 std::to_string(expr.lsb) + "]";
8554 }
8555 return base + "[" + std::to_string(expr.msb) + "]";
8556 }
8557 case gpga::ExprKind::kIndex: {
8558 std::string base = ExprToString(*expr.base, module);
8559 std::string index = expr.index ? ExprToString(*expr.index, module) : "0";
8560 return base + "[" + index + "]";
8561 }
8562 case gpga::ExprKind::kCall: {
8563 std::string out = expr.ident + "(";
8564 for (size_t i = 0; i < expr.call_args.size(); ++i) {
8565 if (i > 0) {
8566 out += ", ";
8567 }
8568 if (expr.call_args[i]) {
8569 out += ExprToString(*expr.call_args[i], module);
8570 } else {
8571 out += "<null>";
8572 }
8573 }
8574 out += ")";
8575 return out;
8576 }
8577 case gpga::ExprKind::kConcat: {
8578 std::string inner;
8579 for (size_t i = 0; i < expr.elements.size(); ++i) {
8580 if (i > 0) {
8581 inner += ", ";
8582 }
8583 if (expr.elements[i]) {
8584 inner += ExprToString(*expr.elements[i], module);
8585 } else {
8586 inner += "<null>";
8587 }
8588 }
8589 if (expr.repeat > 1) {
8590 return "{" + std::to_string(expr.repeat) + "{" + inner + "}}";
8591 }
8592 return "{" + inner + "}";
8593 }
8594 }
8595 return "<expr>";
8596}
8597
8598void DumpStatement(const gpga::Statement& stmt, const gpga::Module& module,
8599 int indent, std::ostream& os) {
8600 std::string pad(static_cast<size_t>(indent), ' ');
8601 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kAssign) {
8602 if (stmt.assign.rhs) {
8603 std::string lhs = stmt.assign.lhs;
8604 if (stmt.assign.lhs_index) {
8605 lhs += "[" + ExprToString(*stmt.assign.lhs_index, module) + "]";
8606 }
8607 os << pad << lhs
8608 << (stmt.assign.nonblocking ? " <= " : " = ")
8609 << (stmt.assign.delay ? "#" + ExprToString(*stmt.assign.delay, module) + " "
8610 : "")
8611 << ExprToString(*stmt.assign.rhs, module) << ";\n";
8612 }
8613 return;
8614 }
8615 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kIf) {
8616 const gpga::Statement* current = &stmt;
8617 bool first = true;
8618 while (current) {
8619 std::string cond = current->condition
8620 ? ExprToString(*current->condition, module)
8621 : "0";
8622 if (first) {
8623 os << pad << "if (" << cond << ") {\n";
8624 first = false;
8625 } else {
8626 os << pad << "} else if (" << cond << ") {\n";
8627 }
8628 for (const auto& inner : current->then_branch) {
8629 DumpStatement(inner, module, indent + 2, os);
8630 }
8631 if (current->else_branch.empty()) {
8632 os << pad << "}\n";
8633 break;
8634 }
8635 if (current->else_branch.size() == 1 &&
8636 current->else_branch[0].kind == gpga::StatementKind::kIf) {
8637 current = &current->else_branch[0];
8638 continue;
8639 }
8640 os << pad << "} else {\n";
8641 for (const auto& inner : current->else_branch) {
8642 DumpStatement(inner, module, indent + 2, os);
8643 }
8644 os << pad << "}\n";
8645 break;
8646 }
8647 return;
8648 }
8649 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kCase) {
8650 std::string expr = stmt.case_expr ? ExprToString(*stmt.case_expr, module)
8651 : "0";
8652 const char* case_name = "case";
8653 if (stmt.case_kind == gpga::CaseKind::kCaseZ) {
8654 case_name = "casez";
8655 } else if (stmt.case_kind == gpga::CaseKind::kCaseX) {
8656 case_name = "casex";
8657 }
8658 os << pad << case_name << " (" << expr << ")\n";
8659 for (const auto& item : stmt.case_items) {
8660 std::string labels;
8661 for (size_t i = 0; i < item.labels.size(); ++i) {
8662 if (i > 0) {
8663 labels += ", ";
8664 }
8665 labels += ExprToString(*item.labels[i], module);
8666 }
8667 os << pad << " " << labels << ":\n";
8668 for (const auto& inner : item.body) {
8669 DumpStatement(inner, module, indent + 4, os);
8670 }
8671 }
8672 if (!stmt.default_branch.empty()) {
8673 os << pad << " default:\n";
8674 for (const auto& inner : stmt.default_branch) {
8675 DumpStatement(inner, module, indent + 4, os);
8676 }
8677 }
8678 os << pad << "endcase\n";
8679 return;
8680 }
8681 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kBlock) {
8682 os << pad << "begin";
8683 if (!stmt.block_label.empty()) {
8684 os << " : " << stmt.block_label;
8685 }
8686 os << "\n";
8687 for (const auto& inner : stmt.block) {
8688 DumpStatement(inner, module, indent + 2, os);
8689 }
8690 os << pad << "end";
8691 if (!stmt.block_label.empty()) {
8692 os << " : " << stmt.block_label;
8693 }
8694 os << "\n";
8695 return;
8696 }
8697 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kDelay) {
8698 std::string delay =
8699 stmt.delay ? ExprToString(*stmt.delay, module) : "0";
8700 os << pad << "#" << delay;
8701 if (stmt.delay_body.empty()) {
8702 os << ";\n";
8703 return;
8704 }
8705 os << "\n";
8706 for (const auto& inner : stmt.delay_body) {
8707 DumpStatement(inner, module, indent + 2, os);
8708 }
8709 return;
8710 }
8711 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kEventControl) {
8712 if (!stmt.event_items.empty()) {
8713 os << pad << "@(";
8714 for (size_t i = 0; i < stmt.event_items.size(); ++i) {
8715 if (i > 0) {
8716 os << ", ";
8717 }
8718 if (stmt.event_items[i].edge == gpga::EventEdgeKind::kPosedge) {
8719 os << "posedge ";
8720 } else if (stmt.event_items[i].edge == gpga::EventEdgeKind::kNegedge) {
8721 os << "negedge ";
8722 }
8723 if (stmt.event_items[i].expr) {
8724 os << ExprToString(*stmt.event_items[i].expr, module);
8725 } else {
8726 os << "/*missing*/";
8727 }
8728 }
8729 os << ")";
8730 } else if (!stmt.event_expr) {
8731 os << pad << "@*";
8732 } else {
8733 std::string expr = ExprToString(*stmt.event_expr, module);
8734 os << pad << "@(";
8735 if (stmt.event_edge == gpga::EventEdgeKind::kPosedge) {
8736 os << "posedge ";
8737 } else if (stmt.event_edge == gpga::EventEdgeKind::kNegedge) {
8738 os << "negedge ";
8739 }
8740 os << expr << ")";
8741 }
8742 if (stmt.event_body.empty()) {
8743 os << ";\n";
8744 return;
8745 }
8746 os << "\n";
8747 for (const auto& inner : stmt.event_body) {
8748 DumpStatement(inner, module, indent + 2, os);
8749 }
8750 return;
8751 }
8752 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kEventTrigger) {
8753 os << pad << "-> " << stmt.trigger_target << ";\n";
8754 return;
8755 }
8756 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kWait) {
8757 std::string expr =
8758 stmt.wait_condition ? ExprToString(*stmt.wait_condition, module) : "0";
8759 os << pad << "wait (" << expr << ")";
8760 if (stmt.wait_body.empty()) {
8761 os << ";\n";
8762 return;
8763 }
8764 os << "\n";
8765 for (const auto& inner : stmt.wait_body) {
8766 DumpStatement(inner, module, indent + 2, os);
8767 }
8768 return;
8769 }
8770 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kForever) {
8771 os << pad << "forever\n";
8772 for (const auto& inner : stmt.forever_body) {
8773 DumpStatement(inner, module, indent + 2, os);
8774 }
8775 return;
8776 }
8777 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kFork) {
8778 os << pad << "fork";
8779 if (!stmt.block_label.empty()) {
8780 os << " : " << stmt.block_label;
8781 }
8782 os << "\n";
8783 for (const auto& inner : stmt.fork_branches) {
8784 DumpStatement(inner, module, indent + 2, os);
8785 }
8786 os << pad << "join\n";
8787 return;
8788 }
8789 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kDisable) {
8790 os << pad << "disable " << stmt.disable_target << ";\n";
8791 return;
8792 }
8793 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kTaskCall) {
8794 os << pad << stmt.task_name << "(";
8795 for (size_t i = 0; i < stmt.task_args.size(); ++i) {
8796 if (i > 0) {
8797 os << ", ";
8798 }
8799 if (stmt.task_args[i]) {
8800 os << ExprToString(*stmt.task_args[i], module);
8801 } else {
8802 os << "<null>";
8803 }
8804 }
8805 os << ");\n";
8806 return;
8807 }
8808 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kForce) {
8809 if (stmt.assign.rhs) {
8810 std::string lhs =
8811 stmt.force_target.empty() ? stmt.assign.lhs : stmt.force_target;
8812 if (stmt.assign.lhs_index) {
8813 lhs += "[" + ExprToString(*stmt.assign.lhs_index, module) + "]";
8814 }
8815 if (stmt.is_procedural) {
8816 os << pad << "assign " << lhs << " = "
8817 << ExprToString(*stmt.assign.rhs, module) << ";\n";
8818 } else {
8819 os << pad << "force " << lhs << " = "
8820 << ExprToString(*stmt.assign.rhs, module) << ";\n";
8821 }
8822 }
8823 return;
8824 }
8825 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kRelease) {
8826 std::string lhs =
8827 stmt.release_target.empty() ? stmt.assign.lhs : stmt.release_target;
8828 if (stmt.assign.lhs_index) {
8829 lhs += "[" + ExprToString(*stmt.assign.lhs_index, module) + "]";
8830 }
8831 if (stmt.is_procedural) {
8832 os << pad << "deassign " << lhs << ";\n";
8833 } else {
8834 os << pad << "release " << lhs << ";\n";
8835 }
8836 return;
8837 }
8838}

8840std::string FormatExprFeaturesForDiag(
8841 const gpga::SchedulerVmExprFeatures& feat) {
8842 std::ostringstream os;
8843 os << "width=" << feat.width
8844 << " real=" << (feat.is_real ? "true" : "false")
8845 << " call=" << (feat.has_call ? "true" : "false")
8846 << " select=" << (feat.has_select ? "true" : "false")
8847 << " index=" << (feat.has_index ? "true" : "false")
8848 << " concat=" << (feat.has_concat ? "true" : "false")
8849 << " repeat=" << (feat.has_repeat ? "true" : "false")
8850 << " ternary=" << (feat.has_ternary ? "true" : "false")
8851 << " xz=" << (feat.has_xz ? "true" : "false")
8852 << " real_lit=" << (feat.has_real_literal ? "true" : "false");
8853 return os.str();
8854}

8856void DumpFlat(const gpga::ElaboratedDesign& design, std::ostream& os) {
8857 const auto& top = design.top;
8858 os << "Top: " << top.name << "\n";
8859 if (!top.parameters.empty()) {
8860 os << "Parameters:\n";
8861 for (const auto& param : top.parameters) {
8862 if (param.value) {
8863 os << " - " << param.name << " = "
8864 << ExprToString(*param.value, top) << "\n";
8865 } else {
8866 os << " - " << param.name << "\n";
8867 }
8868 }
8869 }
8870 os << "Ports:\n";
8871 for (const auto& port : top.ports) {
8872 os << " - " << DirLabel(port.dir);
8873 if (port.is_signed) {
8874 os << " signed";
8875 }
8876 os << " " << port.name << " [" << port.width << "]\n";
8877 }
8878 os << "Nets:\n";
8879 for (const auto& net : top.nets) {
8880 const char* type = "wire";
8881 switch (net.type) {
8882 case gpga::NetType::kWire:
8883 type = "wire";
8884 break;
8885 case gpga::NetType::kReg:
8886 type = "reg";
8887 break;
8888 case gpga::NetType::kWand:
8889 type = "wand";
8890 break;
8891 case gpga::NetType::kWor:
8892 type = "wor";
8893 break;
8894 case gpga::NetType::kTri0:
8895 type = "tri0";
8896 break;
8897 case gpga::NetType::kTri1:
8898 type = "tri1";
8899 break;
8900 case gpga::NetType::kTriand:
8901 type = "triand";
8902 break;
8903 case gpga::NetType::kTrior:
8904 type = "trior";
8905 break;
8906 case gpga::NetType::kTrireg:
8907 type = "trireg";
8908 break;
8909 case gpga::NetType::kSupply0:
8910 type = "supply0";
8911 break;
8912 case gpga::NetType::kSupply1:
8913 type = "supply1";
8914 break;
8915 }
8916 os << " - " << type;
8917 if (net.is_signed) {
8918 os << " signed";
8919 }
8920 os << " " << net.name << " [" << net.width << "]";
8921 if (net.array_size > 0) {
8922 os << " [" << net.array_size << "]";
8923 }
8924 os << "\n";
8925 }
8926 if (!top.events.empty()) {
8927 os << "Events:\n";
8928 for (const auto& evt : top.events) {
8929 os << " - event " << evt.name << "\n";
8930 }
8931 }
8932 auto format_assign = [&](const gpga::Assign& assign) -> std::string {
8933 int lhs_width = SignalWidth(top, assign.lhs);
8934 std::string lhs = assign.lhs;
8935 if (assign.lhs_has_range) {
8936 int lo = std::min(assign.lhs_msb, assign.lhs_lsb);
8937 int hi = std::max(assign.lhs_msb, assign.lhs_lsb);
8938 lhs_width = hi - lo + 1;
8939 if (assign.lhs_msb == assign.lhs_lsb) {
8940 lhs += "[" + std::to_string(assign.lhs_msb) + "]";
8941 } else {
8942 lhs += "[" + std::to_string(assign.lhs_msb) + ":" +
8943 std::to_string(assign.lhs_lsb) + "]";
8944 }
8945 }
8946 const gpga::Expr* rhs_expr = assign.rhs.get();
8947 if (const gpga::Expr* simplified =
8948 SimplifyAssignMask(*assign.rhs, top, lhs_width)) {
8949 rhs_expr = simplified;
8950 }
8951 int rhs_width = ExprWidth(*rhs_expr, top);
8952 std::string rhs = ExprToString(*rhs_expr, top);
8953 if (rhs_width < lhs_width) {
8954 rhs = (ExprSigned(*rhs_expr, top) ? "sext(" : "zext(") + rhs + ", " +
8955 std::to_string(lhs_width) + ")";
8956 } else if (rhs_width > lhs_width) {
8957 rhs = "trunc(" + rhs + ", " + std::to_string(lhs_width) + ")";
8958 }
8959 return lhs + " = " + rhs;
8960 };
8961 auto format_proc_assign = [&](const gpga::Statement& stmt) -> std::string {
8962 std::string lhs = stmt.assign.lhs;
8963 for (const auto& idx : stmt.assign.lhs_indices) {
8964 if (idx) {
8965 lhs += "[" + ExprToString(*idx, top) + "]";
8966 }
8967 }
8968 if (stmt.assign.lhs_index) {
8969 lhs += "[" + ExprToString(*stmt.assign.lhs_index, top) + "]";
8970 } else if (stmt.assign.lhs_has_range) {
8971 if (stmt.assign.lhs_msb == stmt.assign.lhs_lsb) {
8972 lhs += "[" + std::to_string(stmt.assign.lhs_msb) + "]";
8973 } else {
8974 lhs += "[" + std::to_string(stmt.assign.lhs_msb) + ":" +
8975 std::to_string(stmt.assign.lhs_lsb) + "]";
8976 }
8977 }
8978 std::string rhs =
8979 stmt.assign.rhs ? ExprToString(*stmt.assign.rhs, top) : "<null>";
8980 std::string delay;
8981 if (stmt.assign.delay) {
8982 delay = "#" + ExprToString(*stmt.assign.delay, top) + " ";
8983 }
8984 return "procedural " + lhs + " = " + delay + rhs;
8985 };
8986 std::vector<const gpga::Assign*> explicit_assigns;
8987 std::vector<const gpga::Assign*> derived_assigns;
8988 std::vector<const gpga::Assign*> implicit_assigns;
8989 std::vector<const gpga::Assign*> inlined_assigns;
8990 for (const auto& assign : top.assigns) {
8991 if (!assign.rhs) {
8992 continue;
8993 }
8994 if (assign.is_derived) {
8995 derived_assigns.push_back(&assign);
8996 } else if (assign.origin_depth == 0 && !assign.is_implicit) {
8997 explicit_assigns.push_back(&assign);
8998 } else if (assign.is_implicit) {
8999 implicit_assigns.push_back(&assign);
9000 } else {
9001 inlined_assigns.push_back(&assign);
9002 }
9003 }
9004 std::vector<std::string> procedural_assigns;
9005 std::function<void(const gpga::Statement&)> collect_proc;
9006 collect_proc = [&](const gpga::Statement& stmt) {
9007 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kForce && stmt.is_procedural) {
9008 if (stmt.assign.rhs) {
9009 procedural_assigns.push_back(format_proc_assign(stmt));
9010 }
9011 return;
9012 }
9013 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kIf) {
9014 for (const auto& inner : stmt.then_branch) {
9015 collect_proc(inner);
9016 }
9017 for (const auto& inner : stmt.else_branch) {
9018 collect_proc(inner);
9019 }
9020 return;
9021 }
9022 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kBlock) {
9023 for (const auto& inner : stmt.block) {
9024 collect_proc(inner);
9025 }
9026 return;
9027 }
9028 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kCase) {
9029 for (const auto& item : stmt.case_items) {
9030 for (const auto& inner : item.body) {
9031 collect_proc(inner);
9032 }
9033 }
9034 for (const auto& inner : stmt.default_branch) {
9035 collect_proc(inner);
9036 }
9037 return;
9038 }
9039 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kFor) {
9040 for (const auto& inner : stmt.for_body) {
9041 collect_proc(inner);
9042 }
9043 return;
9044 }
9045 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kWhile) {
9046 for (const auto& inner : stmt.while_body) {
9047 collect_proc(inner);
9048 }
9049 return;
9050 }
9051 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kRepeat) {
9052 for (const auto& inner : stmt.repeat_body) {
9053 collect_proc(inner);
9054 }
9055 return;
9056 }
9057 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kDelay) {
9058 for (const auto& inner : stmt.delay_body) {
9059 collect_proc(inner);
9060 }
9061 return;
9062 }
9063 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kEventControl) {
9064 for (const auto& inner : stmt.event_body) {
9065 collect_proc(inner);
9066 }
9067 return;
9068 }
9069 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kWait) {
9070 for (const auto& inner : stmt.wait_body) {
9071 collect_proc(inner);
9072 }
9073 return;
9074 }
9075 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kForever) {
9076 for (const auto& inner : stmt.forever_body) {
9077 collect_proc(inner);
9078 }
9079 return;
9080 }
9081 if (stmt.kind == gpga::StatementKind::kFork) {
9082 for (const auto& inner : stmt.fork_branches) {
9083 collect_proc(inner);
9084 }
9085 }
9086 };
9087 for (const auto& block : top.always_blocks) {
9088 if (block.origin_depth != 0 || block.is_synthesized) {
9089 continue;
9090 }
9091 for (const auto& stmt : block.statements) {
9092 collect_proc(stmt);
9093 }
9094 }
9095 os << "Assigns:\n";
9096 for (const auto* assign : explicit_assigns) {
9097 os << " - " << format_assign(*assign) << "\n";
9098 }
9099 for (const auto& proc : procedural_assigns) {
9100 os << " - " << proc << "\n";
9101 }
9102 if (!derived_assigns.empty()) {
9103 os << "Derived assigns:\n";
9104 for (const auto* assign : derived_assigns) {
9105 os << " * " << format_assign(*assign) << "\n";
9106 }
9107 }
9108 if (!inlined_assigns.empty()) {
9109 os << "Inlined assigns:\n";
9110 for (const auto* assign : inlined_assigns) {
9111 os << " * " << format_assign(*assign) << "\n";
9112 }
9113 }
9114 if (!implicit_assigns.empty()) {
9115 os << "Implicit assigns:\n";
9116 for (const auto* assign : implicit_assigns) {
9117 os << " * " << format_assign(*assign) << "\n";
9118 }
9119 }
9120 os << "Switches:\n";
9121 for (const auto& sw : top.switches) {
9122 const char* kind = "tran";
9123 switch (sw.kind) {
9124 case gpga::SwitchKind::kTran:
9125 kind = "tran";
9126 break;
9127 case gpga::SwitchKind::kTranif1:
9128 kind = "tranif1";
9129 break;
9130 case gpga::SwitchKind::kTranif0:
9131 kind = "tranif0";
9132 break;
9133 case gpga::SwitchKind::kCmos:
9134 kind = "cmos";
9135 break;
9136 }
9137 os << " - " << kind << " " << sw.a << " <-> " << sw.b;
9138 if (sw.control) {
9139 os << " (" << ExprToString(*sw.control, top) << ")";
9140 }
9141 if (sw.control_n) {
9142 os << " / (" << ExprToString(*sw.control_n, top) << ")";
9143 }
9144 os << "\n";
9145 }
9146 auto emit_block_header = [&](const gpga::AlwaysBlock& block,
9147 const std::string& bullet) {
9148 if (block.edge == gpga::EdgeKind::kCombinational) {
9149 if (!block.sensitivity.empty() && block.sensitivity != "*") {
9150 os << bullet << "always @(" << block.sensitivity << ")\n";
9151 } else {
9152 os << bullet << "always @*\n";
9153 }
9154 return;
9155 }
9156 if (block.edge == gpga::EdgeKind::kInitial) {
9157 os << bullet << "initial\n";
9158 return;
9159 }
9160 if (!block.sensitivity.empty()) {
9161 os << bullet << "always @(" << block.sensitivity << ")\n";
9162 } else {
9163 os << bullet << "always @("
9164 << (block.edge == gpga::EdgeKind::kPosedge ? "posedge " : "negedge ")
9165 << block.clock << ")\n";
9166 }
9167 };
9168 auto emit_block = [&](const gpga::AlwaysBlock& block,
9169 const std::string& bullet, bool split_decl_init) {
9170 if (split_decl_init && block.is_decl_init &&
9171 block.statements.size() > 1) {
9172 for (const auto& stmt : block.statements) {
9173 emit_block_header(block, bullet);
9174 DumpStatement(stmt, top, 4, os);
9175 }
9176 return;
9177 }
9178 emit_block_header(block, bullet);
9179 for (const auto& stmt : block.statements) {
9180 DumpStatement(stmt, top, 4, os);
9181 }
9182 };
9183 os << "Always blocks:\n";
9184 std::vector<const gpga::AlwaysBlock*> explicit_blocks;
9185 std::vector<const gpga::AlwaysBlock*> inlined_blocks;
9186 std::vector<const gpga::AlwaysBlock*> synthesized_blocks;
9187 for (const auto& block : top.always_blocks) {
9188 if (block.is_synthesized) {
9189 synthesized_blocks.push_back(&block);
9190 } else if (block.origin_depth != 0) {
9191 inlined_blocks.push_back(&block);
9192 } else {
9193 explicit_blocks.push_back(&block);
9194 }
9195 }
9196 for (const auto* block : explicit_blocks) {
9197 emit_block(*block, " - ", true);
9198 }
9199 if (!inlined_blocks.empty()) {
9200 os << "Inlined always blocks:\n";
9201 for (const auto* block : inlined_blocks) {
9202 emit_block(*block, " * ", false);
9203 }
9204 }
9205 if (!synthesized_blocks.empty()) {
9206 os << "Synthesized always blocks:\n";
9207 for (const auto* block : synthesized_blocks) {
9208 emit_block(*block, " * ", false);
9209 }
9210 }
9211 os << "Flat name map:\n";
9212 if (design.flat_to_hier.empty()) {
9213 os << " - __top__ -> " << top.name << "\n";
9214 } else {
9215 for (const auto& entry : design.flat_to_hier) {
9216 os << " - " << entry.first << " -> " << entry.second << "\n";
9217 }
9218 }
9219}

9223int main(int argc, char** argv) {
9224 if (argc < 2) {
9225 PrintUsage(argv[0]);
9226 return 2;
9227 }
9228
9229#ifndef NDEBUG
9230 LoadDotEnvIfDebug();
9231#endif
9232
9233 std::vector<std::string> input_paths;
9234 std::string msl_out;
9235 std::string host_out;
9236 std::string flat_out;
9237 std::string top_name;
9238 std::string sdf_path;
9239 bool dump_flat = false;
9240 bool enable_4state = false;
9241 bool sched_vm = false;
9242 bool fallback_diag = false;
9243 bool auto_discover = false;
9244 bool strict_1364 = false;
9245 bool verbose_warnings = false;
9246 bool run = false;
9247 bool run_verbose = false;
9248 bool run_source_bindings = false;
9249 uint32_t run_count = 1u;
9250 uint32_t run_service_capacity = 32u;
9251 uint32_t run_max_steps = 1024u;
9252 uint32_t run_max_proc_steps = 64u;
9253 uint32_t run_dispatch_timeout_ms = 0u;
9254 std::string vcd_dir;
9255 uint32_t vcd_steps = 0u;
9256 std::vector<std::string> plusargs;
9257
9258 for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
9259 std::string arg = argv[i];
9260 if (arg == "--emit-msl") {
9261 if (i + 1 >= argc) {
9262 PrintUsage(argv[0]);
9263 return 2;
9264 }
9265 msl_out = argv[++i];
9266 } else if (arg == "--emit-flat") {
9267 if (i + 1 >= argc) {
9268 PrintUsage(argv[0]);
9269 return 2;
9270 }
9271 flat_out = argv[++i];
9272 } else if (arg == "--dump-flat") {
9273 dump_flat = true;
9274 } else if (arg == "--top") {
9275 if (i + 1 >= argc) {
9276 PrintUsage(argv[0]);
9277 return 2;
9278 }
9279 top_name = argv[++i];
9280 } else if (arg == "--emit-host") {
9281 if (i + 1 >= argc) {
9282 PrintUsage(argv[0]);
9283 return 2;
9284 }
9285 host_out = argv[++i];
9286 } else if (arg == "--sdf") {
9287 if (i + 1 >= argc) {
9288 PrintUsage(argv[0]);
9289 return 2;
9290 }
9291 sdf_path = argv[++i];
9292 } else if (arg == "--4state") {
9293 enable_4state = true;
9294 } else if (arg == "--sched-vm") {
9295 sched_vm = true;
9296 } else if (arg == "--fallback-diag") {
9297 fallback_diag = true;
9298 } else if (arg == "--auto") {
9299 auto_discover = true;
9300 } else if (arg == "--strict-1364") {
9301 strict_1364 = true;
9302 } else if (arg == "--verbose" || arg == "-v") {
9303 verbose_warnings = true;
9304 } else if (arg == "--version") {
9305 PrintVersion();
9306 return 0;
9307 } else if (arg == "--run") {
9308 run = true;
9309 } else if (arg == "--run-verbose") {
9310 run_verbose = true;
9311 } else if (arg == "--source-bindings") {
9312 run_source_bindings = true;
9313 } else if (arg == "--count") {
9314 if (i + 1 >= argc) {
9315 PrintUsage(argv[0]);
9316 return 2;
9317 }
9318 run_count = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::stoul(argv[++i]));
9319 if (run_count == 0u) {
9320 run_count = 1u;
9321 }
9322 } else if (arg == "--service-capacity") {
9323 if (i + 1 >= argc) {
9324 PrintUsage(argv[0]);
9325 return 2;
9326 }
9327 run_service_capacity = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::stoul(argv[++i]));
9328 if (run_service_capacity == 0u) {
9329 run_service_capacity = 1u;
9330 }
9331 } else if (arg == "--max-steps") {
9332 if (i + 1 >= argc) {
9333 PrintUsage(argv[0]);
9334 return 2;
9335 }
9336 run_max_steps = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::stoul(argv[++i]));
9337 } else if (arg == "--max-proc-steps") {
9338 if (i + 1 >= argc) {
9339 PrintUsage(argv[0]);
9340 return 2;
9341 }
9342 run_max_proc_steps = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::stoul(argv[++i]));
9343 } else if (arg == "--dispatch-timeout-ms") {
9344 if (i + 1 >= argc) {
9345 PrintUsage(argv[0]);
9346 return 2;
9347 }
9348 run_dispatch_timeout_ms =
9349 static_cast<uint32_t>(std::stoul(argv[++i]));
9350 } else if (arg == "--vcd-dir") {
9351 if (i + 1 >= argc) {
9352 PrintUsage(argv[0]);
9353 return 2;
9354 }
9355 vcd_dir = argv[++i];
9356 } else if (arg == "--vcd-steps") {
9357 if (i + 1 >= argc) {
9358 PrintUsage(argv[0]);
9359 return 2;
9360 }
9361 vcd_steps = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::stoul(argv[++i]));
